body.en: AI can help students practise English at home.
body.zh: 人工智能可以帮助学生在家练习英语。

body.en: My cousin used AI to make a picture for our class project.
body.zh: 我表哥用人工智能为我们的班级项目制作了一张图片。

body.en: My cousin returned to China after studying abroad.
body.zh: 我的表姐留学后回到了中国。

body.en: We travelled across China by train last summer.
body.zh: 去年夏天，我们坐火车游历了中国。

body.en: Our visitors want to learn some Chinese before dinner.
body.zh: 我们的客人想在晚饭前学几句中文。

body.en: We read a Chinese story in class today.
body.zh: 今天我们在课上读了一个中国故事。

body.en: We decorate the living room with lights before Christmas each year.
body.zh: 每年圣诞节前，我们都会用彩灯装饰客厅。

body.en: My cousin sent me a card at Christmas last year.
body.zh: 去年圣诞节，我的表亲给我寄了一张卡片。

body.en: We use English to write letters to our new friends.
body.zh: 我们用英语给新朋友写信。

body.en: This English story has short sentences and colorful pictures.
body.zh: 这个英语故事句子简短，插图色彩鲜艳。

body.en: I keep my favourite books beside my bed.
body.zh: 我把最喜欢的书放在床边。

body.en: When the rain stopped, I went outside with my brother.
body.zh: 雨停后，我和弟弟一起出去了。

body.en: We used the Internet to find the museum's opening hours.
body.zh: 我们用互联网查询了博物馆的开放时间。

body.en: Dad checks the Internet for train times before a trip.
body.zh: 爸爸出行前会在网上查询列车时刻。

body.en: Miss Lee helped us find our classroom.
body.zh: 李老师帮我们找到了教室。

body.en: I gave the card to Miss Green after class.
body.zh: 下课后我把卡片交给了格林老师。

body.en: Mr Green teaches science at our middle school.
body.zh: 格林先生在我们中学教科学。

body.en: We thanked Mr Lee for helping with the school garden.
body.zh: 我们感谢李先生帮助打理学校花园。

body.en: Mrs Brown brought some flowers for our classroom.
body.zh: 布朗太太给我们教室带来了一些花。

body.en: We visited Mrs Li after she moved into her new home.
body.zh: 李太太搬入新家后，我们去看望了她。

body.en: Ms Wang will lead our art club this term.
body.zh: 王女士这学期将负责我们的美术社团。

body.en: I asked Ms Lee a question after the meeting.
body.zh: 会议结束后，我问了李女士一个问题。

body.en: It is OK to ask questions when you do not understand.
body.zh: 不明白时提问是可以的。

body.en: I checked the little bird and saw that it was OK.
body.zh: 我检查了小鸟，发现它安然无恙。

body.en: Our class watched the Olympic opening ceremony together.
body.zh: 我们班一起观看了奥运会开幕式。

body.en: She dreams of joining an Olympic swimming team one day.
body.zh: 她梦想有一天加入奥运游泳队。

body.en: We have PE in the playground on Tuesday morning.
body.zh: 星期二上午，我们在操场上上体育课。

body.en: Please wear sports shoes for your PE lesson today.
body.zh: 今天上体育课请穿运动鞋。

body.en: I wore a clean T-shirt for our class picnic.
body.zh: 班级野餐时，我穿了一件干净的T恤。

body.en: This T-shirt is too small for my younger brother.
body.zh: 这件T恤对我弟弟来说太小了。

body.en: We watched a film about wild animals on TV.
body.zh: 我们在电视上看了一部关于野生动物的影片。

body.en: Please turn off the TV when you leave the room.
body.zh: 离开房间时，请关掉电视。

body.en: The doctor looked at the X-ray of my arm.
body.zh: 医生看了我手臂的X光片。

body.en: I waited outside while my brother had an X-ray.
body.zh: 哥哥拍X光片时，我在外面等着。

body.en: I ate an apple before school.
body.zh: 我上学前吃了一个苹果。

body.en: There is a small shop near our home.
body.zh: 我们家附近有一家小商店。

body.en: Our first lesson begins at eight a.m. tomorrow.
body.zh: 我们明天第一节课上午八点开始。

body.en: The train leaves at ten a.m. on Sunday.
body.zh: 火车周日上午十点出发。

body.en: Practice can improve your ability to speak English.
body.zh: 练习能提高你说英语的能力。

body.en: She has the ability to explain difficult ideas clearly.
body.zh: 她有把复杂想法讲清楚的能力。

body.en: My little brother is able to tie his shoes now.
body.zh: 我弟弟现在会系鞋带了。

body.en: Are you able to help me carry these books upstairs?
body.zh: 你能帮我把这些书搬上楼吗？

body.en: We talked about our favorite books during lunch.
body.zh: 午餐时我们聊了各自最喜欢的书。

body.en: The walk to the lake takes about twenty minutes.
body.zh: 走到湖边大约要二十分钟。

body.en: A small lamp hangs above the kitchen table.
body.zh: 一盏小灯挂在餐桌上方。

body.en: Please write your name above the first question.
body.zh: 请把姓名写在第一道题上方。

body.en: My cousin hopes to study abroad next year.
body.zh: 我表姐希望明年出国留学。

body.en: We met some friendly people while travelling abroad.
body.zh: 我们出国旅行时遇到了友好的人。

body.en: Two students were absent from class yesterday.
Please tell the teacher why you were absent.
body.zh: 请告诉老师你缺席的原因。

body.en: Mia accepted her friend's invitation to the party.
body.zh: 米娅接受了朋友的派对邀请。

body.en: Dad accepted my apology after I said sorry.
body.zh: 我道歉后，爸爸接受了我的道歉。

body.en: The bus stopped because of a road accident.
body.zh: 公交车因为一起交通事故停下了。

body.en: I found your missing pen by accident yesterday.
body.zh: 昨天我偶然找到了你丢失的笔。

body.en: According to the school notice, the library closes at five.
body.zh: 根据学校通知，图书馆五点关门。

body.en: We chose our seats according to the teacher's plan.
body.zh: 我们按照老师的安排选了座位。

body.en: My sister opened a bank account last week.
body.zh: 我姐姐上周开了一个银行账户。

body.en: He gave a clear account of the trip.
body.zh: 他清楚地讲述了旅行的经过。

body.en: My legs ache after the long mountain walk.
body.zh: 长途登山后，我的双腿酸痛。

body.en: She felt a dull ache in her shoulder.
You can achieve your goal through regular practice.
body.zh: 通过经常练习，你能实现目标。

body.en: Our team worked hard to achieve better results.
body.zh: 我们队努力争取更好的成绩。

body.en: We walked across the bridge after school.
body.zh: 放学后我们走过了那座桥。

body.en: Their house is across the street from the library.
body.zh: 他们家在图书馆的马路对面。

body.en: We must act quickly to protect the old tree.
body.zh: 我们必须迅速行动，保护那棵老树。

body.en: I want to act in the school play.
body.zh: 我想在学校的话剧中表演。

body.en: The teacher took action when she saw water on the classroom floor.
body.zh: 老师看到教室地板上有水时，马上采取了行动。

body.en: The film has exciting action, but my little brother prefers cartoons.
body.zh: 这部电影有精彩的动作场面，但我弟弟更喜欢动画片。

body.en: Tom stays active by riding his bike to school every day.
body.zh: 汤姆每天骑自行车上学，让自己保持活跃。

body.en: Our English club is active and meets every Friday after class.
body.zh: 我们的英语社团很活跃，每周五课后都会活动。

body.en: Our class chose a team activity for the school open day.
body.zh: 我们班为学校开放日选了一项团队活动。

body.en: Reading is a quiet activity I enjoy before going to bed.
body.zh: 阅读是我喜欢的一项安静活动，我睡前会读书。

body.en: The actor signed my notebook after the school play.
body.zh: 学校戏剧演出后，那位男演员在我的笔记本上签了名。

body.en: My cousin hopes to become an actress in the future.
body.zh: 我表姐希望将来成为一名女演员。

body.en: I thought the shop was closed, but it was actually open.
body.zh: 我以为商店关门了，但它其实开着。

body.en: Actually, our class picnic is on Friday, not Saturday.
body.zh: 其实，我们班的野餐在星期五，不是星期六。

body.en: Dad saw an ad for a new bicycle in the newspaper.
body.zh: 爸爸在报纸上看到了一则新自行车广告。

body.en: The shop put an ad online to tell people about its sale.
body.zh: 商店在网上登了广告，告诉大家它在打折。

body.en: Add some milk to the bowl before mixing the eggs.
body.zh: 搅拌鸡蛋前，先往碗里加些牛奶。

body.en: Our teacher added a fun quiz to the lesson.
body.zh: 老师在课上加了一个有趣的小测验。

body.en: Please write your address clearly on the envelope.
body.zh: 请在信封上写清楚你的地址。

body.en: I sent the invitation to the wrong address.
body.zh: 我把邀请函寄到了错误的地址。

body.en: I admire people who help others without rewards.
body.zh: 我敬佩那些不求回报帮助别人的人。

body.en: We stopped to admire the flowers beside the road.
body.zh: 我们停下来欣赏路边的花。

body.en: Please ask an adult to help with this box.
body.zh: 请找一位成年人帮忙搬这个箱子。

body.en: An adult ticket costs more than a child's ticket.
Living near school has one clear advantage.
body.zh: 住在学校附近有一个明显的好处。

body.en: Her height gives her an advantage in basketball.
body.zh: 她的身高让她打篮球时占优势。

body.en: My sister gave me good advice about choosing a school club.
body.zh: 姐姐给了我选择学校社团的好建议。

body.en: The coach's advice helped our team play better together.
body.zh: 教练的建议帮助我们队配合得更好。

body.en: Teachers advise us to plan our study time.
body.zh: 老师建议我们安排好学习时间。

body.en: What would you advise me to do next?
body.zh: 你建议我接下来做什么？

body.en: I saved my pocket money until I could afford a new helmet.
body.zh: 我攒零花钱，直到买得起一顶新头盔。

body.en: We cannot afford to miss the last bus home.
body.zh: 我们不能错过回家的末班车。

body.en: Lena is afraid of dogs, so she stays near her mother.
body.zh: 莉娜怕狗，所以她待在妈妈身边。

body.en: I'm afraid we cannot visit the park because it is closed.
body.zh: 恐怕我们不能去公园，因为它关门了。

body.en: We usually walk the dog after dinner.
Wash your hands after you play outside.
Our class will visit the museum this afternoon.
body.zh: 我们班今天下午要参观博物馆。

body.en: I spent the whole afternoon reading a story.
body.zh: 我整个下午都在读一个故事。

body.en: Please explain the last question again more slowly.
body.zh: 请再慢一点解释最后一道题。

body.en: We hope to visit this village again soon.
body.zh: 我们希望很快再次到这个村庄游玩。

body.en: Our team will play against theirs on Friday.
body.zh: 我们队周五将与他们队比赛。

body.en: Please leave your bicycle against the garden wall.
body.zh: 请把自行车靠在花园墙边。

body.en: Children of my age enjoy this adventure story.
body.zh: 我这个年龄的孩子喜欢这个冒险故事。

body.en: My grandmother learned to swim at the age of sixty.
body.zh: 我奶奶六十岁时学会了游泳。

body.en: We moved to this town three years ago.
body.zh: 我们三年前搬到了这个镇上。

body.en: The film started about ten minutes ago.
body.zh: 电影大约十分钟前开始了。

body.en: My friends and I agree to meet at the library after school.
body.zh: 我和朋友们同意放学后在图书馆见面。

body.en: The two sisters agree that the blue dress looks better.
body.zh: 姐妹俩都认为蓝色连衣裙更好看。

body.en: The library is just ahead on your left.
body.zh: 图书馆就在前方你的左手边。

body.en: We need to plan ahead for the school trip.
body.zh: 我们需要提前为学校旅行做好计划。

body.en: The older students gave aid to younger children during the school trip.
body.zh: 学校旅行时，高年级学生帮助了年幼的孩子。

body.en: A map can aid us when we walk through a new town.
body.zh: 在陌生城镇里步行时，地图能帮到我们。

body.en: My aim is to read one English story every week.
body.zh: 我的目标是每周读一个英语故事。

body.en: She aimed at the goal carefully before kicking the ball.
body.zh: 踢球前，她仔细瞄准了球门。

body.en: Open the window to let in fresh air.
body.zh: 打开窗户，让新鲜空气进来。

body.en: The kite rose high into the evening air.
body.zh: 风筝高高飞上傍晚的天空。

body.en: We arrived at the airport two hours before our flight.
body.zh: 我们提前两小时到达机场。

body.en: A bus took us from the airport to our hotel.
body.zh: 一辆公交车把我们从机场送到了酒店。

body.en: My alarm rang before sunrise this morning.
body.zh: 今天早晨天还没亮，闹钟就响了。

body.en: Everyone left the building when the alarm sounded.
body.zh: 警报响起时，大家都离开了大楼。

body.en: The little plant is still alive after a week without rain.
body.zh: 这株小植物一周没下雨后仍然活着。

body.en: The busy market comes alive when the music starts.
body.zh: 音乐响起时，热闹的集市顿时充满活力。

body.en: All the students brought their own water bottles today.
body.zh: 今天所有学生都带了自己的水瓶。

body.en: We ate all the sandwiches before the bus arrived.
body.zh: 公交车到达前，我们把所有三明治都吃完了。

body.en: Our teacher allows us to use dictionaries in class.
body.zh: 老师允许我们在课堂上使用词典。

body.en: The museum does not allow visitors to touch the paintings.
body.zh: 博物馆不允许游客触摸画作。

body.en: We almost missed the bus because we left home late.
body.zh: 我们差点因为出门晚而错过公交车。

body.en: The bottle is almost full after I added some water.
body.zh: 加了一些水后，瓶子几乎满了。

body.en: She enjoys reading alone in the quiet garden.
body.zh: 她喜欢独自在安静的花园里读书。

body.en: I was not alone because my sister stayed.
body.zh: 我不是独自一人，因为姐姐留了下来。

body.en: We walked along the river after dinner and watched the ducks.
body.zh: 晚饭后我们沿着河边散步，看鸭子。

body.en: Come along with us to the school library.
body.zh: 和我们一起去学校图书馆吧。

body.en: Please read the first paragraph aloud to us.
body.zh: 请把第一段朗读给我们听。

body.en: Grandpa likes to read poems aloud after dinner.
body.zh: 爷爷喜欢在晚饭后朗读诗歌。

body.en: I have already packed my books for tomorrow.
body.zh: 我已经收拾好了明天要用的书。

body.en: The bus had already left when we reached the stop.
body.zh: 我们到车站时，公交车已经开走了。

body.en: My sister plays the piano, and she also sings in the school choir.
body.zh: 我姐姐会弹钢琴，也在学校合唱团唱歌。

body.en: We packed sandwiches and also brought fresh fruit for the picnic.
body.zh: 我们带了三明治，也为野餐准备了新鲜水果。

body.en: Although it was raining, we played basketball indoors.
body.zh: 虽然下着雨，我们还是在室内打了篮球。

body.en: Although Mia was tired, she finished her homework before dinner.
body.zh: 虽然米娅很累，她还是在晚饭前完成了作业。

body.en: Our dog always waits by the door when I come home.
body.zh: 我回家时，我们的狗总是在门边等着。

body.en: I always pack my schoolbag before I go to sleep.
body.zh: 我睡觉前总会整理好书包。

body.en: The view from the mountain was truly amazing.
body.zh: 山顶的景色十分令人惊叹。

body.en: She showed us an amazing drawing of a dragon.
body.zh: 她给我们看了一幅令人惊叹的龙的画。

body.en: Among the colorful flowers, a small bee was looking for food.
body.zh: 在五颜六色的花丛中，一只小蜜蜂正在寻找食物。

body.en: The teacher shared the extra books among the three groups.
body.zh: 老师把多余的书分给了三个小组。

body.en: We saw ancient bowls at the history museum.
body.zh: 我们在历史博物馆看到了古代的碗。

body.en: The guide told us how people lived in ancient China.
body.zh: 导游给我们讲了古代中国人的生活。

body.en: My brother and I walk to school together.
body.zh: 我和弟弟一起步行上学。

body.en: We bought apples and bread for the picnic.
body.zh: 我们为野餐买了苹果和面包。

body.en: He felt angry when someone broke his model.
body.zh: 有人弄坏他的模型时，他感到生气。

body.en: I was angry with myself for losing the key.
body.zh: 我因弄丢钥匙而生自己的气。

body.en: This small animal lives high in the mountains.
body.zh: 这种小动物生活在高山上。

body.en: We watched an animal programme after finishing dinner.
body.zh: 吃完晚饭后，我们看了动物节目。

body.en: Could I have another glass of water, please?
We tried another way to solve the problem.
body.zh: 我们尝试用另一种方法解决问题。

body.en: Please answer the question in a complete sentence.
body.zh: 请用完整的句子回答问题。

body.en: I found the answer at the end of the book.
body.zh: 我在书的末尾找到了答案。

body.en: An ant carried a tiny piece of bread.
body.zh: 一只蚂蚁搬着一小块面包。

body.en: We watched an ant walk across the path.
body.zh: 我们看着一只蚂蚁爬过小路。

body.en: Do you have any questions about the homework?
body.zh: 关于作业，你还有问题吗？

body.en: You can choose any book from this shelf.
body.zh: 你可以从这个书架上任选一本书。

body.en: Does anyone want to join our game after lunch?
body.zh: 午饭后有人想加入我们的游戏吗？

body.en: Anybody can borrow this book from the classroom shelf.
body.zh: 任何人都可以从教室书架上借这本书。

body.en: Would you like anything to drink after the game?
body.zh: 比赛后你想喝点什么吗？

body.en: I couldn't find anything interesting at the bookshop.
body.zh: 我在书店没找到什么有趣的东西。

body.en: It was raining, but we went to the library anyway.
body.zh: 虽然下着雨，我们还是去了图书馆。

body.en: I forgot my umbrella, but the bus stop is nearby anyway.
body.zh: 我忘带伞了，不过公交站反正就在附近。

body.en: You can sit anywhere in the classroom during free reading time.
body.zh: 自由阅读时间，你可以坐在教室里的任何地方。

body.en: We looked everywhere, but could not find the keys anywhere.
body.zh: 我们到处找，但哪儿都没找到钥匙。

body.en: Their apartment is on the fifth floor.
We moved into a small apartment near school.
body.zh: 我们搬进了学校附近的一套小公寓。

body.en: This app helps me learn new English words.
body.zh: 这个应用程序帮我学习英语新单词。

body.en: Dad uses an app to check the weather.
body.zh: 爸爸用一个应用程序查看天气。

body.en: A rainbow appeared over the playground after the rain.
body.zh: 雨后，操场上空出现了一道彩虹。

body.en: The soup appears hot, so let it cool before eating.
body.zh: 这汤看起来很烫，喝之前让它凉一凉。

body.en: I put an apple in my lunch box.
body.zh: 我在午餐盒里放了一个苹果。

body.en: Please cut the apple into four equal pieces.
body.zh: 请把苹果切成大小相等的四块。

body.en: This area of the park is perfect for a family picnic.
body.zh: 公园的这片区域很适合全家野餐。

body.en: We measured the area of the classroom with a tape measure.
body.zh: 我们用卷尺测量了教室的面积。

body.en: Please do not argue about such a small problem.
body.zh: 请不要为这样的小问题争吵。

body.en: They often argue with each other about football.
body.zh: 他们经常因为足球互相争论。

body.en: She carried the books under her left arm.
My arm felt tired after carrying the heavy bag.
body.zh: 提完重袋子后，我的手臂很累。

body.en: The army helped families after the strong storm hit the town.
body.zh: 强风暴袭击小镇后，军队帮助了当地家庭。

body.en: My uncle joined the army after he finished college.
body.zh: 我叔叔大学毕业后参了军。

body.en: We walked around the lake and watched the ducks.
body.zh: 我们绕着湖散步，看着那些鸭子。

body.en: There are several small shops around our school.
body.zh: 我们学校周围有几家小商店。

body.en: We should arrive at the station before noon.
body.zh: 我们应该在中午前到达车站。

body.en: What time will your cousins arrive tomorrow morning?
body.zh: 你表亲们明天上午几点到？

body.en: We learn about colour in our art lessons.
body.zh: 我们在美术课上学习色彩知识。

body.en: The museum has a wonderful collection of modern art.
body.zh: 博物馆收藏了许多精彩的现代艺术作品。

body.en: I read an interesting article about wild birds.
body.zh: 我读了一篇关于野生鸟类的有趣文章。

body.en: She wrote an article for the school newspaper.
body.zh: 她为校报写了一篇文章。

body.en: The artist painted a bright picture of our school garden.
body.zh: 这位艺术家画了一幅色彩明亮的校园花园图。

body.en: My aunt is an artist who makes small clay animals.
body.zh: 我阿姨是一位制作小陶土动物的艺术家。

body.en: As we walked home, the sky turned pink.
body.zh: 我们走回家时，天空变成了粉红色。

body.en: My sister works as a doctor at the town hospital.
body.zh: 我姐姐在镇上的医院当医生。

body.en: Please ask your teacher if you need help.
body.zh: 如果需要帮助，请向老师求助。

body.en: May I ask you a question about the trip?
body.zh: 我可以问你一个关于旅行的问题吗？

body.en: The baby was already asleep when we arrived.
body.zh: 我们到达时，宝宝已经睡着了。

body.en: I fell asleep before the film was over.
body.zh: 电影还没结束，我就睡着了。

body.en: An astronaut spoke to our class from space.
body.zh: 一名宇航员从太空与我们班进行了交谈。

body.en: My brother dreams of becoming an astronaut someday.
body.zh: 我哥哥梦想将来成为宇航员。

body.en: Meet me at the school gate after class.
body.zh: 下课后在校门口和我碰面。

body.en: The children laughed at the funny story.
body.zh: 孩子们听了这个有趣的故事都笑了。

body.en: The young athlete runs around the school field every morning.
body.zh: 这位年轻运动员每天早上都绕着学校操场跑步。

body.en: My sister wants to be an athlete when she grows up.
body.zh: 我姐姐长大后想当一名运动员。

body.en: The castle walls protected the village from attack.
body.zh: 城墙保护村庄免受攻击。

body.en: In the game, we must attack the enemy base.
body.zh: 在游戏里，我们必须进攻敌方基地。

body.en: Will your parents attend the school meeting tomorrow?
body.zh: 你的父母明天会参加学校会议吗？

body.en: I attend a painting class every Saturday morning.
body.zh: 我每周六上午上绘画课。

body.en: Please pay attention when the teacher explains the homework.
body.zh: 老师讲解作业时，请认真听讲。

body.en: The bright red sign caught my attention near the bus stop.
body.zh: 公交车站附近那个鲜红的标志吸引了我的注意。

body.en: My aunt taught me how to make dumplings.
We stayed with our aunt during the holiday.
body.zh: 假期里我们住在阿姨家。

body.en: The leaves turn yellow and red in autumn.
body.zh: 秋天，树叶变成黄色和红色。

body.en: We picked apples together on a sunny autumn day.
body.zh: 秋天一个晴天，我们一起摘了苹果。

body.en: The average height of these plants is one metre.
body.zh: 这些植物的平均高度是一米。

body.en: We spend an average of twenty minutes reading daily.
body.zh: 我们每天平均花二十分钟阅读。

body.en: We left early to avoid the heavy traffic.
body.zh: 我们早早出发，以避开拥堵的交通。

body.en: Read the question carefully to avoid making mistakes.
I stayed awake until my father came home.
body.zh: 我一直没睡，直到爸爸回家。

body.en: The loud noise kept everyone awake last night.
body.zh: 昨晚的巨响让大家无法入睡。

body.en: Our class won an award for the garden project.
body.zh: 我们班的花园项目获了奖。

body.en: She received an award at the school concert.
body.zh: 她在学校音乐会上获得了奖项。

body.en: I was not aware that the library closed early on Fridays.
body.zh: 我不知道图书馆周五会提早关门。

body.en: Please be aware of the wet floor near the swimming pool.
body.zh: 请注意游泳池附近的地面很湿。

body.en: My grandparents live far away, so we visit them in summer.
body.zh: 我的祖父母住得很远，所以我们夏天去看望他们。

body.en: Please put your toys away before dinner.
The weather was awful, so we stayed indoors.
body.zh: 天气很糟糕，所以我们待在室内。

body.en: I felt awful about breaking my sister's favourite cup.
body.zh: 打碎姐姐最爱的杯子，我很难受。

body.en: The baby smiled when her mother sang softly.
body.zh: 妈妈轻声唱歌时，宝宝笑了。

body.en: Please speak quietly because the baby is sleeping.
body.zh: 请小声说话，因为宝宝正在睡觉。

body.en: I put the book back on the shelf.
He carried a small bag on his back.
Please write your name on the blue background of the poster.
body.zh: 请把名字写在海报的蓝色背景上。

body.en: We learned about the background of the old bridge in class.
body.zh: 我们在课堂上了解了这座古桥的背景资料。

body.en: I had a bad cold and stayed home from school yesterday.
body.zh: 我昨天重感冒了，只好待在家里没去上学。

body.en: It is bad to leave your books in the rain.
We play badminton in the sports hall after school.
body.zh: 放学后，我们在体育馆打羽毛球。

body.en: My sister joined the school badminton club last week.
body.zh: 我姐姐上周加入了学校羽毛球社。

body.en: My bag is too heavy to carry far.
body.zh: 我的包太重，无法提着走很远。

body.en: She put the empty bag beside the door.
She kept her balance while riding her bike down the hill.
body.zh: 她骑车下坡时保持了平衡。

body.en: We need to balance homework with time for rest and play.
body.zh: 我们需要平衡作业、休息和玩耍的时间。

body.en: a balance of work and rest
The ball rolled under a car near the gate.
body.zh: 球滚到了大门附近的一辆汽车下面。

body.en: Please throw the ball gently to your little sister.
body.zh: 请轻轻地把球扔给妹妹。

body.en: A red balloon floated above the garden fence.
body.zh: 一个红气球飘在花园围栏上方。

body.en: We tied a balloon to each chair for the party.
body.zh: 我们为聚会在每把椅子上绑了一个气球。

body.en: Pandas spend much of their time eating bamboo.
body.zh: 熊猫花很多时间吃竹子。

body.en: Grandpa made a small basket from bamboo.
body.zh: 爷爷用竹子做了一个小篮子。

body.en: I had a banana after our running practice.
body.zh: 跑步训练后，我吃了一根香蕉。

body.en: She cut the banana into pieces for the baby.
body.zh: 她把香蕉切成小块给宝宝吃。

body.en: My brother plays the guitar in a school band.
body.zh: 我哥哥在学校乐队弹吉他。

body.en: The band played three songs at the summer concert.
body.zh: 乐队在夏季音乐会上演奏了三首歌。

body.en: Dad went to the bank to put some money into his account.
body.zh: 爸爸去银行把一些钱存进账户。

body.en: We sat on the river bank and watched the ducks swim.
body.zh: 我们坐在河岸上看鸭子游泳。

body.en: We play baseball with our neighbors in the park on Sundays.
body.zh: 星期天我们和邻居在公园里打棒球。

body.en: My brother needs a new baseball for practice this afternoon.
body.zh: 我哥哥今天下午训练需要一个新棒球。

body.en: The coach taught us some basic swimming skills.
body.zh: 教练教了我们一些基本游泳技巧。

body.en: Please learn the basic rules before playing this game.
body.zh: 玩这个游戏前，请先了解基本规则。

body.en: We filled the basket with apples from the tree.
body.zh: 我们把从树上摘的苹果装满了篮子。

body.en: Put the clean towels in the large basket.
body.zh: 把干净毛巾放进那个大篮子里。

body.en: Our basketball team practises twice a week.
body.zh: 我们篮球队每周训练两次。

body.en: We watched a basketball game on television yesterday.
body.zh: 我们昨天在电视上看了一场篮球赛。

body.en: A bat flew out of the old building.
body.zh: 一只蝙蝠从旧楼里飞了出来。

body.en: He held the baseball bat with both hands.
I had a warm bath after the long walk.
body.zh: 走了很久后，我洗了个温水澡。

body.en: The child splashed water while having a bath.
body.zh: 孩子洗澡时把水溅得到处都是。

body.en: Please leave the clean towels in the bathroom.
body.zh: 请把干净毛巾放在浴室里。

body.en: There is a bathroom next to my bedroom.
body.zh: 我的卧室旁边有一个卫生间。

body.en: I am tired after basketball practice.
The library is open until five today.
We collected shells along the beach before lunch.
body.zh: 午饭前，我们沿着海滩捡贝壳。

body.en: The children built a sandcastle on the beach.
body.zh: 孩子们在海滩上堆了一座沙堡。

body.en: We planted a bean in a small pot.
body.zh: 我们在小花盆里种了一颗豆子。

body.en: This bean plant needs more space to grow.
body.zh: 这株豆科植物需要更大的生长空间。

body.en: We saw a brown bear beside the river.
body.zh: 我们在河边看见了一只棕熊。

body.en: I cannot bear the noise from that machine.
body.zh: 我受不了那台机器的噪声。

body.en: Our team hopes to beat them next time.
body.zh: 我们队希望下次战胜他们。

body.en: We clapped our hands to the beat of the music.
body.zh: 我们随着音乐的节拍拍手。

body.en: The garden looks beautiful after the spring rain.
body.zh: 春雨过后，花园看起来很美。

body.en: She sang a beautiful song at the school concert.
body.zh: 她在学校音乐会上唱了一首优美的歌。

body.en: We stayed inside because it was raining hard.
body.zh: 因为雨下得很大，我们待在了室内。

body.en: Tina wore a coat because the morning was cold.
body.zh: 因为早晨很冷，蒂娜穿了一件外套。

body.en: I hope to become a teacher one day.
body.zh: 我希望有一天成为老师。

body.en: The sky can become dark before a storm.
body.zh: 暴风雨来临前，天空会变暗。

body.en: I read for ten minutes before going to bed.
The cat was sleeping at the end of my bed.
I put my schoolbag beside the desk in my bedroom.
body.zh: 我把书包放在卧室书桌旁。

body.en: My sister shares a bedroom with me when our cousins visit.
body.zh: 表亲来访时，我和姐姐共用一间卧室。

body.en: A bee landed on a bright yellow flower.
body.zh: 一只蜜蜂落在一朵鲜黄色的花上。

body.en: We watched the bee fly back to its hive.
body.zh: 我们看着蜜蜂飞回蜂巢。

body.en: Dad cooked beef with carrots for our dinner.
body.zh: 爸爸把牛肉和胡萝卜一起烹调，作为我们的晚餐。

body.en: Would you like some beef in your noodles?
body.zh: 你想在面条里加点牛肉吗？

body.en: Please finish your homework before dinner tonight.
body.zh: 今晚请在晚饭前完成作业。

body.en: Wash your hands before you help Mum make sandwiches.
body.zh: 帮妈妈做三明治前先洗手。

body.en: Our lessons begin at half past eight.
Let us begin with a simple question today.
body.zh: 今天我们从一个简单的问题开始。

body.en: Please behave well when we visit the museum.
body.zh: 参观博物馆时，请注意举止。

body.en: Children learn how to behave by watching adults.
body.zh: 孩子通过观察成年人学习如何举止得体。

body.en: The little dog hid behind the garden gate.
Please do not leave your schoolbag behind.
I believe my friend will keep her promise.
body.zh: 我相信我的朋友会信守诺言。

body.en: Many children believe that stars look brighter in the countryside.
body.zh: 许多孩子认为乡村的星星看起来更亮。

body.en: The school bell rang while we were reading.
body.zh: 我们阅读时，学校的铃响了。

body.en: Please ring the bell if nobody opens the door.
body.zh: 如果没人开门，请按门铃。

body.en: These colored pencils belong to my sister, so I will return them.
body.zh: 这些彩色铅笔是我姐姐的，所以我会还给她。

body.en: After a few weeks, I began to feel that I belonged in the club.
body.zh: 几周后，我开始觉得自己适合待在这个社团里。

body.en: The temperature stayed below zero during the cold night.
body.zh: 寒冷的夜里，气温一直在零度以下。

body.en: Please write your answer below the picture on the page.
body.zh: 请把答案写在这一页图片的下方。

body.en: He wears a brown belt with these trousers.
body.zh: 他穿这条裤子时系一条棕色皮带。

body.en: Please fasten your seat belt before we leave.
Regular reading can benefit students in many ways.
body.zh: 经常阅读能让学生在许多方面受益。

body.en: One benefit of walking is spending time outdoors.
body.zh: 步行的一个好处是能在户外活动。

body.en: I left my umbrella beside the front door.
body.zh: 我把伞放在前门旁边了。

body.en: She sat beside her friend on the bus.
body.zh: 她在公交车上坐在朋友旁边。

body.en: This is the best book I have read this year.
body.zh: 这是我今年读过的最好的书。

body.en: Do your best and enjoy the school race.
body.zh: 尽你最大的努力，享受学校比赛吧。

body.en: The weather is better today, so we can play outside.
body.zh: 今天天气好些了，所以我们可以在外面玩。

body.en: You can see the board better from the front row.
The library stands between the bank and the cinema.
body.zh: 图书馆位于银行和电影院之间。

body.en: We shared the last orange between the two of us.
body.zh: 我们俩分了最后一个橙子。

body.en: They need a big table for the family dinner.
body.zh: 家庭聚餐需要一张大桌子。

body.en: Moving to another city was a big change.
body.zh: 搬到另一座城市是个很大的变化。

body.en: I ride my bike to school every morning.
body.zh: 我每天早晨骑自行车上学。

body.en: My bike has a small basket at the front.
body.zh: 我的自行车前面有一个小篮子。

body.en: We asked for the bill after finishing lunch.
body.zh: 吃完午饭后，我们请服务员结账。

body.en: Dad checked the electricity bill at the kitchen table.
body.zh: 爸爸在餐桌旁核对电费账单。

body.en: Please put the empty bottle in the recycling bin.
body.zh: 请把空瓶子放进回收箱。

body.en: The bin beside our classroom is almost full.
body.zh: 教室旁边的垃圾桶快满了。

body.en: We learn about plants and animals in biology.
body.zh: 我们在生物课上学习动植物知识。

body.en: Our biology teacher showed us a leaf under a microscope.
body.zh: 生物老师让我们看了显微镜下的叶片。

body.en: A small bird sang outside my bedroom window.
body.zh: 一只小鸟在我的卧室窗外鸣叫。

body.en: We found a bird's nest in the old tree.
body.zh: 我们在老树上发现了一个鸟窝。

body.en: Our teacher asked us to write our date of birth.
body.zh: 老师让我们写出自己的出生日期。

body.en: We celebrated the birth of my little sister with a family dinner.
body.zh: 我们吃了一顿家庭聚餐，庆祝妹妹的出生。

body.en: My birthday falls on a Friday this year.
body.zh: 今年我的生日是星期五。

body.en: We made a card for our teacher's birthday.
body.zh: 我们为老师的生日做了一张卡片。

body.en: Would you like a biscuit with your tea?
body.zh: 你喝茶时想吃一块饼干吗？

body.en: She shared her last biscuit with her brother.
body.zh: 她和弟弟分吃了最后一块饼干。

body.en: I feel a bit tired after the long walk.
body.zh: 走了很久后，我感觉有点累。

body.en: Please add a little bit of salt to the soup.
Kai wore a black jacket to school on the rainy day.
body.zh: 下雨那天，凯穿了一件黑色夹克去学校。

body.en: The artist used black to draw the night sky.
body.zh: 画家用黑色颜料画夜空。

body.en: The teacher wrote three questions on the blackboard.
body.zh: 老师在黑板上写了三个问题。

body.en: Please clean the blackboard before our next lesson.
body.zh: 下节课前，请擦干净黑板。

body.en: My finger began to bleed after I cut it.
body.zh: 手指割破后开始流血了。

body.en: Small cuts sometimes bleed more than you expect.
body.zh: 小伤口有时流血比你预想的多。

body.en: The guide dog helps a blind woman cross roads.
body.zh: 导盲犬帮助一位盲人女士过马路。

body.en: Some blind people read books using raised dots.
body.zh: 一些盲人通过触摸凸点来阅读书籍。

body.en: A fallen tree can block a narrow road.
body.zh: 倒下的树会挡住狭窄的道路。

body.en: Our flat is in the next block.
body.zh: 我们的公寓在下一栋楼里。

body.en: The nurse took a small sample of blood.
There was a little blood on his sleeve.
My mother wore a blue blouse to work.
body.zh: 妈妈穿了一件蓝色女衬衫去上班。

body.en: This cotton blouse feels soft and comfortable.
body.zh: 这件棉质女衬衫摸着柔软舒适。

body.en: A cool wind began to blow through the open window.
body.zh: 凉风开始从开着的窗户吹进来。

body.en: Please blow on the soup because it is still hot.
She painted the bedroom walls light blue.
body.zh: 她把卧室的墙刷成了浅蓝色。

body.en: There were no clouds in the blue sky.
The teacher wrote our new words on the board before class.
body.zh: 上课前，老师把新单词写在黑板上。

body.en: We boarded the bus at the stop near the park.
body.zh: 我们在公园附近的车站上了公交车。

body.en: We crossed the lake in a small boat.
The boat stopped beside the wooden bridge.
Regular exercise helps keep your body strong.
body.zh: 经常锻炼有助于保持身体强健。

body.en: The dancer moved her whole body to the music.
body.zh: 舞者随着音乐舞动全身。

body.en: Please boil some water before making the tea.
We need to boil the potatoes until soft.
body.zh: 我们需要把土豆煮到软烂。

body.en: I borrowed a book about stars from the library.
body.zh: 我从图书馆借了一本关于星星的书。

body.en: We need to book a table for Saturday evening.
body.zh: 我们需要预订周六晚上的餐桌。

body.en: The long speech was boring, so I felt sleepy.
body.zh: 长篇演讲很无聊，所以我困了。

body.en: He thinks washing dishes is a boring job.
body.zh: 他认为洗碗是件无聊的事。

body.en: My little sister was born in this city.
body.zh: 我的妹妹在这座城市出生。

body.en: The twins were born on a snowy morning.
body.zh: 这对双胞胎在一个下雪的早晨出生。

body.en: May I borrow your ruler for this lesson?
body.zh: 这节课我可以借一下你的尺子吗？

body.en: We can borrow books from the school library.
body.zh: 我们可以从学校图书馆借书。

body.en: My boss thanked everyone for their hard work.
body.zh: 我的老板感谢大家的辛勤工作。

body.en: The shop's boss speaks kindly to every worker.
body.zh: 这家店的老板对每位员工都很和气。

body.en: Both my parents came to watch our school play.
body.zh: 我的父母都来观看了学校演出。

body.en: We both enjoy walking our dog after dinner.
body.zh: 我们俩都喜欢晚饭后遛狗。

body.en: Please fill this bottle with clean drinking water.
body.zh: 请给这个瓶子装上干净的饮用水。

body.en: I left my water bottle on the bus.
body.zh: 我把水瓶落在公交车上了。

body.en: My pencil rolled to the bottom of the schoolbag.
body.zh: 我的铅笔滚到了书包底部。

body.en: We sat at the bottom of the hill to eat our snacks.
body.zh: 我们坐在山脚下吃零食。

body.en: at the bottom of the hill
I ate a bowl of noodles after soccer practice.
body.zh: 足球训练后，我吃了一碗面条。

body.en: Put the clean apples in that large bowl.
body.zh: 把洗干净的苹果放进那个大碗里。

body.en: The kitten climbed into an empty cardboard box.
body.zh: 小猫爬进了一个空纸箱。

body.en: We packed the old toys in a large box.
body.zh: 我们把旧玩具装进了一个大箱子。

body.en: The boy next door lent me his football.
body.zh: 隔壁男孩把足球借给了我。

body.en: A young boy helped us find the library.
body.zh: 一位小男孩帮我们找到了图书馆。

body.en: The brain helps us think, learn, and remember.
body.zh: 大脑帮助我们思考、学习和记忆。

body.en: We studied a picture of the human brain.
body.zh: 我们研究了一张人脑图片。

body.en: The brave child told the truth despite feeling afraid.
body.zh: 那个勇敢的孩子虽害怕，还是说了实话。

body.en: It was brave of you to try again.
body.zh: 你勇于再次尝试，真勇敢。

body.en: We bought fresh bread from the corner shop.
body.zh: 我们从街角商店买了新鲜面包。

body.en: Would you like another slice of bread?
We took a short break after cleaning the classroom together.
body.zh: 一起打扫完教室后，我们休息了一小会儿。

body.en: Be careful not to break the glass when you wash it.
body.zh: 洗杯子时小心别把玻璃杯打碎。

body.en: I usually have eggs and milk for breakfast.
body.zh: 我早餐通常吃鸡蛋、喝牛奶。

body.en: We ate breakfast before leaving for the station.
body.zh: 我们吃完早餐才出发去车站。

body.en: After running around the playground, I stopped to catch my breath.
body.zh: 绕操场跑完后，我停下来喘口气。

body.en: Take a deep breath before you blow out the candles.
body.zh: 吹蜡烛前先深吸一口气。

body.en: A wooden bridge connects the two villages.
body.zh: 一座木桥连接着这两个村庄。

body.en: We stood on the bridge and watched the boats.
The bright sunlight made the room feel warm.
body.zh: 明亮的阳光让房间显得温暖。

body.en: She wore a bright yellow coat to school.
body.zh: 她穿了一件鲜黄色外套去上学。

body.en: Please bring your notebook to English class tomorrow.
body.zh: 请明天把笔记本带到英语课上。

body.en: The funny story brought smiles to everyone's faces.
body.zh: 这个有趣的故事让每个人都露出了笑容。

body.en: My older brother helps me with difficult maths problems.
body.zh: 哥哥帮助我解答数学难题。

body.en: I shared my last orange with my brother.
body.zh: 我和弟弟分了最后一个橙子。

body.en: The leaves turned brown as winter came closer.
body.zh: 冬天临近时，树叶变成了褐色。

body.en: She chose a brown bag for the school trip.
body.zh: 她为学校旅行选了一个棕色包。

body.en: Remember to brush your teeth before going to bed.
I used a small brush to paint the flowers.
body.zh: 我用小画笔画了那些花。

body.en: We planned a budget for our class picnic.
body.zh: 我们为班级野餐制订了预算。

body.en: The new books cost less than our budget.
body.zh: 新书的花费低于我们的预算。

body.en: Our class will build a small birdhouse from old wooden boxes.
body.zh: 我们班会用旧木盒做一个小鸟屋。

body.en: They built a snowman together in the garden yesterday.
body.zh: 昨天他们一起在花园里堆了一个雪人。

body.en: The tallest building in our town has a small library on the ground floor.
body.zh: 我们镇最高的建筑一楼有一间小图书馆。

body.en: Workers are building a new playground beside the school.
body.zh: 工人们正在学校旁边建一个新操场。

body.en: Nobody has the right to bully another student.
body.zh: 任何人都无权欺负其他学生。

body.en: The teacher stopped a bully from taking my bag.
body.zh: 老师阻止了一个欺凌者抢走我的包。

body.en: The toast may burn if you leave it in the toaster too long.
body.zh: 吐司在烤面包机里放太久可能会烤焦。

body.en: Be careful with the hot pan, or you could burn your hand.
body.zh: 小心热锅，否则你可能会烫伤手。

body.en: We took the bus to the science museum.
body.zh: 我们坐公交车去了科学博物馆。

body.en: The last bus leaves at ten this evening.
body.zh: 今晚末班公交车十点发车。

body.en: My aunt runs a small business selling handmade bags.
body.zh: 我姑姑经营一家卖手工包的小生意。

body.en: Cleaning the classroom is everyone's business after the club meeting.
body.zh: 社团活动后打扫教室是大家的责任。

body.en: My parents are busy preparing dinner for our guests.
body.zh: 父母正忙着为客人准备晚饭。

body.en: This road is very busy during the morning.
body.zh: 这条路早晨交通很繁忙。

body.en: I wanted to play outside, but it started to rain.
body.zh: 我想去外面玩，但是天开始下雨了。

body.en: Everyone but Tom finished the puzzle before lunch.
body.zh: 除了汤姆，大家都在午饭前完成了拼图。

body.en: She spread a little butter on the warm bread.
body.zh: 她在热面包上涂了一点黄油。

body.en: We need some butter to make these biscuits.
body.zh: 做这些饼干需要一些黄油。

body.en: A butterfly landed on the flower beside me.
body.zh: 一只蝴蝶落在我身旁的花上。

body.en: The children watched a butterfly open its wings.
body.zh: 孩子们看着一只蝴蝶张开翅膀。

body.en: I want to buy a notebook after school.
body.zh: 我想放学后买一本笔记本。

body.en: We buy fresh vegetables at the market every weekend.
body.zh: 我们每周末在市场买新鲜蔬菜。

body.en: I left my schoolbag by the classroom door.
body.zh: 我把书包放在教室门边。

body.en: The story was written by a young student.
body.zh: 这个故事是一位年轻学生写的。

body.en: Dad added cabbage to the soup for dinner.
body.zh: 爸爸给晚饭的汤加了卷心菜。

body.en: We grew a large cabbage in our school garden.
body.zh: 我们在学校菜园里种出了一棵大卷心菜。

body.en: My sister made a cake for my birthday.
body.zh: 姐姐为我的生日做了一个蛋糕。

body.en: Please cut the cake into eight equal pieces.
body.zh: 请把蛋糕切成大小相等的八块。

body.en: I marked the school trip on our calendar.
body.zh: 我在日历上标出了学校旅行的日期。

body.en: The calendar hangs beside the kitchen window.
body.zh: 日历挂在厨房窗户旁边。

body.en: Please call me when you reach the station.
body.zh: 到车站后，请给我打电话。

body.en: I missed a call from my cousin this morning.
body.zh: 今天早上我漏接了表亲的电话。

body.en: Try to stay calm before your first performance.
body.zh: 第一次演出前，尽量保持镇定。

body.en: The sea looked calm under the morning sun.
body.zh: 晨光下的海面看起来很平静。

body.en: I used my camera to photograph the old bridge.
body.zh: 我用相机拍了那座古桥。

body.en: Please hold the camera steady when taking a picture.
We will camp near the lake this weekend.
body.zh: 这个周末我们将在湖边露营。

body.en: Our summer camp offers music and sports activities.
body.zh: 我们的夏令营提供音乐和体育活动。

body.en: Can you help me find my blue notebook?
body.zh: 你能帮我找找我的蓝色笔记本吗？

body.en: We can make a paper boat and float it in the tub.
body.zh: 我们可以折一只纸船，让它在浴缸里漂。

body.en: Heavy rain forced us to cancel the picnic.
body.zh: 大雨迫使我们取消了野餐。

body.en: Please cancel my booking for tomorrow's boat trip.
body.zh: 请取消我预订的明天的游船行程。

body.en: Our class raised money for a cancer charity.
body.zh: 我们班为一家癌症慈善机构筹了款。

body.en: The hospital opened a new centre for cancer research.
body.zh: 医院开设了一个新的癌症研究中心。

body.en: Dad lit a candle when the lights went out.
body.zh: 停电时，爸爸点了一支蜡烛。

body.en: Please blow out the candle before leaving the room.
body.zh: 离开房间前，请吹灭蜡烛。

body.en: The child chose one piece of candy after lunch.
body.zh: 午饭后，孩子选了一颗糖。

body.en: There is a small candy shop beside the cinema.
body.zh: 电影院旁边有一家小糖果店。

body.en: I wear a cap when playing outside in summer.
body.zh: 夏天在外面玩时，我会戴帽子。

body.en: Please put the cap back on the bottle.
Beijing is the capital of our country.
Begin each sentence with a capital letter.
body.zh: 每个句子的开头要用大写字母。

body.en: We drove to the beach in our car on Saturday morning.
body.zh: 星期六早上我们开车去了海边。

body.en: My father parks the car beside our apartment every evening.
body.zh: 我爸爸每天晚上把车停在公寓旁边。

body.en: She sent me a card for my birthday.
body.zh: 她给我寄了一张生日卡片。

body.en: Please show your library card when borrowing books.
My grandparents take good care of their garden every weekend.
body.zh: 我的祖父母每个周末都认真照料花园。

body.en: I care about keeping the playground clean for everyone.
body.zh: 我很在意为大家保持操场整洁。

body.en: Be careful when carrying the hot soup.
A careful reader notices small details in a story.
body.zh: 细心的读者会注意到故事中的小细节。

body.en: A careless mistake cost our team a point.
body.zh: 一个粗心的失误让我们队丢了一分。

body.en: It was careless of me to leave the door open.
She cut a carrot into small pieces.
body.zh: 她把一根胡萝卜切成了小块。

body.en: We added carrot to the soup for lunch.
body.zh: 我们在午饭的汤里加了胡萝卜。

body.en: I carry my water bottle in my schoolbag every day.
body.zh: 我每天把水瓶装在书包里。

body.en: The bus can carry forty students to the museum.
body.zh: 这辆公交车能载四十名学生去博物馆。

body.en: My little sister enjoys watching this funny cartoon.
body.zh: 妹妹喜欢看这部有趣的动画片。

body.en: He drew a cartoon for the school newspaper.
body.zh: 他为校报画了一幅漫画。

body.en: I keep my glasses in a hard case.
body.zh: 我把眼镜放在一个硬质眼镜盒里。

body.en: Take a coat in case the weather turns cold.
body.zh: 带上外套，以防天气变冷。

body.en: Can I pay for these books in cash?
body.zh: 买这些书可以付现金吗？

body.en: Dad keeps a little cash in his wallet.
body.zh: 爸爸的钱包里放着少量现金。

body.en: The cat curled up beside the warm window.
Our cat likes to hide under my bed.
body.zh: 我家的猫喜欢躲在床下。

body.en: We ran to catch the last bus home.
body.zh: 我们跑着去赶回家的末班公交车。

body.en: Can you catch the ball with one hand?
body.zh: 你能用一只手接住球吗？

body.en: Heavy rain caused a small flood in the park yesterday.
body.zh: 昨天的大雨导致公园里发生了小洪水。

body.en: The doctor explained the cause of my sore throat.
body.zh: 医生解释了我喉咙痛的原因。

body.en: We celebrated my sister's birthday with cake and fruit.
body.zh: 我们用蛋糕和水果庆祝姐姐的生日。

body.en: Our class will celebrate the end of exams with a picnic.
body.zh: 我们班将用野餐庆祝考试结束。

body.en: This pencil costs just one cent at the sale.
body.zh: 这支铅笔促销时只卖一美分。

body.en: I found a one-cent coin under the table.
body.zh: 我在桌下找到了一枚一美分硬币。

body.en: The new library is in a central part of our town.
body.zh: 新图书馆在我们镇的中心地带。

body.en: Teamwork is central to our class project about nature.
body.zh: 团队合作对我们关于自然的班级项目很重要。

body.en: The town centre has a library and a small park.
body.zh: 镇中心有一座图书馆和一个小公园。

body.en: We met at the centre of the playground.
This old bridge was built more than a century ago.
body.zh: 这座古桥是一百多年前建成的。

body.en: People in the next century may travel in very different ways.
body.zh: 下个世纪的人们出行方式可能会大不相同。

body.en: I am certain that Dad put the keys beside the front door.
body.zh: 我确定爸爸把钥匙放在前门旁边了。

body.en: A certain boy in our class always brings two notebooks.
body.zh: 我们班有个男孩总是带两本笔记本。

body.en: Please pull up a chair and join us.
body.zh: 请搬把椅子过来，加入我们吧。

body.en: The wooden chair stands beside my bedroom window.
body.zh: 木椅摆在我的卧室窗旁。

body.en: The teacher used white chalk to draw a circle.
body.zh: 老师用白粉笔画了一个圆。

body.en: Please bring a piece of chalk to the classroom.
body.zh: 请拿一支粉笔到教室来。

body.en: Learning to swim was a challenge for me.
body.zh: 学习游泳对我来说是个挑战。

body.en: We accepted the challenge of cleaning the whole garden.
body.zh: 我们接受了清理整个花园的挑战。

body.en: The champion thanked her coach after the final race.
body.zh: 决赛结束后，冠军感谢了她的教练。

body.en: He hopes to become a chess champion one day.
body.zh: 他希望有一天成为国际象棋冠军。

body.en: I had a chance to talk with the new student at lunch.
body.zh: 午饭时，我有机会和新同学交谈。

body.en: There is a good chance of rain, so take an umbrella.
body.zh: 很可能会下雨，所以带把伞吧。

body.en: Please change your wet socks before dinner.
Mum gave me change for the bus ride.
body.zh: 妈妈给了我坐公交车的零钱。

body.en: My favourite character in the story is a brave girl.
body.zh: 故事中我最喜欢的角色是一个勇敢的女孩。

body.en: Please write each Chinese character inside a square.
body.zh: 请把每个汉字写在方格内。

body.en: Curiosity is a characteristic that helps students learn new things.
body.zh: 好奇心是一种帮助学生学习新事物的特征。

body.en: A panda's black and white fur is a familiar characteristic.
body.zh: 熊猫黑白相间的毛色是一个熟悉的特征。

body.en: We sold old books to raise money for charity.
body.zh: 我们卖旧书为慈善事业筹款。

body.en: The charity provides meals for people who need help.
body.zh: 这家慈善机构给需要帮助的人提供餐食。

body.en: We often chat about books during the lunch break.
I had a friendly chat with our new neighbour.
body.zh: 我和新邻居友好地聊了一会儿。

body.en: We found a cheap lunch near the train station.
body.zh: 我们在火车站附近找到了便宜的午餐。

body.en: This bag was cheap, but it is strong enough for school.
body.zh: 这个包很便宜，但结实耐用，适合上学用。

body.en: It is wrong to cheat in a school exam.
Please play fairly and do not cheat.
Please check your answers before handing in the paper.
I need to check the train times online.
body.zh: 我需要上网查一下火车时刻。

body.en: We went to cheer for our school's basketball team.
body.zh: 我们去为学校篮球队加油。

body.en: Her friends tried to cheer her up after the game.
body.zh: 比赛后，她的朋友努力让她振作起来。

body.en: I put cheese and tomato in my sandwich.
body.zh: 我在三明治里放了奶酪和番茄。

body.en: Would you like some cheese with your bread?
body.zh: 你想在面包里加些奶酪吗？

body.en: Our chemistry teacher explained why iron can rust.
body.zh: 化学老师解释了铁为什么会生锈。

body.en: We did a simple experiment in chemistry class.
body.zh: 我们在化学课上做了一个简单实验。

body.en: My grandfather taught me how to play chess.
We played a game of chess after dinner.
body.zh: 晚饭后，我们下了一盘国际象棋。

body.en: A chicken ran across the farmyard this morning.
body.zh: 今天早晨，一只鸡跑过了农场院子。

body.en: We had chicken and rice for lunch.
body.zh: 我们午餐吃了鸡肉和米饭。

body.en: The child is drawing a picture of her dog.
body.zh: 这个孩子正在画她的小狗。

body.en: Many children play in the park after school.
body.zh: 许多孩子放学后在公园玩。

body.en: A tiny chip inside the card stores information.
body.zh: 卡片内的一枚微小芯片储存着信息。

body.en: There is a small chip in this cup.
body.zh: 这个杯子上有一个小缺口。

body.en: My sister made hot chocolate on a cold evening.
body.zh: 一个寒冷的晚上，姐姐做了热巧克力。

body.en: I gave Grandma a small box of chocolates.
body.zh: 我送给奶奶一小盒巧克力。

body.en: You have a choice between walking home and taking the bus.
body.zh: 你可以选择步行回家或乘公交车。

body.en: This small shop has a wide choice of fresh fruit.
body.zh: 这家小店有很多新鲜水果可供选择。

body.en: You can choose a book to read during the train ride.
body.zh: 坐火车时，你可以选一本书来读。

body.en: Mia chose the blue shoes because they were more comfortable.
body.zh: 米娅选了蓝色的鞋子，因为它们更舒服。

body.en: I use chopsticks to eat noodles at home.
Our guest learned to use chopsticks during dinner.
body.zh: 客人在吃晚饭时学会了用筷子。

body.en: Washing dishes is my usual chore after dinner.
body.zh: 晚饭后洗碗是我平时负责的家务。

body.en: Everyone in our family does at least one chore.
body.zh: 我们家每个人至少做一项家务。

body.en: We went to the cinema on Saturday evening.
body.zh: 我们周六晚上去了电影院。

body.en: The new cinema is opposite the railway station.
body.zh: 新电影院在火车站对面。

body.en: Draw a large circle on the paper and color it blue.
body.zh: 在纸上画一个大圆圈，并把它涂成蓝色。

body.en: The birds circled above the lake while we ate lunch.
body.zh: 我们吃午饭时，鸟儿在湖上空盘旋。

body.en: Every citizen can help keep our city clean.
body.zh: 每位市民都能帮助保持城市整洁。

body.en: She became a citizen of that country last year.
body.zh: 她去年成为了那个国家的公民。

body.en: My uncle lives in a busy city with many buses and parks.
body.zh: 我叔叔住在一座有许多公交车和公园的繁忙城市。

body.en: We visited the city museum during our family trip.
body.zh: 家庭旅行时，我们参观了市立博物馆。

body.en: Our class planted trees behind the sports hall.
body.zh: 我们班在体育馆后面种了树。

body.en: Please arrive before the English class begins.
body.zh: 请在英语课开始前到达。

body.en: We read a classic story about a wooden boy.
body.zh: 我们读了一个关于木偶男孩的经典故事。

body.en: This film is a classic that many families enjoy.
body.zh: 这部电影是一部许多家庭喜爱的经典作品。

body.en: My classmate lent me a ruler during the lesson.
body.zh: 上课时，我的同班同学借给我一把尺子。

body.en: I worked with a classmate on our science project.
body.zh: 我和一位同班同学一起做了科学项目。

body.en: We keep our classroom clean and tidy.
body.zh: 我们让教室保持干净整洁。

body.en: The classroom windows face the school garden.
body.zh: 教室的窗户朝着学校花园。

body.en: Please clean your shoes before coming inside.
body.zh: 进屋前，请把鞋子弄干净。

body.en: The towels are clean and ready to use.
body.zh: 这些毛巾很干净，可以使用。

body.en: The teacher gave clear directions to the science room.
body.zh: 老师清楚地说明了去科学教室的路线。

body.en: We cleared the table before putting our books on it.
body.zh: 我们先清理了桌子，再把书放上去。

body.en: That was a clever way to solve the problem.
body.zh: 那是解决问题的一个巧妙办法。

body.en: The clever dog learned to open the gate.
body.zh: 那只聪明的狗学会了开门。

body.en: Please click on the picture to see more details.
body.zh: 请点击图片，查看更多细节。

body.en: I heard a click as the door closed.
body.zh: 门关上时，我听见咔哒一声。

body.en: This island has a warm and wet climate.
body.zh: 这个岛屿的气候温暖湿润。

body.en: We learned how climate affects the plants around us.
body.zh: 我们学习了气候如何影响周围的植物。

body.en: We climbed the hill slowly and rested beneath a tree.
body.zh: 我们慢慢爬上山，在树下休息。

body.en: The cat can climb onto the low wall by itself.
body.zh: 这只猫能自己爬上矮墙。

body.en: The clock above the door says half past seven.
body.zh: 门上方的钟显示七点半。

body.en: I set the alarm clock before going to bed.
Please close the window before you leave.
We live close to the school library.
body.zh: 我们住得离学校图书馆很近。

body.en: I put my wet clothes beside the heater.
body.zh: 我把湿衣服放在暖气旁。

body.en: She packed warm clothes for the mountain trip.
body.zh: 她为山区旅行带了保暖的衣服。

body.en: A dark cloud covered the sun during our picnic.
body.zh: 野餐时，一片乌云遮住了太阳。

body.en: We watched white clouds move slowly across the blue sky.
body.zh: 我们看着白云缓缓飘过蓝天。

body.en: The sky was cloudy when we left home.
We still enjoyed our picnic on the cloudy day.
body.zh: 虽然那天多云，我们的野餐仍很愉快。

body.en: I joined the school art club to learn how to draw animals.
body.zh: 我加入了学校美术社，学习怎样画动物。

body.en: Our book club meets in the library every Friday afternoon.
body.zh: 我们的读书俱乐部每周五下午在图书馆见面。

body.en: Our coach showed us how to pass the ball.
We travelled to the museum by coach.
body.zh: 我们乘长途客车去了博物馆。

body.en: We spent our summer holiday on the coast.
body.zh: 我们在海边度过了暑假。

body.en: The boat stayed close to the rocky coast.
body.zh: 船一直靠近多岩石的海岸。

body.en: Take a warm coat because the evening may be cold.
body.zh: 带上保暖外套，因为晚上可能冷。

body.en: She hung her coat behind the classroom door.
body.zh: 她把外套挂在教室门后。

body.en: Dad drinks a cup of coffee after breakfast.
body.zh: 爸爸早餐后喝一杯咖啡。

body.en: The smell of coffee filled the small shop.
body.zh: 咖啡的香气弥漫着小店。

body.en: I found a coin under the sofa.
body.zh: 我在沙发底下找到了一枚硬币。

body.en: Grandpa showed us an old coin from his collection.
body.zh: 爷爷给我们看了一枚他收藏的古币。

body.en: The water felt cold when I touched it.
body.zh: 我碰到水时，觉得水很冷。

body.en: She stayed home because she had a cold.
We collect empty bottles for recycling at school.
body.zh: 我们在学校收集空瓶子用于回收。

body.en: Please collect your things before leaving the classroom.
body.zh: 离开教室前，请收好自己的物品。

body.en: My sister hopes to study art at college one day.
body.zh: 我姐姐希望有一天能在大学学习艺术。

body.en: The college has a library where students can study quietly.
body.zh: 这所学院有一间供学生安静学习的图书馆。

body.en: What colour would you like for your bedroom walls?
body.zh: 你的卧室墙壁想要什么颜色？

body.en: Please colour the small circle blue and the square red.
body.zh: 请把小圆涂成蓝色，把方块涂成红色。

body.en: My cousin will come to our house for lunch on Sunday.
body.zh: 我表姐星期天会来我们家吃午饭。

body.en: The school bus came ten minutes late because of the rain.
body.zh: 校车因为下雨晚了十分钟才到。

body.en: These shoes are comfortable enough for a long walk.
body.zh: 这双鞋很舒适，适合长途步行。

body.en: The chair looked old but felt very comfortable.
body.zh: 椅子看着旧，坐着却很舒服。

body.en: It is common for students to bring water bottles to school.
body.zh: 学生带水瓶上学很常见。

body.en: A common goal helped our team work well together.
body.zh: 共同的目标帮助我们团队合作得很好。

body.en: We communicate with our cousins through video calls.
body.zh: 我们通过视频通话与表亲们交流。

body.en: Pictures can help us communicate ideas without words.
body.zh: 图片能帮助我们不用语言传达想法。

body.en: People in our community clean the park together each month.
body.zh: 我们社区的人每月一起打扫公园。

body.en: The community center offers free art classes for children.
body.zh: 社区中心为孩子们提供免费的美术课。

body.en: My aunt works for a small travel company.
body.zh: 我阿姨在一家小旅行公司工作。

body.en: I enjoy your company on these long walks.
body.zh: 长途散步时，有你陪伴我很开心。

body.en: Please compare your answer with the example below.
body.zh: 请将你的答案与下方的示例比较。

body.en: We compare prices before buying a new computer.
body.zh: 我们买新电脑前会比较价格。

body.en: Our school will compete in a swimming race next Saturday.
body.zh: 我们学校下周六将参加游泳比赛。

body.en: The two teams competed for the final place in the tournament.
body.zh: 两支队伍争夺锦标赛的最后一个名额。

body.en: Mia completed her science project before the school fair.
body.zh: 米娅在学校展览会前完成了科学项目。

body.en: The story is not complete because its final page is missing.
body.zh: 这个故事不完整，因为最后一页不见了。

body.en: We use a computer to make our class newspaper.
Please turn off the computer after finishing your work.
body.zh: 完成工作后，请关掉电脑。

body.en: We found seats near the front before the concert began.
body.zh: 音乐会开始前，我们找到了靠前的座位。

body.en: My sister will play the violin at tonight's concert.
body.zh: 我姐姐将在今晚的音乐会上拉小提琴。

body.en: The road was in good condition after workers repaired it.
body.zh: 工人修好后，这条路的状况很好。

body.en: You can borrow my bike on one condition: wear a helmet.
body.zh: 你可以借我的自行车，但有一个条件：戴好头盔。

body.en: With practice, I gained confidence before the school speech contest.
body.zh: 经过练习，我在学校演讲比赛前增强了信心。

body.en: My coach gave me confidence to try the harder jump.
body.zh: 教练让我有信心尝试难度更高的跳跃。

body.en: Congratulations on finishing your first school play, Anna!
body.zh: 安娜，祝贺你完成了第一次学校话剧演出！

body.en: Dad sent his congratulations when I won the drawing prize.
body.zh: 我获得绘画奖时，爸爸向我表示祝贺。

body.en: This bridge connects our village to the town across the river.
body.zh: 这座桥把我们的村庄和河对岸的城镇连接起来。

body.en: Please connect the computer to the classroom screen.
body.zh: 请把电脑连接到教室的屏幕上。

body.en: We should consider taking the earlier bus to the museum.
body.zh: 我们应该考虑乘早一点的公交车去博物馆。

body.en: Please consider my idea before choosing a team name.
body.zh: 选队名之前，请考虑一下我的想法。

body.en: After a short break, our class continued the game in the gym.
body.zh: 短暂休息后，我们班在体育馆继续比赛。

body.en: The rain continued through the night, so the field was wet.
body.zh: 雨下了一整夜，所以操场湿了。

body.en: The teacher asked us to control our voices in the library.
body.zh: 老师要求我们在图书馆里控制音量。

body.en: This button controls the lights in the classroom.
body.zh: 这个按钮控制教室里的灯。

body.en: The bus stop outside our building is very convenient.
body.zh: 楼外就有公交站，对我们来说很方便。

body.en: Is Saturday morning a convenient time for our meeting?
body.zh: 星期六上午见面方便吗？

body.en: We had a long conversation about our plans for summer.
body.zh: 我们就暑假计划聊了很久。

body.en: Please put your phone away during our conversation.
body.zh: 我们交谈时，请把手机收起来。

body.en: I can cook noodles, but I need help with the soup.
body.zh: 我会煮面条，但做汤需要帮忙。

body.en: The cook added fresh tomatoes to our lunch.
body.zh: 厨师在我们的午餐里加了新鲜番茄。

body.en: I put a cookie beside Grandpa's cup of tea.
body.zh: 我在爷爷的茶杯旁放了一块饼干。

body.en: These cookies need five more minutes in the oven.
body.zh: 这些饼干还需要在烤箱里烤五分钟。

body.en: The kitchen feels cool with both windows open.
body.zh: 两扇窗户都开着，厨房里很凉爽。

body.en: Let the bread cool before you cut it.
We need to cooperate to finish this poster before lunch.
body.zh: 我们需要合作，在午饭前完成这张海报。

body.en: The two classes will cooperate on a school garden project.
body.zh: 这两个班将合作开展校园花园项目。

body.en: Please copy the new words into your notebook after class.
body.zh: 下课后请把生词抄到笔记本里。

body.en: I made a copy of the photo for my grandmother.
body.zh: 我给奶奶复印了一张照片。

body.en: Dad put some sweet corn into the soup.
body.zh: 爸爸在汤里加了一些甜玉米。

body.en: We watched the farmer pick corn in the field.
body.zh: 我们看着农民在田里摘玉米。

body.en: There is a small bookshop on the corner.
The cat is sleeping in the corner of my room.
body.zh: 猫正睡在我房间的角落里。

body.en: Please check that your name is correct on the school form.
body.zh: 请检查学校表格上的姓名是否正确。

body.en: Lily corrected the spelling mistake before handing in her homework.
body.zh: 莉莉交作业前改正了拼写错误。

body.en: The blue notebook costs five yuan at the shop near school.
body.zh: 学校附近商店里的蓝色笔记本五元钱。

body.en: This mistake cost our team a chance to play in the final.
body.zh: 这个失误让我们队失去了参加决赛的机会。

body.en: This cotton shirt feels soft against my skin.
body.zh: 这件棉衬衫贴着皮肤很柔软。

body.en: We saw fields of cotton from the train window.
body.zh: 我们从火车窗口看到了成片的棉田。

body.en: Please cover your mouth when you cough.
Her cough kept her awake for part of the night.
body.zh: 她咳嗽得夜里有一阵没睡着。

body.en: Could you show me how to get to the school library?
body.zh: 你能告诉我怎么去学校图书馆吗？

body.en: At age six, my brother could already ride a bike.
body.zh: 我弟弟六岁时就已经会骑自行车了。

body.en: Please count the apples before we put them in the basket.
body.zh: 把苹果放进篮子前，请数一数。

body.en: Our teacher counts everyone before the class leaves the museum.
body.zh: 全班离开博物馆前，老师会清点人数。

body.en: Which country would you like to visit one day?
body.zh: 你将来想去哪个国家旅行？

body.en: My grandparents live in the country, far from busy roads.
body.zh: 我的祖父母住在乡下，远离繁忙的道路。

body.en: We spent the weekend walking through the quiet countryside.
body.zh: 我们周末在宁静的乡间散步。

body.en: The bus took us from the city into the countryside.
body.zh: 公交车把我们从城市带到了乡下。

body.en: I need a couple of minutes to finish my homework.
body.zh: 我还需要几分钟完成作业。

body.en: The couple took their little dog for a walk after dinner.
body.zh: 这对夫妻晚饭后带着小狗去散步。

body.en: It took courage to tell the teacher about my mistake.
body.zh: 把自己的错误告诉老师需要勇气。

body.en: Her friend's kind words gave her courage to try again.
body.zh: 朋友温暖的话语给了她再次尝试的勇气。

body.en: Our English course includes songs, stories, and short talks.
body.zh: 我们的英语课程包括歌曲、故事和简短演讲。

body.en: The runners followed a safe course around the school field.
body.zh: 跑步者沿着校园操场周围的安全路线前进。

body.en: My cousin brought a board game for us to play.
body.zh: 我的表亲带来一款桌游，让我们一起玩。

body.en: I share a room with my cousin during the holiday.
body.zh: 假期里，我和表亲住一个房间。

body.en: Please cover the soup so it stays warm until dinner.
body.zh: 请把汤盖好，这样晚饭时还是热的。

body.en: This map covers all the walking paths in the park.
body.zh: 这张地图包括公园里的所有步行路线。

body.en: The cow stood quietly while the farmer filled its water bowl.
body.zh: 农民给水盆加水时，那头母牛安静地站着。

body.en: We counted six cows eating grass beside the fence.
body.zh: 我们数到六头牛在围栏边吃草。

body.en: My cousin is crazy about basketball and practices every afternoon.
body.zh: 我表哥特别喜欢篮球，每天下午都练习。

body.en: That was a crazy idea, but our science project worked.
body.zh: 那主意听起来很疯狂，不过我们的科学项目成功了。

body.en: We used paper and glue to create a birthday card.
body.zh: 我们用纸和胶水做了一张生日贺卡。

body.en: The art club will create a mural for the school hall.
body.zh: 美术社团将为学校大厅创作一幅壁画。

body.en: Our creative group made a paper city for the science fair.
body.zh: 我们富有创意的小组为科学展做了一座纸城。

body.en: She found a creative way to remember the new English words.
body.zh: 她想出了一个有创意的方法来记住英语生词。

body.en: Please look both ways before you cross the street.
body.zh: 过马路前请先向两边看。

body.en: We drew a red cross on the map to mark the school.
body.zh: 我们在地图上画了一个红色十字标出学校。

body.en: The bus was so crowded that we waited for the next one.
body.zh: 公交车太挤了，我们便等下一班。

body.en: We left the crowded market and found a quiet cafe.
body.zh: 我们离开拥挤的市场，找到一家安静的咖啡馆。

body.en: The baby began to cry when the door slammed.
body.zh: 门砰地关上时，宝宝哭了起来。

body.en: We heard a cry for help near the river.
body.zh: 我们听见河边传来呼救声。

body.en: Please wash this cucumber before we make the salad.
body.zh: 做沙拉前，请把这根黄瓜洗干净。

body.en: Grandma grows cucumber plants beside the garden wall.
body.zh: 奶奶在花园墙边种黄瓜。

body.en: Our class learned about Chinese culture during the school festival.
body.zh: 在学校的节庆活动中，我们班了解了中国文化。

body.en: We visited a museum to learn about the culture of ancient China.
body.zh: 我们参观了博物馆，了解古代中国文化。

body.en: I warmed my hands around a cup of tea.
body.zh: 我双手捧着一杯茶取暖。

body.en: Our team lifted the cup after the final match.
body.zh: 决赛结束后，我们队举起了奖杯。

body.en: The curious child asked how the old clock worked.
body.zh: 那个好奇的孩子问旧钟是怎样运转的。

body.en: I am curious about the birds outside our window.
body.zh: 我对窗外那些鸟很好奇。

body.en: The customer asked for a larger pair of shoes.
body.zh: 那位顾客想要一双更大尺码的鞋。

body.en: Every customer gets a paper bag for their books.
body.zh: 每位顾客都会得到一个装书的纸袋。

body.en: Please cut the apple into four equal pieces.
body.zh: 请把苹果切成大小相等的四块。

body.en: I used scissors to cut a star out of paper.
body.zh: 我用剪刀从纸上剪出一颗星星。

body.en: A cute little dog followed us to the gate.
body.zh: 一只可爱的小狗跟着我们走到门口。

body.en: Your drawing of the sleeping rabbit looks very cute.
body.zh: 你画的那只熟睡的兔子看起来很可爱。

body.en: I write a short note in my daily journal before bed.
body.zh: 我睡前在日记里写一则简短的日常记录。

body.en: Our school newspaper comes out daily during the festival week.
body.zh: 节庆周期间，我们的校报每天出版。

body.en: We learned a simple dance for the school show.
body.zh: 我们为学校演出学了一支简单的舞。

body.en: My grandparents like to dance together after dinner.
body.zh: 我的祖父母喜欢晚饭后一起跳舞。

body.en: The sign warns visitors about danger near the deep river.
body.zh: 标牌提醒游客，深河附近有危险。

body.en: Our teacher explained the danger of running across a busy road.
body.zh: 老师讲解了横穿繁忙马路的危险。

body.en: It is dangerous to swim in the river after heavy rain.
body.zh: 大雨后在河里游泳很危险。

body.en: The road is dangerous when cars drive too fast.
body.zh: 汽车开得太快时，这条路很危险。

body.en: The room was dark, so I turned on the lamp.
body.zh: 房间里很暗，我便打开了灯。

body.en: She chose a dark blue coat for winter.
body.zh: 她选了一件深蓝色外套过冬。

body.en: Please write today's date at the top of your homework.
body.zh: 请在作业顶部写上今天的日期。

body.en: Our class picnic is on the fifteenth, so let's check the date.
body.zh: 班级野餐定在十五号，我们来确认一下日期。

body.en: Their daughter helped her parents make dinner after school.
body.zh: 他们的女儿放学后帮父母做晚饭。

body.en: My aunt's daughter is learning to play the piano.
body.zh: 我阿姨的女儿正在学弹钢琴。

body.en: We rode our bikes to the park on a sunny day.
body.zh: 晴朗的一天，我们骑自行车去了公园。

body.en: I do my homework after school every day.
The battery is dead, so my flashlight will not turn on.
body.zh: 电池没电了，所以我的手电筒打不开。

body.en: The garden looked dead after the cold winter, but new leaves appeared in spring.
body.zh: 寒冷的冬天过后，花园看起来没有生气，但春天长出了新叶。

body.en: Our deaf classmate taught us to say hello in sign language.
body.zh: 我们的聋人同学教我们用手语打招呼。

body.en: The museum has a guide for deaf visitors.
body.zh: 博物馆为聋人游客配有导览员。

body.en: We made a deal to take turns choosing the movie.
Dad deals with the dishes while I dry them after dinner.
body.zh: 晚饭后爸爸洗碗，我负责擦干。

body.en: My dear friend sent me a postcard from the sea.
body.zh: 我亲爱的朋友从海边给我寄来一张明信片。

body.en: Oh dear, I left my umbrella on the bus!
body.zh: 哎呀，我把雨伞落在公交车上了！

body.en: The story tells of the death of a brave old dog.
body.zh: 这个故事讲述了一只勇敢的老狗的离世。

body.en: The family planted a tree in memory of Grandpa after his death.
body.zh: 爷爷去世后，全家种了一棵树来纪念他。

body.en: We decided to ride our bikes to the lake on Saturday.
body.zh: 我们决定星期六骑自行车去湖边。

body.en: Mum will decide what to cook after she checks the fridge.
body.zh: 妈妈看过冰箱后再决定做什么。

body.en: The river is too deep for us to cross here.
body.zh: 这里河水太深，我们无法涉水过去。

body.en: Take a deep breath before you start your song.
body.zh: 开始唱歌前，先深吸一口气。

body.en: The temperature fell to five degrees last night.
My aunt earned a degree in art last year.
body.zh: 我阿姨去年获得了艺术学位。

body.en: The bread smells delicious, but it is still too hot.
body.zh: 面包闻起来很香，不过还太烫。

body.en: We made a delicious meal with vegetables from our garden.
body.zh: 我们用自家菜园的蔬菜做了一顿美味的饭。

body.en: The dentist asked me to open my mouth wider.
body.zh: 牙医让我把嘴张大一点。

body.en: I have an appointment with the dentist after school.
body.zh: 我预约了放学后去看牙医。

body.en: Whether we play outside depends on the weather after school.
body.zh: 放学后我们能否在外面玩取决于天气。

body.en: You can depend on Mia to return your book tomorrow.
body.zh: 你可以放心，米娅明天会把书还给你。

body.en: depend on sb. to do sth.
Can you describe the puppy you saw near the bus stop?
body.zh: 你能描述一下在公交站附近看到的小狗吗？

body.en: Our teacher asked us to describe our favorite place in town.
body.zh: 老师让我们描述镇上最喜欢的地方。

body.en: We saw a picture of camels crossing a desert.
body.zh: 我们看到了一张骆驼穿越沙漠的图片。

body.en: The guide carried extra water for the desert trip.
body.zh: 向导为沙漠旅行多带了些水。

body.en: Our class will design a new sign for the library.
body.zh: 我们班将为图书馆设计一个新标牌。

body.en: I like the simple design on your notebook cover.
body.zh: 我喜欢你笔记本封面上简洁的图案。

body.en: My desk is beside the window in my bedroom.
Please clear your desk before we start painting.
body.zh: 开始画画前，请把桌面收拾干净。

body.en: Ben developed a good habit of reading before bedtime.
body.zh: 本养成了睡前阅读的好习惯。

body.en: The young plants develop quickly in warm, sunny weather.
body.zh: 这些幼苗在温暖晴朗的天气里生长很快。

body.en: Read the dialogue aloud with a partner.
body.zh: 和同伴一起大声朗读这段对话。

body.en: The film has very little dialogue but beautiful music.
body.zh: 这部电影对白很少，音乐却很优美。

body.en: I write in my diary before I go to sleep.
This old diary describes Grandma's first year at school.
body.zh: 这本旧日记记录了奶奶上学第一年的生活。

body.en: I used a dictionary to check the meaning of this word.
body.zh: 我用词典查了这个词的意思。

body.en: Our classroom dictionary has pictures beside some of the words.
body.zh: 我们教室里的词典给部分词语配了插图。

body.en: Some plants die if they do not get enough water.
body.zh: 有些植物如果得不到足够的水就会枯死。

body.en: The old battery died, so the toy stopped moving.
body.zh: 旧电池没电了，所以玩具不动了。

body.en: Fresh vegetables are part of our family's daily diet.
body.zh: 新鲜蔬菜是我们家日常饮食的一部分。

body.en: The book explains the diet of wild rabbits.
body.zh: 这本书介绍了野兔的食物。

body.en: Can you see the difference between these two pictures?
body.zh: 你能看出这两张图片的区别吗？

body.en: There is a big difference in size between the two boxes.
body.zh: 这两个盒子的大小差别很大。

body.en: My sister and I chose different books at the library.
body.zh: 我和姐姐在图书馆选了不同的书。

body.en: People in different places enjoy different kinds of food.
body.zh: 不同地方的人喜欢不同种类的食物。

body.en: This puzzle is difficult, so let's solve it together.
body.zh: 这道谜题很难，我们一起解吧。

body.en: It is difficult to hear you beside the busy road.
body.zh: 在这条繁忙的道路旁，我很难听清你说话。

body.en: We need to dig a hole for this young tree.
body.zh: 我们需要挖一个坑来种这棵小树。

body.en: The dog tried to dig under the garden fence.
body.zh: 那只狗试图从花园围栏下面挖过去。

body.en: The digital clock beside my bed shows seven thirty.
body.zh: 床边的电子钟显示七点半。

body.en: Our teacher keeps digital copies of the class photos.
body.zh: 老师保存着班级照片的电子版。

body.en: We put fresh flowers on the dining table.
body.zh: 我们在餐桌上摆了鲜花。

body.en: The school dining hall serves lunch at twelve.
body.zh: 学校食堂十二点供应午餐。

body.en: We invited our neighbors to dinner on Friday.
body.zh: 我们邀请邻居星期五来吃晚饭。

body.en: Please wash your hands because dinner is ready.
body.zh: 请洗手，晚饭已经准备好了。

body.en: The teacher gave us direct instructions for the science project.
body.zh: 老师给了我们关于科学项目的明确指示。

body.en: My aunt directs the school play every spring.
body.zh: 我姑姑每年春天都指导学校戏剧演出。

body.en: The director showed our class how a movie scene was filmed.
body.zh: 导演向我们班展示了电影场景是如何拍摄的。

body.en: My aunt is a director at a small company near our home.
body.zh: 我姑姑是家附近一家小公司的主管。

body.en: My shoes got dirty after I walked through the garden.
body.zh: 穿过花园后，我的鞋弄脏了。

body.en: Put the dirty towels in the basket by the door.
body.zh: 把脏毛巾放进门边的篮子里。

body.en: I hope the rain will not disappoint our picnic guests.
body.zh: 我希望这场雨不会让野餐的客人们失望。

body.en: The film did not disappoint us; we enjoyed every minute.
body.zh: 这部电影没让我们失望，我们从头到尾都很喜欢。

body.en: After the disaster, neighbors helped each other repair their homes.
body.zh: 灾难过后，邻居们互相帮助修缮家园。

body.en: Burnt rice turned my first cooking lesson into a disaster.
body.zh: 米饭烧焦了，让我的第一堂烹饪课一团糟。

body.en: We hope to discover new plants during our forest walk.
body.zh: 我们希望在森林漫步时发现新植物。

body.en: You may discover a new hobby at the school fair.
body.zh: 你可能在学校活动会上发现一项新爱好。

body.en: We will discuss our ideas before choosing a team name.
body.zh: 选队名前，我们会讨论大家的想法。

body.en: Please discuss the story with the person beside you.
body.zh: 请和身旁的同学讨论这个故事。

body.en: The scientist studies a disease that affects apple trees.
body.zh: 那位科学家研究一种影响苹果树的疾病。

body.en: The doctor explained the disease to my family in simple words.
body.zh: 医生用简单的话向我的家人解释了这种疾病。

body.en: Grandma served a warm vegetable dish with rice for dinner.
body.zh: 晚饭时，奶奶端来一道热乎的蔬菜菜肴和米饭。

body.en: I washed each dish after helping my father cook.
body.zh: 帮爸爸做饭后，我把每个盘子都洗了。

body.en: We divided the oranges equally among the four children.
body.zh: 我们把橙子平均分给了四个孩子。

body.en: Our teacher asked us to divide the class into small groups.
body.zh: 老师让我们把全班分成几个小组。

body.en: I do my homework at the kitchen table after dinner.
body.zh: 晚饭后我在餐桌旁做作业。

body.en: Our class did a science experiment with clean water yesterday.
body.zh: 昨天我们班用干净的水做了一个科学实验。

body.en: The doctor listened carefully when I described my sore throat.
body.zh: 我描述喉咙痛时，医生仔细地听着。

body.en: My sister wants to become a doctor and help children.
body.zh: 我姐姐想成为一名医生，帮助孩子们。

body.en: Our dog waits by the door when we get home.
body.zh: 我们到家时，狗狗就在门边等着。

body.en: Please keep your dog close on this narrow path.
body.zh: 在这条窄路上，请让狗狗跟紧你。

body.en: My little sister made a paper hat for her doll.
body.zh: 我妹妹给她的娃娃做了一顶纸帽子。

body.en: The old doll in the box belonged to Grandma.
body.zh: 盒子里的旧娃娃曾是奶奶的。

body.en: This postcard costs one dollar at the museum shop.
body.zh: 这张明信片在博物馆商店卖一美元。

body.en: I found a dollar under the sofa while cleaning.
body.zh: 打扫时，我在沙发下面找到了一美元。

body.en: We can donate these clean coats to the local charity.
body.zh: 我们可以把这些干净的外套捐给当地慈善机构。

body.en: Our class will donate books to a small village library.
body.zh: 我们班将向一家乡村小图书馆捐书。

body.en: Someone left a small parcel outside our front door.
body.zh: 有人在我们家门外留下了一个小包裹。

body.en: Please hold the door while I carry this box inside.
body.zh: 我搬这个箱子进去时，请帮忙扶着门。

body.en: This large bottle holds double the water of that small one.
body.zh: 这个大瓶子的容量是那个小瓶子的两倍。

body.en: We need to double the recipe for eight guests.
body.zh: 招待八位客人，我们需要把食谱的用量加倍。

body.en: I had no doubt that my friend would keep her promise.
body.zh: 我确信朋友会遵守承诺。

body.en: If you doubt an answer, check it in your textbook.
body.zh: 如果你对答案有疑问，就查查课本。

body.en: The ball rolled down the hill and stopped by a tree.
body.zh: 球沿着山坡滚下，在一棵树旁停住了。

body.en: Please write down the address before you leave.
body.zh: 离开前，请把地址记下来。

body.en: You can download the map before we leave home.
body.zh: 我们出门前，你可以下载这张地图。

body.en: I will download the homework file after dinner.
body.zh: 晚饭后我会下载作业文件。

body.en: The dragon in this story guards a hidden cave.
body.zh: 这个故事里的龙守着一个隐秘的洞穴。

body.en: We made a red paper dragon for the festival.
body.zh: 我们为节日做了一条红色纸龙。

body.en: I joined the drama club because I enjoy acting.
body.zh: 我喜欢表演，所以加入了戏剧社。

body.en: We watched a short drama about two old friends.
body.zh: 我们看了一出关于两位老朋友的短剧。

body.en: Can you draw a map from our house to the park?
body.zh: 你能画出从我们家到公园的路线图吗？

body.en: The bright flowers draw bees into our garden.
body.zh: 鲜艳的花朵把蜜蜂吸引到我们的花园里。

body.en: I had a strange dream about a flying bicycle.
body.zh: 我做了一个关于会飞的自行车的怪梦。

body.en: Her dream is to open a small bookshop by the sea.
body.zh: 她的梦想是在海边开一家小书店。

body.en: My aunt wore a green dress to the family party.
body.zh: 我阿姨穿了一条绿色连衣裙参加家庭聚会。

body.en: My little brother can dress himself without any help.
body.zh: 我弟弟不用人帮忙就能自己穿衣服。

body.en: Would you like a hot drink after your walk?
body.zh: 散步回来，你想喝点热饮吗？

body.en: I always drink water after playing football.
body.zh: 踢完足球后，我总会喝水。

body.en: Dad drives us to the swimming pool when it rains.
body.zh: 下雨时爸爸开车送我们去游泳池。

body.en: We went for a short drive along the coast on Sunday.
body.zh: 星期天我们沿海岸短途兜风。

body.en: The driver waited until everyone was seated on the bus.
body.zh: 司机等着，直到公交车上的每个人都坐好了。

body.en: A taxi driver helped us find the right hotel.
body.zh: 一位出租车司机帮我们找到了要去的酒店。

body.en: Lily dropped her pencil under the desk during class.
body.zh: 莉莉上课时把铅笔掉在了课桌下面。

body.en: Please add a drop of milk to my tea.
body.zh: 请在我的茶里加一滴牛奶。

body.en: Hang your wet coat by the window so it can dry.
body.zh: 把湿外套挂在窗边晾干。

body.en: Please dry the clean plates with this soft towel.
body.zh: 请用这条柔软的毛巾把洗干净的盘子擦干。

body.en: A duck was swimming slowly beneath the wooden bridge.
body.zh: 一只鸭子正在木桥下慢慢游动。

body.en: We watched the duck lead its babies toward the pond.
body.zh: 我们看着鸭妈妈领着小鸭子走向池塘。

body.en: I put a little filling inside each dumpling.
body.zh: 我在每个饺子里放了一点馅。

body.en: Our family makes dumplings together on cold winter evenings.
body.zh: 冬天寒冷的晚上，我们全家一起包饺子。

body.en: We stayed inside during the heavy rain.
body.zh: 下大雨时，我们待在室内。

body.en: Please do not talk during the quiet part of the song.
body.zh: 歌曲安静的部分，请不要讲话。

body.en: It is our duty to keep the classroom clean.
body.zh: 保持教室整洁是我们的责任。

body.en: My mother is on duty at the hospital tonight.
body.zh: 我妈妈今晚在医院值班。

body.en: Each student brought one photo for the class display.
body.zh: 每位学生都带来一张照片用于班级展览。

body.en: We each chose a different book from the shelf.
body.zh: 我们各自从书架上选了一本不同的书。

body.en: An eagle flew high above the mountain path.
body.zh: 一只鹰在山路上空高高飞翔。

body.en: The eagle spread its wings before leaving the tree.
body.zh: 那只鹰张开翅膀，准备飞离树枝。

body.en: The puppy has one white ear and one black ear.
body.zh: 那只小狗一只耳朵是白色的，另一只是黑色的。

body.en: She leaned closer and whispered the answer in my ear.
body.zh: 她靠近一些，在我耳边轻声说出了答案。

body.en: We caught an early train to avoid the crowds.
body.zh: 我们赶了一班早车，避开人群。

body.en: I arrived early and helped the teacher arrange the chairs.
body.zh: 我早早到了，帮老师摆好椅子。

body.en: We learned that the earth moves around the sun.
body.zh: 我们了解到地球绕着太阳运动。

body.en: The gardener covered the seeds with a little earth.
body.zh: 园丁在种子上盖了一点泥土。

body.en: The earthquake damaged the old bridge near the village.
body.zh: 地震损坏了村子附近的旧桥。

body.en: Our class read a story about helpers after an earthquake.
body.zh: 我们班读了一个关于地震后救援人员的故事。

body.en: The sun comes up in the east every morning.
body.zh: 太阳每天早晨从东方升起。

body.en: Our school is east of the train station.
body.zh: 我们学校在火车站的东边。

body.en: This bag is light and easy to carry.
body.zh: 这个包很轻，拿起来很方便。

body.en: The instructions make this paper boat easy to build.
body.zh: 有了这些说明，这只纸船做起来很容易。

body.en: We can eat outside if the weather stays warm.
body.zh: 如果天气一直暖和，我们可以在户外吃饭。

body.en: The baby bird opened its mouth to eat.
body.zh: 小鸟张开嘴准备吃东西。

body.en: Education helps children learn about the world around them.
body.zh: 教育帮助孩子们了解身边的世界。

body.en: Her parents talk with her about the value of education.
body.zh: 她的父母和她谈教育的价值。

body.en: The new school rule had a good effect on our class.
body.zh: 这条新校规对我们班产生了积极的影响。

body.en: Regular exercise can have a good effect on your sleep.
body.zh: 经常锻炼能对睡眠产生好的影响。

body.en: With a little effort each day, Sam learned to ride his bike.
body.zh: 萨姆每天稍加努力，学会了骑自行车。

body.en: Our team made a great effort to clean the park before noon.
body.zh: 我们队努力在中午前打扫干净公园。

body.en: Crack one egg into the bowl and mix it well.
body.zh: 往碗里打一个鸡蛋，搅拌均匀。

body.en: A small bird came out of the egg this morning.
body.zh: 今天早上，一只小鸟从蛋里孵了出来。

body.en: You can choose either the red cup or the blue one.
body.zh: 你可以选红杯子或蓝杯子中的任意一个。

body.en: I don't like rainy mornings, and my brother doesn't either.
body.zh: 我不喜欢下雨的早晨，我弟弟也不喜欢。

body.en: My elder brother taught me how to repair my bicycle.
The village elders shared stories about the old bridge.
body.zh: 村里的长者讲述了那座旧桥的故事。

body.en: The electric fan kept us cool during lunch.
body.zh: 午饭时，电风扇让我们感到凉爽。

body.en: We rode an electric bus through the city center.
body.zh: 我们乘电动公交车穿过市中心。

body.en: Our school library lends electronic books as well as paper ones.
body.zh: 学校图书馆既借纸质书，也借电子书。

body.en: Please turn off electronic devices before the concert starts.
body.zh: 音乐会开始前，请关闭电子设备。

body.en: The elephant reached for a branch with its long trunk.
body.zh: 那头大象用长鼻子去够树枝。

body.en: We drew an elephant with large ears in art class.
body.zh: 美术课上，我们画了一头大耳朵的大象。

body.en: Would you like anything else with your sandwich?
body.zh: 你的三明治还要搭配别的东西吗？

body.en: We can take another bus, or else we will be late.
body.zh: 我们可以坐另一班公交车，不然就要迟到了。

body.en: Please send the photos to me by email.
body.zh: 请用电子邮件把照片发给我。

body.en: I received an email about tomorrow's class trip.
body.zh: 我收到一封关于明天班级旅行的邮件。

body.en: The teacher showed us the emergency exit before the show.
body.zh: 演出前，老师向我们指出了紧急出口。

body.en: Keep this phone number in case of an emergency.
body.zh: 保存这个电话号码，以备紧急情况使用。

body.en: The emperor in the story lived in a large palace.
body.zh: 故事里的皇帝住在一座大宫殿里。

body.en: The painting shows an empress wearing a golden crown.
body.zh: 画上是一位戴着金色王冠的女皇。

body.en: The water bottle was empty, so I filled it at the fountain.
body.zh: 水瓶空了，所以我在饮水机旁把它装满。

body.en: Please empty your schoolbag before you put it in the cupboard.
body.zh: 把书包放进柜子前，请先清空它。

body.en: Our teacher will encourage everyone to share an idea.
body.zh: 老师会鼓励每个人分享一个想法。

body.en: I try to encourage my friend when the work seems difficult.
body.zh: 任务看起来很难时，我会试着鼓励朋友。

body.en: At the end of the lesson, we played a quick word game.
body.zh: 课快结束时，我们玩了一个简单的单词游戏。

body.en: Our street ends near a small park with a pond.
body.zh: 我们这条街在一个有池塘的小公园附近到头。

body.en: In the game, our team had to find the enemy's hidden base.
body.zh: 游戏中，我们队必须找到敌人隐藏的基地。

body.en: The story is about two friends who become enemies after a fight.
body.zh: 这个故事讲的是两个朋友打架后成了敌人。

body.en: The energetic puppy ran around the garden all morning.
body.zh: 那只精力充沛的小狗整个上午都在花园里跑。

body.en: After a good night's sleep, I felt energetic again.
body.zh: 好好睡了一夜后，我又充满了精神。

body.en: After breakfast, I had enough energy to ride my bike to school.
body.zh: 吃过早饭后，我精力充沛，骑车去了学校。

body.en: The sun gives plants the energy they need to grow.
body.zh: 太阳为植物生长提供所需的能量。

body.en: My aunt is an engineer who designs bridges for her city.
body.zh: 我阿姨是一名工程师，为她所在的城市设计桥梁。

body.en: The young engineer showed our class a small robot she built.
body.zh: 这位年轻工程师向我们班展示了她制作的小机器人。

body.en: I enjoy reading beside the window on rainy afternoons.
body.zh: 下雨的午后，我喜欢在窗边读书。

body.en: We hope you enjoy your visit to our village.
body.zh: 希望你在我们村游玩愉快。

body.en: We have enough chairs for everyone in the classroom.
body.zh: 教室里的椅子够每个人坐。

body.en: The soup is cool enough for my little brother to eat.
body.zh: 汤已经不烫了，我弟弟可以喝了。

body.en: Please enter your name at the top of the form.
body.zh: 请在表格顶部填写你的名字。

body.en: The students entered the museum quietly with their teacher.
body.zh: 学生们和老师安静地进入了博物馆。

body.en: We pick up litter to help protect the environment.
body.zh: 我们捡起垃圾，帮助保护环境。

body.en: Soft music creates a calm environment in the reading room.
body.zh: 轻柔的音乐在阅览室里营造出宁静的环境。

body.en: My grandparents often tell stories about life in a different era.
body.zh: 我的祖父母常讲另一个时代的生活故事。

body.en: The internet has changed how students learn in the modern era.
body.zh: 互联网改变了学生在现代的学习方式。

body.en: May I borrow your eraser to correct this drawing?
body.zh: 我可以借你的橡皮擦修改这幅画吗？

body.en: My eraser fell between the desk and the wall.
body.zh: 我的橡皮掉进了书桌和墙壁之间。

body.en: I like fruit, especially sweet oranges from the garden.
body.zh: 我喜欢水果，尤其喜欢园子里甜甜的橙子。

body.en: Dad makes breakfast for us, especially on busy school mornings.
body.zh: 爸爸为我们做早餐，尤其是在忙碌的上学日早晨。

body.en: Everyone enjoyed the story, even my sleepy little brother.
body.zh: 大家都喜欢这个故事，连困倦的小弟弟也不例外。

body.en: Six is an even number, but seven is not.
We watched the sky turn pink in the evening.
body.zh: 傍晚，我们看着天空变成粉红色。

body.en: I have a piano lesson on Thursday evening.
body.zh: 我星期四晚上有一节钢琴课。

body.en: Our school sports event starts on the playground at nine.
body.zh: 我们学校的体育活动九点在操场开始。

body.en: The singing contest was my favorite event at the school festival.
body.zh: 歌唱比赛是我最喜欢的校园节日活动。

body.en: Have you ever seen snow fall in the mountains?
body.zh: 你曾在山上见过下雪吗？

body.en: This is the best sandwich I have ever made.
body.zh: 这是我做过的最好吃的三明治。

body.en: Our teacher checks every student's homework before class begins.
body.zh: 上课前，老师会检查每个学生的作业。

body.en: I drink a glass of milk every morning before school.
body.zh: 我每天早晨上学前喝一杯牛奶。

body.en: Everybody stood up when the school song began.
body.zh: 校歌响起时，大家都站了起来。

body.en: There is enough cake for everyone at the party.
body.zh: 聚会上的蛋糕足够每个人吃。

body.en: This book teaches English for everyday situations like shopping.
body.zh: 这本书教购物等日常场景中的英语。

body.en: Bicycles are part of everyday life in our town.
body.zh: 自行车是我们镇日常生活的一部分。

body.en: I packed everything I need for the school trip.
body.zh: 我把校外活动需要的东西都装好了。

body.en: Everything on the table is ready for breakfast.
body.zh: 桌上吃早餐要用的东西都准备好了。

body.en: We looked everywhere for my missing school key.
body.zh: 我们到处寻找我丢失的校门钥匙。

body.en: After the rain, small puddles were everywhere in the playground.
body.zh: 下雨后，操场上到处都是小水坑。

body.en: The bus leaves at exactly eight, so please arrive early.
body.zh: 公交车正好八点发车，请早点到。

body.en: That is exactly the answer we found in the book.
body.zh: 那正是我们在书里找到的答案。

body.en: I checked my answers before handing in the exam paper.
Our English exam will be in the music room tomorrow.
body.zh: 明天我们的英语考试在音乐教室举行。

body.en: Can you give an example of an animal that swims?
body.zh: 你能举一个会游泳的动物的例子吗？

body.en: Some fruits, for example oranges, have a thick skin.
body.zh: 一些水果，比方说橙子，果皮很厚。

body.en: The guide gave us excellent directions to the lake.
body.zh: 向导给我们清楚地说明了去湖边的路线。

body.en: Your careful drawing is an excellent addition to our display.
body.zh: 你精心画的作品为我们的展览增色不少。

body.en: Everyone came to the picnic except Jack, who had a cold.
body.zh: 除了感冒的杰克，大家都来参加了野餐。

body.en: I like all the colors except purple.
body.zh: 除了紫色，我喜欢所有颜色。

body.en: The children were excited about sleeping in a tent.
body.zh: 孩子们对睡帐篷这件事感到兴奋。

body.en: I felt excited when my parcel finally arrived.
body.zh: 包裹终于送到时，我感到很激动。

body.en: The last few minutes of the match were very exciting.
body.zh: 比赛的最后几分钟非常激动人心。

body.en: We have an exciting plan to build a tree house.
body.zh: 我们有个令人兴奋的计划：建一座树屋。

body.en: Excuse me, is this seat beside you free?
body.zh: 打扰一下，你旁边这个座位空着吗？

body.en: Please excuse the mess while we paint the kitchen.
