body.zh: 我们正在粉刷厨房，屋里有点乱，请见谅。

body.en: I get some exercise by walking to school each morning.
body.zh: 我每天早晨步行上学，借此锻炼身体。

body.en: Please finish the first exercise on this page.
body.zh: 请完成这一页的第一道练习。

body.en: We expect the school bus to arrive before eight.
body.zh: 我们预计校车会在八点前到。

body.en: I expect my cousin to visit us during the holiday.
body.zh: 我预计表亲会在假期来我们家。

body.en: This coat is too expensive, so I will try another one.
body.zh: 这件外套太贵了，我试试另一件。

body.en: We brought sandwiches instead of buying an expensive lunch.
body.zh: 我们自带了三明治，没有花大钱买午餐。

body.en: Our first camping experience taught us how to set up a tent.
body.zh: 我们第一次露营的经历教会了我们怎样搭帐篷。

body.en: She experienced heavy rain on her walk home yesterday.
body.zh: 她昨天步行回家时遇上了大雨。

body.en: An expert showed us how to care for the old books.
body.zh: 一位专家教我们怎样保养这些旧书。

body.en: My uncle is an expert on birds that live near rivers.
body.zh: 我叔叔是研究河边鸟类的专家。

body.en: Our teacher explained the new game rules with a simple picture.
body.zh: 老师用一张简单的图解释了新游戏规则。

body.en: Can you explain how to get to the sports centre?
body.zh: 你能说明怎么去体育中心吗？

body.en: We explored the old castle during our family trip.
body.zh: 家庭旅行时，我们参观探索了那座古老的城堡。

body.en: The children used a map to explore the forest safely.
body.zh: 孩子们用地图安全地探索森林。

body.en: You can express your feelings through music or art.
body.zh: 你可以通过音乐或绘画表达感受。

body.en: She wrote a card to express her thanks.
body.zh: 她写了一张卡片表达谢意。

body.en: A grain of sand got into my eye at the beach.
body.zh: 在沙滩上，一粒沙子进了我的眼睛。

body.en: A single tear rolled down from her left eye.
body.zh: 一滴眼泪从她的左眼流下。

body.en: Wash your face before we leave for school.
Our classroom windows face the school garden.
body.zh: 我们教室的窗户朝着学校花园。

body.en: It is a fact that water freezes when it gets cold enough.
body.zh: 水冷到一定程度会结冰，这是事实。

body.en: We checked the facts before making a poster about pandas.
body.zh: 制作熊猫海报前，我们核实了相关事实。

body.en: The factory near our town makes paper from old newspapers.
body.zh: 我们镇附近的工厂用旧报纸造纸。

body.en: Workers at the toy factory showed us their new wooden trains.
body.zh: 玩具厂工人给我们看了新做的木头火车。

body.en: The plan may fail if we forget to bring the tools.
body.zh: 如果忘带工具，这个计划可能失败。

body.en: I sometimes fail to notice the time when I read.
body.zh: 读书时，我有时会忘记留意时间。

body.en: Our class agreed on fair rules for choosing the team captain.
body.zh: 我们班同意用公平的规则选队长。

body.en: We bought warm pancakes at the school fair on Saturday.
body.zh: 星期六我们在学校集市买了热乎乎的煎饼。

body.en: Leaves fall from the trees when autumn comes.
body.zh: 秋天到来时，树叶会从树上落下。

body.en: I fell off my bike, but my knee was fine.
body.zh: 我从自行车上摔了下来，不过膝盖没事。

body.en: One statement on this page is true, and one is false.
body.zh: 这一页上有一句话是对的，另一句是错的。

body.en: The false alarm interrupted our music lesson this morning.
body.zh: 今天早上，误报的警报打断了我们的音乐课。

body.en: That song sounds familiar, but I cannot remember its name.
body.zh: 那首歌听起来很熟悉，但我想不起它的名字。

body.en: Our new classmate is familiar with the school library rules.
body.zh: 我们的新同学熟悉学校图书馆的规定。

body.en: Our family takes turns choosing the film on Friday nights.
body.zh: 我们家每到周五晚上就轮流选电影。

body.en: I drew a family tree with help from my grandparents.
body.zh: 在祖父母的帮助下，我画了一张家谱图。

body.en: This town is famous for its old stone bridges.
body.zh: 这个镇以古老的石桥闻名。

body.en: A famous singer visited our school and answered our questions.
body.zh: 一位著名歌手来到学校，回答了我们的问题。

body.en: The fan on my desk blows the loose papers around.
body.zh: 桌上的风扇把散放的纸张吹得到处都是。

body.en: My sister is a big fan of the local football team.
body.zh: 我姐姐是当地足球队的忠实球迷。

body.en: We had a fantastic view of the lake from our room.
body.zh: 从房间里，我们能欣赏到绝美的湖景。

body.en: Your idea for a class newspaper sounds fantastic.
body.zh: 你关于办班报的主意听起来棒极了。

body.en: Our school is far from the train station, so we take a bus.
body.zh: 我们学校离火车站很远，所以我们坐公交车。

body.en: How far can you ride your bike in one hour?
body.zh: 你一小时能骑自行车骑多远？

body.en: We helped collect eggs during our visit to the farm.
body.zh: 参观农场时，我们帮忙收鸡蛋。

body.en: The small farm sells fresh vegetables every Saturday.
body.zh: 那个小农场每周六出售新鲜蔬菜。

body.en: The farmer covered the young plants before the cold night.
body.zh: 寒夜来临前，农民把幼苗盖了起来。

body.en: A local farmer taught us how to pick ripe tomatoes.
body.zh: 一位当地农民教我们怎样摘熟番茄。

body.en: My sister likes to read fashion magazines after dinner.
body.zh: 晚饭后我姐姐喜欢看时尚杂志。

body.en: Jeans and simple shirts are still in fashion at our school.
body.zh: 牛仔裤和简洁的衬衫在我们学校依然流行。

body.en: The river flows fast after several days of rain.
body.zh: 连下几天雨后，河水流得很快。

body.en: This fast train can take us there before lunch.
body.zh: 这趟快车能在午饭前把我们送到那里。

body.en: The soup has too much fat, so Mum removes the oil on top.
body.zh: 汤里的脂肪太多了，所以妈妈把表面的油撇掉。

body.en: This cat gets fat when it eats too many treats.
body.zh: 这只猫零食吃得太多就会变胖。

body.en: My father taught me to fix a loose bicycle chain.
body.zh: 我父亲教我修理松掉的自行车链条。

body.en: Anna and her father planted beans beside the fence.
body.zh: 安娜和她父亲在围栏旁种了豆子。

body.en: My favourite part of the day is reading before bed.
body.zh: 一天中我最喜欢的时刻是睡前阅读。

body.en: This soup has been a family favourite for years.
body.zh: 这道汤多年来一直是全家最爱的一道菜。

body.en: She overcame her fear of water with patient help.
body.zh: 在耐心的帮助下，她克服了怕水的心理。

body.en: I fear that we have taken the wrong bus.
body.zh: 我恐怕我们坐错公交车了。

body.en: Please feed the cat before you leave for school.
body.zh: 上学出门前，请喂一下猫。

body.en: We watched the birds feed their chicks in the nest.
body.zh: 我们看着鸟儿在巢里喂雏鸟。

body.en: I feel happy when our whole family cooks together.
body.zh: 全家一起做饭时，我觉得很开心。

body.en: Feel this cloth and tell me whether it is soft.
body.zh: 摸摸这块布，告诉我它软不软。

body.en: I had a strange feeling that I had seen this house before.
body.zh: 我有一种奇怪的感觉，觉得以前见过这所房子。

body.en: Talking with a friend helped me explain my feelings.
body.zh: 和朋友交谈帮助我说清了自己的感受。

body.en: Our town holds a flower festival every spring.
body.zh: 我们镇每年春天都会举办花卉节。

body.en: We decorated the classroom with paper lanterns for the festival.
body.zh: 为迎接节日，我们用纸灯笼布置了教室。

body.en: Mum took me to the doctor because I had a fever.
body.zh: 我发烧了，妈妈带我去看医生。

body.en: Her fever had gone by the next morning.
body.zh: 到第二天早上，她的烧已经退了。

body.en: Only a few people were waiting at the bus stop.
body.zh: 公交车站只有几个人在等车。

body.en: There were few empty seats, so we sat near the back.
body.zh: 空座位很少，我们便坐在后面。

body.en: Our class played football on the field after school.
body.zh: 放学后我们班在运动场上踢了足球。

body.en: My aunt works in the field of children's books.
body.zh: 我姑妈从事儿童图书领域的工作。

body.en: The two friends stopped their fight and apologized to each other.
body.zh: 两个朋友停止争吵，并互相道了歉。

body.en: Our team will fight hard to win the school game.
body.zh: 我们队会努力拼搏，争取赢得校际比赛。

body.en: Please fill the bottle with water before our walk.
body.zh: 请在我们散步前把瓶子装满水。

body.en: The smell of fresh bread filled the kitchen.
body.zh: 新鲜面包的香味弥漫了整个厨房。

body.en: We watched a film about a child and a lost dog.
body.zh: 我们看了一部关于孩子和走失小狗的电影。

body.en: Can you film our dance so we can watch it later?
body.zh: 你能录下我们的舞蹈，让我们稍后看吗？

body.en: Please check your work before writing the final answer.
body.zh: 写下最终答案前，请检查你的解题过程。

body.en: Our team reached the final of the school football competition.
body.zh: 我们队进入了学校足球赛的决赛。

body.en: I found my missing library book under the sofa.
body.zh: 我在沙发下面找到了丢失的图书馆借书。

body.en: We find the science museum easy to reach by bus.
body.zh: 我们觉得坐公交去科学博物馆很方便。

body.en: I felt tired yesterday, but I am fine today.
body.zh: 我昨天觉得累，不过今天身体很好。

body.en: The weather stayed fine throughout our camping trip.
body.zh: 整个露营期间，天气一直晴朗。

body.en: She pointed to the tiny bird with one finger.
body.zh: 她伸出一根手指，指着那只小鸟。

body.en: I have a little blue paint on my finger.
body.zh: 我的手指上沾了一点蓝色颜料。

body.en: Let's finish washing the dishes before we watch the film.
body.zh: 我们看电影前先把碗洗完吧。

body.en: The runners smiled as they crossed the finish line.
body.zh: 跑步者冲过终点线时都笑了。

body.en: We sat by the fire and listened to Grandpa's stories.
body.zh: 我们坐在炉火边，听爷爷讲故事。

body.en: The fire damaged several shops, but everyone got out safely.
body.zh: 大火烧坏了几家商店，但所有人都安全逃出。

body.en: The fireman carried a frightened cat down the ladder.
body.zh: 消防员把一只受惊的猫抱下梯子。

body.en: Two firemen visited our class to talk about their work.
body.zh: 两位消防员来到班上，介绍他们的工作。

body.en: A bright firework lit up the sky above the river.
body.zh: 一束明亮的烟花照亮了河面上方的天空。

body.en: We watched the fireworks from a safe distance.
body.zh: 我们在安全距离外观看烟花。

body.en: A small silver fish swam between the rocks.
body.zh: 一条银色的小鱼在岩石间游动。

body.en: Grandpa likes to fish beside the lake in the morning.
body.zh: 爷爷喜欢早晨在湖边钓鱼。

body.en: These shoes fit me well, so I can walk comfortably.
body.zh: 这双鞋很合脚，所以我走路很舒服。

body.en: The new desk fits beside the window in my room.
body.zh: 新书桌正好能放在我房间的窗边。

body.en: Dad fixed my bike after the chain came off.
body.zh: 自行车链条掉了以后，爸爸把车修好了。

body.en: We fixed a time to meet at the library on Saturday.
body.zh: 我们定好星期六在图书馆见面的时间。

body.en: The flag moved gently in the morning wind.
body.zh: 旗帜在晨风中轻轻飘动。

body.en: Each boat carried a colorful flag at the festival.
body.zh: 节日期间，每条船上都插着一面彩旗。

body.en: Put the paper on a flat surface before drawing.
body.zh: 画画前，把纸放在平整的表面上。

body.en: My aunt lives in a small flat above the bakery.
body.zh: 我阿姨住在面包店楼上的一套小公寓里。

body.en: The flood covered the fields after days of heavy rain.
body.zh: 连日大雨后，洪水淹没了田野。

body.en: Neighbors helped clean the library after the flood.
body.zh: 洪水过后，邻居们帮忙清理图书馆。

body.en: I dropped my pencil, and it rolled across the floor.
body.zh: 我的铅笔掉了，沿着地板滚了出去。

body.en: The art room is on the second floor.
A yellow flower opened beside the garden gate.
body.zh: 花园门边开了一朵黄花。

body.en: She pressed a flower between the pages of a book.
body.zh: 她把一朵花夹在书页之间压平。

body.en: I missed two days of school because I had flu.
body.zh: 我得了流感，两天没去上学。

body.en: Dad stayed home from work while he recovered from flu.
body.zh: 爸爸得流感后，在家休养，没有去上班。

body.en: The little bird is learning how to fly.
A fly landed on the table beside my plate.
body.zh: 一只苍蝇落在桌上，就在我的盘子旁。

body.en: Mia turned off the TV to focus on her homework.
body.zh: 米娅关掉电视，专心做作业。

body.en: The camera focused on the flowers in the garden.
body.zh: 相机对焦在花园里的花朵上。

body.en: Thick fog hid the hills from our bedroom window.
body.zh: 浓雾遮住了山丘，从卧室窗口望不到它们。

body.en: The fog began to clear after the sun came out.
body.zh: 太阳出来后，雾开始散了。

body.en: Folk music from this town often tells stories about the sea.
body.zh: 这个小镇的民间音乐常常讲述关于大海的故事。

body.en: My folks are coming to the school show tonight.
body.zh: 我家人今晚要来看学校演出。

body.en: Please follow the guide along this narrow forest path.
body.zh: 请沿着这条狭窄的林间小路跟着向导走。

body.en: You need to follow the instructions to build the model.
body.zh: 你需要按照说明来制作模型。

body.en: We packed enough food for a picnic by the lake.
body.zh: 我们为湖边野餐带了足够的食物。

body.en: The birds search for food under the fallen leaves.
body.zh: 鸟儿在落叶下面寻找食物。

body.en: The clever fox tried to fool the crow in the story.
body.zh: 故事里，聪明的狐狸试图欺骗乌鸦。

body.en: Do not let a false message fool you.
My left foot got wet when I stepped in a puddle.
We rested at the foot of the hill before climbing.
body.zh: 爬山前，我们在山脚下休息。

body.en: We played football until it became too dark to see.
body.zh: 我们踢足球，一直踢到天黑看不清为止。

body.en: My brother keeps his football in a box by the door.
body.zh: 我弟弟把足球放在门边的箱子里。

body.en: Dad made a warm bowl of soup for me after practice.
body.zh: 训练结束后，爸爸为我做了一碗热汤。

body.en: We stayed inside, for the rain was getting heavier.
body.zh: 我们待在室内，因为雨越下越大。

body.en: The strong wind forced us to stay inside after school.
body.zh: 大风迫使我们放学后留在室内。

body.en: It takes force to push this heavy classroom door open.
body.zh: 推开这扇沉重的教室门需要用力。

body.en: Our class watched a foreign film with Chinese subtitles.
body.zh: 我们班看了一部配有中文字幕的外国电影。

body.en: My uncle can speak two foreign languages.
The path through the forest leads to a clear stream.
body.zh: 穿过森林的小路通向一条清澈的溪流。

body.en: We heard many different birds singing in the forest.
body.zh: 我们在森林里听见许多不同的鸟儿鸣唱。

body.en: We promised to remember our summer by the sea forever.
body.zh: 我们约好永远记住那个海边的夏天。

body.en: I cannot keep this library book forever; it belongs to everyone.
body.zh: 我不能一直留着这本图书馆的书，它属于大家。

body.en: Please do not forget your umbrella when you leave.
I sometimes forget where I put my reading glasses.
body.zh: 我有时会忘记把阅读眼镜放在哪儿了。

body.en: I used a fork to pick up a piece of potato.
body.zh: 我用叉子叉起了一块土豆。

body.en: Take the left path at the fork near the bridge.
body.zh: 到桥边的岔路口时，走左边那条路。

body.en: Please fill in this form before joining the school club.
body.zh: 加入学校社团前请填写这张表格。

body.en: The students form a line before entering the classroom.
body.zh: 学生们在进入教室前排成一队。

body.en: Please move forward so more people can get on the bus.
body.zh: 请往前走，让更多人能上公交车。

body.en: We look forward to seeing you at the school show.
body.zh: 我们期待在学校演出时见到你。

body.en: They plan to found a club for young nature lovers.
body.zh: 他们计划为年轻的自然爱好者创办一个社团。

body.en: Our town was founded beside a river many years ago.
body.zh: 许多年前，我们的镇子建在一条河边。

body.en: A fox slipped through the hedge beside the field.
body.zh: 一只狐狸从田边的树篱间溜了过去。

body.en: The fox in this story has a bright red tail.
body.zh: 这个故事里的狐狸有一条鲜红的尾巴。

body.en: The museum is free for children on Sundays.
body.zh: 博物馆每周日对儿童免费开放。

body.en: Are you free to help me after lunch?
body.zh: 午饭后，你有空帮我一下吗？

body.en: Water can freeze on the road during cold nights.
body.zh: 寒冷的夜晚，道路上的水可能结冰。

body.en: We can freeze the extra soup for another day.
body.zh: 我们可以把多余的汤冷冻起来，改天喝。

body.en: We bought fresh bread from the bakery this morning.
body.zh: 今天早上，我们从面包店买了新鲜面包。

body.en: Open the window and let some fresh air in.
body.zh: 打开窗户，让新鲜空气进来。

body.en: Please put the milk back in the fridge.
There is enough space in the fridge for this cake.
body.zh: 冰箱里有足够的空间放这个蛋糕。

body.en: My friend saved me a seat on the school bus.
body.zh: 我的朋友在校车上给我留了个座位。

body.en: We became friends after working on a science project together.
body.zh: 一起做科学项目后，我们成了朋友。

body.en: A friendly neighbor helped us carry our bags upstairs.
body.zh: 一位友善的邻居帮我们把包提上楼。

body.en: The new librarian gave everyone a friendly smile.
body.zh: 新来的图书管理员对大家友好地微笑。

body.en: Our friendship began when we shared a desk at school.
body.zh: 我们成为同桌时，这段友谊就开始了。

body.en: Keeping promises is important in a friendship.
body.zh: 信守承诺对友谊很重要。

body.en: My cousin came from Beijing to visit us.
body.zh: 我表姐从北京来看望我们。

body.en: This cake is a gift from my grandmother.
body.zh: 这块蛋糕是我奶奶送的礼物。

body.en: I left my boots by the front door.
Please stand at the front so everyone can see you.
body.zh: 请站到前面，让大家都能看见你。

body.en: We washed the fruit before putting it on the table.
body.zh: 把水果摆上桌前，我们先洗了洗。

body.en: The apple tree finally bore fruit this autumn.
body.zh: 这棵苹果树今年秋天终于结果了。

body.en: The bus was full, so we waited for the next one.
body.zh: 公交车满了，所以我们等下一辆。

body.en: My bottle is full of cold water after the walk.
body.zh: 散步后，我的水瓶装满了凉水。

body.en: We had fun playing badminton after school yesterday.
body.zh: 昨天放学后我们打羽毛球，玩得很开心。

body.en: Our teacher planned a fun science game for the class.
body.zh: 老师为全班设计了一个有趣的科学游戏。

body.en: My little brother told a funny story at dinner.
body.zh: 我弟弟晚饭时讲了一个有趣的故事。

body.en: The dog looked funny in Dad's old hat.
body.zh: 狗戴着爸爸的旧帽子，看起来很滑稽。

body.en: In the future, I hope to design games for children.
body.zh: 将来，我希望为孩子们设计游戏。

body.en: Our future plans include visiting the science museum together.
body.zh: 我们的未来计划包括一起参观科学博物馆。

body.en: We played a board game with our cousins on Sunday.
body.zh: 星期天我们和表兄弟姐妹玩了桌游。

body.en: Our school team won the basketball game by three points.
body.zh: 我们校队以三分之差赢得了篮球比赛。

body.en: Grandpa grows carrots in the garden behind our house.
body.zh: 爷爷在房子后面的菜园里种胡萝卜。

body.en: We sat in the garden and listened to the birds.
body.zh: 我们坐在花园里听鸟鸣。

body.en: We learned that air is a mixture of different gases.
body.zh: 我们了解到，空气由不同的气体混合而成。

body.en: Dad turned off the gas after cooking dinner.
body.zh: 做好晚饭后，爸爸关掉了燃气。

body.en: Please close the school gate after you enter the playground.
body.zh: 进入操场后请关好校门。

body.en: We waited by the garden gate for our friends to arrive.
body.zh: 我们在花园门口等朋友到来。

body.en: The teacher gave us a general idea of tomorrow's trip.
body.zh: 老师向我们大致介绍了明天的行程。

body.en: In general, this path is quieter than the main road.
body.zh: 总的来说，这条小路比大路安静。

body.en: The gentleman beside me offered to carry my suitcase.
body.zh: 我旁边那位先生主动提出帮我提行李箱。

body.en: Ladies and gentlemen, please welcome our school band.
body.zh: 女士们、先生们，请欢迎我们学校的乐队。

body.en: In geography class, we learned how rivers shape the land.
body.zh: 地理课上，我们学习了河流如何塑造地貌。

body.en: This map helps me understand the geography of our country.
body.zh: 这张地图帮助我了解我国的地理情况。

body.en: I got a postcard from my friend during the holiday.
body.zh: 假期里我收到了朋友寄来的明信片。

body.en: We get home before dark when we walk from school.
body.zh: 我们从学校走回家时，天黑前就能到家。

body.en: I made a small gift for my grandmother's birthday.
body.zh: 我为奶奶的生日做了一份小礼物。

body.en: My sister has a gift for telling funny stories.
body.zh: 我姐姐有讲有趣故事的天赋。

body.en: The giraffe stretched its neck to reach the leaves.
body.zh: 那头长颈鹿伸长脖子去够树叶。

body.en: We watched a baby giraffe follow its mother across the grass.
body.zh: 我们看着小长颈鹿跟随妈妈走过草地。

body.en: The girl in the red jacket is our team captain.
body.zh: 穿红夹克的女孩是我们的队长。

body.en: A girl from the next class lent me her ruler.
body.zh: 隔壁班的一个女孩借给我一把尺子。

body.en: My friend gave me a pencil when mine broke in class.
body.zh: 我的铅笔在课上断了，朋友给了我一支。

body.en: Please give the plants some water before we leave.
body.zh: 我们离开前，请给植物浇些水。

body.en: I am glad that you found your missing notebook.
body.zh: 你找到丢失的笔记本了，我真高兴。

body.en: We were glad to rest after the long walk.
body.zh: 走了很长的路后，能休息一下让我们很高兴。

body.en: The window is made of thick clear glass.
body.zh: 这扇窗户用厚厚的透明玻璃制成。

body.en: May I have a glass of water, please?
I found my missing glove under the kitchen table.
body.zh: 我在厨房桌下找到了丢失的手套。

body.en: These wool gloves keep my hands warm in winter.
body.zh: 这些羊毛手套让我冬天双手暖和。

body.en: We need glue to attach these paper wings.
body.zh: 我们需要用胶水把纸翅膀粘上。

body.en: Please glue the photos onto the blue card.
body.zh: 请把照片粘在蓝色卡纸上。

body.en: We go to school by bus every morning.
body.zh: 我们每天早上坐公交车去上学。

body.en: The lights go off when Dad leaves the kitchen.
body.zh: 爸爸离开厨房时，灯就会熄灭。

body.en: Our class set a goal to read one book each month.
body.zh: 我们班定下目标，每个月读一本书。

body.en: Leo scored a goal during the football match after school.
body.zh: 放学后的足球比赛中，利奥进了一球。

body.en: The story describes a god who controls the sea.
body.zh: 这个故事描述了一位掌管海洋的神。

body.en: We saw a stone statue of an ancient god.
body.zh: 我们看到了一尊古代神祇的石像。

body.en: The old clock has a thin gold frame around its face.
body.zh: 这只旧钟的表盘周围有一圈金色的边框。

body.en: Our team won a gold medal at the school sports day.
body.zh: 我们队在学校运动会上获得了一枚金牌。

body.en: This book gives good advice about growing flowers.
body.zh: 这本书给了许多有用的养花建议。

body.en: It was good of you to help carry those boxes.
body.zh: 你帮忙搬那些箱子，真是太好了。

body.en: We said goodbye to our cousins at the station.
body.zh: 我们在车站和表亲们道别。

body.en: I waved goodbye as the bus drove away.
body.zh: 公交车开走时，我挥手告别。

body.en: The government built a new library in our town last year.
body.zh: 去年，政府在我们镇上建了一座新图书馆。

body.en: Our class learned how the government helps keep people safe.
body.zh: 我们班学习了政府如何帮助保障人们的安全。

body.en: I got a good grade on my science test yesterday.
body.zh: 昨天我的科学考试得了好成绩。

body.en: My brother is in the eighth grade at the middle school.
body.zh: 我弟弟在这所中学读八年级。

body.en: My sister will graduate from university next summer.
body.zh: 我姐姐明年夏天将从大学毕业。

body.en: Our guide is a graduate of the local art school.
body.zh: 我们的向导毕业于当地的艺术学校。

body.en: Our teacher uses short stories to explain grammar.
body.zh: 老师用短故事讲解语法。

body.en: I checked the grammar in my letter before sending it.
body.zh: 寄信前，我检查了信中的语法。

body.en: My grandfather taught me a song from his childhood.
body.zh: 我爷爷教了我一首他小时候唱的歌。

body.en: We helped our grandfather plant a tree beside the gate.
body.zh: 我们帮爷爷在门边种了一棵树。

body.en: My grandmother keeps old family photos in a wooden box.
body.zh: 我奶奶把家里的旧照片放在一个木盒子里。

body.en: I called my grandmother to tell her about our school trip.
body.zh: 我打电话给奶奶，讲了我们的学校旅行。

body.en: A single grape rolled off the plate onto the floor.
body.zh: 一颗葡萄从盘子里滚到了地板上。

body.en: We picked sweet grapes from the vine behind the house.
body.zh: 我们从屋后的葡萄藤上摘了甜葡萄。

body.en: The grass was wet with rain this morning.
body.zh: 今天早上，草地被雨水打湿了。

body.en: We lay on the grass and watched clouds drift past.
body.zh: 我们躺在草地上，看云朵飘过。

body.en: We had a great time making kites with our friends.
body.zh: 我们和朋友一起做风筝，玩得很开心。

body.en: The project took a great deal of time and care.
body.zh: 这个项目花了许多时间和心思。

body.en: The traffic light turned green, and the cars moved forward.
body.zh: 交通灯变绿了，汽车向前开去。

body.en: Green leaves covered the trees again in spring.
body.zh: 春天，树木再次长满了绿叶。

body.en: We went to the door to greet our guests.
body.zh: 我们走到门口迎接客人。

body.en: Please greet your new classmates with a friendly smile.
body.zh: 请带着友好的微笑向新同学打招呼。

body.en: Grey clouds covered the sky before the rain began.
body.zh: 下雨前，灰色的云遮住了天空。

body.en: The little grey cat is hiding under our car.
body.zh: 那只灰色的小猫藏在我们的车底下。

body.en: The ball fell to the ground beside the school gate.
body.zh: 球落到了校门旁的地上。

body.en: Please sit on the ground and rest under this tree.
body.zh: 请坐在地上，在这棵树下休息。

body.en: Our group chose to make a poster about local birds.
body.zh: 我们小组选了本地鸟类作为海报主题。

body.en: A group of children waited outside the swimming pool.
body.zh: 一群孩子在游泳池外等着。

body.en: We grow tomatoes in pots on the sunny balcony.
body.zh: 我们在阳光充足的阳台花盆里种番茄。

body.en: The little tree grew taller after a rainy summer.
body.zh: 经过一个多雨的夏天，小树长高了。

body.en: The guard checked our tickets before opening the museum gate.
body.zh: 保安检查了门票，才打开博物馆大门。

body.en: Our dog likes to guard the garden gate.
body.zh: 我们家的狗喜欢守着花园大门。

body.en: Can you guess what is inside this small box?
body.zh: 你能猜出这个小盒子里有什么吗？

body.en: My first guess was wrong, so I tried another answer.
body.zh: 我第一次猜错了，于是换了一个答案。

body.en: We put a fresh towel in the room for our guest.
body.zh: 我们在房间里为客人放了一条干净毛巾。

body.en: Each guest brought a dish to share at the party.
body.zh: 每位客人都带来一道菜，在聚会上一起分享。

body.en: Our guide showed us the old bridge and told its story.
body.zh: 导游带我们看了那座古桥，并讲了它的故事。

body.en: This map can guide you to the nearest bus stop.
body.zh: 这张地图能指引你到最近的公交车站。

body.en: My brother plays the guitar while I sing.
body.zh: 我唱歌时，哥哥弹吉他伴奏。

body.en: She saved money for a guitar of her own.
body.zh: 她攒钱想买一把自己的吉他。

body.en: The old gun in the museum is behind glass.
body.zh: 博物馆里的旧枪陈列在玻璃后面。

body.en: He filled his water gun for a game in the garden.
body.zh: 他给水枪装了水，准备在花园里玩游戏。

body.en: We moved our basketball practice into the gym because of rain.
body.zh: 因为下雨，我们改到体育馆练篮球。

body.en: The new gym has space for two badminton courts.
body.zh: 新体育馆能容纳两个羽毛球场。

body.en: Reading before bed has become a pleasant habit for me.
body.zh: 睡前阅读已经成了我愉快的习惯。

body.en: I am trying to break the habit of biting my nails.
body.zh: 我正努力改掉咬指甲的习惯。

body.en: My hair was still wet when I left the pool.
body.zh: 我离开游泳池时，头发还湿着。

body.en: She tied her long hair back before painting.
body.zh: 画画前，她把长发扎在脑后。

body.en: I gave my sister half of my sandwich.
body.zh: 我把三明治的一半给了妹妹。

body.en: The bus will arrive in half an hour.
We waited in the school hall before the concert began.
body.zh: 音乐会开始前，我们在学校大厅等候。

body.en: Please leave your wet shoes near the front hall.
body.zh: 请把湿鞋放在前门厅附近。

body.en: I ordered a hamburger with tomatoes and a little cheese.
body.zh: 我点了一个加番茄和少量奶酪的汉堡。

body.en: Dad put a hamburger on each plate for lunch.
body.zh: 爸爸在每个盘子里放了一个汉堡当午餐。

body.en: Raise your hand if you know the answer to this question.
body.zh: 如果你知道这道题的答案，请举手。

body.en: Could you hand me the blue notebook from the desk?
body.zh: 你能把桌上的蓝色笔记本递给我吗？

body.en: My uncle looked handsome in his new blue suit.
body.zh: 叔叔穿上新的蓝色西装很英俊。

body.en: The actor played a handsome prince in the school film.
body.zh: 这位演员在学校的电影中扮演英俊的王子。

body.en: Please hang your coat on the hook by the door.
body.zh: 请把外套挂在门边的钩子上。

body.en: We hung colourful paper stars above the classroom window.
body.zh: 我们在教室窗户上方挂了彩色纸星星。

body.en: A funny thing happened on our way home from school.
body.zh: 我们放学回家的路上发生了一件有趣的事。

body.en: Accidents can happen when people do not look carefully.
body.zh: 人们不仔细观察时，事故可能会发生。

body.en: The children were happy to see their grandparents again.
body.zh: 孩子们再次见到祖父母很开心。

body.en: Reading beside the window makes me happy on rainy days.
body.zh: 雨天在窗边读书让我开心。

body.en: This bread is too hard for my little brother to bite.
body.zh: 这块面包太硬，我弟弟咬不动。

body.en: Our team worked hard to finish the project on time.
body.zh: 我们队努力按时完成了项目。

body.en: We could hardly see the road in the heavy rain.
body.zh: 大雨中，我们几乎看不见路。

body.en: Mia had hardly finished breakfast when the school bus arrived.
body.zh: 米娅刚吃完早饭，校车就到了。

body.en: Too much loud noise can harm your hearing.
body.zh: 过大的噪声会损害听力。

body.en: Please move the glass so it cannot cause any harm.
body.zh: 请把玻璃杯移开，以免造成伤害。

body.en: I wore a warm hat when we went outside in the snow.
body.zh: 我们冒雪出门时，我戴了一顶暖和的帽子。

body.en: The shop had a blue hat that matched my coat.
body.zh: 店里有一顶蓝帽子，和我的外套很相配。

body.en: I hate getting up early, but I enjoy the quiet morning walk.
body.zh: 我讨厌早起，但喜欢清晨安静地散步。

body.en: My brother hates loud music when he is doing homework.
body.zh: 我弟弟做作业时讨厌吵闹的音乐。

body.en: I have a small notebook for my new ideas.
body.zh: 我有一本记新点子的小笔记本。

body.en: My sister has two tickets for the school concert.
body.zh: 姐姐有两张学校音乐会的票。

body.en: He rides his bike to school when the weather is fine.
body.zh: 天气好的时候，他骑自行车上学。

body.en: I met a boy who said he could play the piano.
body.zh: 我遇到一个男孩，他说自己会弹钢琴。

body.en: Wear a hat to keep your head warm on cold mornings.
body.zh: 寒冷的早晨戴顶帽子，让头部暖和些。

body.en: Our team will head to the park after lunch.
body.zh: 午饭后我们队要去公园。

body.en: Walking to school is good for my health.
body.zh: 步行上学对我的健康有好处。

body.en: Our teacher reminded us to drink water for better health.
body.zh: 老师提醒我们多喝水，以保持健康。

body.en: A healthy breakfast helps me get ready for school.
body.zh: 健康的早餐帮助我准备好去上学。

body.en: We keep our dog healthy with walks and regular meals.
body.zh: 我们定时喂狗并带它散步，让它保持健康。

body.en: I can hear birds singing outside my window.
body.zh: 我能听见窗外有鸟在唱歌。

body.en: We heard the school bell while we were talking.
body.zh: 我们聊天时听到了学校的铃声。

body.en: My heart beats faster when I run in the school race.
body.zh: 参加学校赛跑时，我的心跳得更快。

body.en: I drew a red heart on the card for Mum.
body.zh: 我在送给妈妈的卡片上画了一颗红心。

body.en: The heat from the fire kept our room warm.
body.zh: 炉火的热量让房间保持温暖。

body.en: Dad heated the soup before we sat down for lunch.
body.zh: 我们坐下吃午饭前，爸爸热了汤。

body.en: This box is too heavy for me to lift alone.
body.zh: 这个箱子太重，我一个人搬不动。

body.en: Heavy rain kept us inside for most of the afternoon.
body.zh: 大雨让我们大半个下午都待在屋里。

body.en: We measured the height of the classroom door with a ruler.
body.zh: 我们用尺子量了教室门的高度。

body.en: The mountain's height made the climb difficult for our group.
body.zh: 这座山很高，我们一行人爬起来很吃力。

body.en: I said hello to our new neighbour this morning.
body.zh: 今天早上我向新邻居打了招呼。

body.en: She smiled and called hello from the garden gate.
body.zh: 她微笑着在花园门口打招呼。

body.en: Could you help me carry these books upstairs?
body.zh: 你能帮我把这些书搬上楼吗？

body.en: With your help, I found the answer to the question.
body.zh: 在你的帮助下，我找到了问题的答案。

body.en: The map was helpful when we visited the old town.
body.zh: 我们游览古镇时，这张地图很有用。

body.en: Our helpful neighbour showed us how to fix the gate.
body.zh: 热心的邻居教我们修院门。

body.en: The hen laid an egg beside the wooden fence.
body.zh: 母鸡在木栅栏旁下了一个蛋。

body.en: We watched the hen lead her chicks across the yard.
body.zh: 我们看着母鸡领小鸡走过院子。

body.en: I gave her my seat on the bus this morning.
body.zh: 今天早上我在公交车上把座位让给了她。

body.en: Her lunch box is on the shelf beside the door.
body.zh: 她的饭盒在门边的架子上。

body.en: Please sit here beside me during the school concert.
body.zh: 在学校音乐会上，请坐在这儿，挨着我。

body.en: Here is the lunch box you left in the classroom.
body.zh: 这是你落在教室里的饭盒。

body.en: The firefighter became a hero after rescuing the family.
body.zh: 消防员救出那家人后成了英雄。

body.en: The brave girl in this story is my favorite hero.
body.zh: 故事里勇敢的女孩是我最喜欢的主人公。

body.en: My coat is green, but hers is dark blue.
body.zh: 我的外套是绿色的，她的是深蓝色的。

body.en: I could not find my pen, so she lent me hers.
body.zh: 我找不到笔，她便把自己的借给了我。

body.en: Lily taught herself to play this song on the piano.
body.zh: 莉莉自学了这首钢琴曲。

body.en: My little sister can put on her shoes by herself.
I waved and said hi to my cousin at the station.
body.zh: 我在车站挥手向表亲打招呼。

body.en: Our new classmate said hi before sitting beside me.
body.zh: 新同学打了招呼，然后坐在我旁边。

body.en: The puppy hid under the table during the loud storm.
body.zh: 暴风雨很大时，小狗躲在桌子下面。

body.en: I hid the birthday card in a drawer so my sister could not find it.
body.zh: 我把生日卡藏在抽屉里，让姐姐找不到它。

body.en: We climbed a high hill to watch the sunrise.
body.zh: 我们爬上高高的山丘看日出。

body.en: The kite flew high above the trees in the park.
body.zh: 风筝在公园的树木上方高高飞起。

body.en: We plan to hike along the river this weekend.
body.zh: 我们打算这个周末沿河徒步。

body.en: Our class went on a hike through the green hills.
body.zh: 我们班到青翠的山间远足。

body.en: A small house stands at the top of the hill.
body.zh: 山丘顶上有一座小房子。

body.en: We rode our bikes slowly up the steep hill.
body.zh: 我们慢慢骑车上了陡峭的山坡。

body.en: at the foot of the hill
I gave him my extra pencil before the test began.
body.zh: 考试开始前，我把多余的铅笔给了他。

body.en: We saw him waiting outside the school gate after class.
body.zh: 下课后我们看见他在校门外等候。

body.en: Leo taught himself to play a simple song on the piano.
body.zh: 利奥自学会了用钢琴弹一首简单的曲子。

body.en: Dad himself fixed the loose handle on my bike.
body.zh: 爸爸亲自修好了我自行车上松动的把手。

body.en: Ben forgot his lunch, so I shared mine.
body.zh: 本忘带了他的午餐，所以我分了些给他。

body.en: His bike is parked beside the blue gate.
body.zh: 他的自行车停在蓝色大门旁边。

body.en: We learned about ancient China in history class.
body.zh: 我们在历史课上学习了中国古代史。

body.en: Grandpa told us the history of his old watch.
body.zh: 爷爷给我们讲了那块旧手表的来历。

body.en: The tennis ball hit the fence and rolled into the garden.
body.zh: 网球打中了栅栏，滚进了花园。

body.en: A strong wind hit our town during the night.
body.zh: 夜里一阵大风袭击了我们的小镇。

body.en: Drawing birds has become my favourite hobby this year.
body.zh: 画鸟成了我今年最喜欢的爱好。

body.en: My brother wants a hobby he can enjoy outdoors.
body.zh: 哥哥想找一种能在户外进行的爱好。

body.en: Please hold the door while I carry these books inside.
body.zh: 我把这些书搬进去时，请帮我扶住门。

body.en: Our school will hold a sports day next Friday.
body.zh: 我们学校下周五将举办运动会。

body.en: A little mouse made a hole in the old wooden door.
body.zh: 一只小老鼠在旧木门上打了个洞。

body.en: There is a hole in my sock, so I need to change it.
body.zh: 我的袜子破了个洞，所以得换一双。

body.en: We visited our cousins during the summer holiday.
body.zh: 暑假期间我们拜访了表亲。

body.en: Mum took a few photos on our holiday by the sea.
body.zh: 妈妈在我们的海边假期里拍了几张照片。

body.en: We walked home together after basketball practice.
body.zh: 篮球训练后我们一起步行回家。

body.en: My grandparents' home is near a quiet river.
body.zh: 我祖父母的家在一条安静的河边。

body.en: My hometown has a river and several old bridges.
body.zh: 我的家乡有一条河和几座古桥。

body.en: Grandpa often tells us stories about his hometown.
body.zh: 爷爷常给我们讲他家乡的故事。

body.en: I finished my homework before going out to play.
body.zh: 我完成作业后才出去玩。

body.en: Our teacher gave us less homework on Friday.
body.zh: 老师周五给我们布置了较少的作业。

body.en: Be honest and tell me what happened to the cup.
body.zh: 诚实地告诉我杯子出了什么事。

body.en: An honest friend tells the truth even when it is difficult.
body.zh: 诚实的朋友即使难以开口也会说真话。

body.en: Grandma added a little honey to her warm tea.
body.zh: 奶奶在温茶里加了一点蜂蜜。

body.en: The bees make honey from the flowers near our farm.
body.zh: 蜜蜂采我们农场附近的花来酿蜜。

body.en: It was an honour to meet the writer at our school.
body.zh: 能在学校见到这位作家，我感到荣幸。

body.en: We held a concert in honour of our retiring teacher.
body.zh: 我们举行音乐会，向即将退休的老师致敬。

body.en: I hope the weather stays sunny for our class picnic tomorrow.
body.zh: 我希望明天班级野餐时天气一直晴朗。

body.en: There is still hope that we can find the lost kitten.
body.zh: 我们仍有希望找到那只走失的小猫。

body.en: The brown horse drank water beside the farm gate.
body.zh: 棕色的马在农场门边喝水。

body.en: My aunt showed me how to ride a horse safely.
body.zh: 阿姨教我怎样安全地骑马。

body.en: My uncle works as a nurse at the local hospital.
body.zh: 我叔叔在当地医院当护士。

body.en: We visited Grandma in hospital after school yesterday.
body.zh: 昨天放学后，我们去医院看望了奶奶。

body.en: Our host showed us where to put our coats at the party.
body.zh: 聚会主人告诉我们外套该放在哪里。

body.en: A friendly hostess welcomed everyone to the school event.
body.zh: 一位友好的女主人欢迎大家参加学校活动。

body.en: The soup is still hot, so wait before you drink it.
We sat under a tree on the hot afternoon.
body.zh: 炎热的下午，我们坐在树荫下。

body.en: Our hotel was close to the beach and the station.
body.zh: 我们住的旅馆离海滩和车站都很近。

body.en: The hotel staff helped us find a quiet room.
body.zh: 旅馆员工帮我们找到了安静的房间。

body.en: It takes about an hour to walk from our home to school.
body.zh: 从我家走到学校大约要一个小时。

body.en: Our English class starts at the same hour every Tuesday.
body.zh: 我们的英语课每周二都在同一时间开始。

body.en: Our house has a small garden where we grow tomatoes.
body.zh: 我们家的房子有一个种番茄的小花园。

body.en: My aunt will house the visiting students for two nights.
body.zh: 我阿姨会让来访的学生在家住两晚。

body.en: We share the housework so everyone has time to rest.
body.zh: 我们分担家务，让每个人都有时间休息。

body.en: I do some housework after finishing my homework.
body.zh: 完成作业后，我会做些家务。

body.en: Can you show me how to make this paper boat?
body.zh: 你能教我怎么做这只纸船吗？

body.en: How many minutes does it take to walk to school?
body.zh: 步行到学校要多少分钟？

body.en: The walk was long; however, we enjoyed the mountain views.
body.zh: 路程很长，不过我们很喜欢山景。

body.en: However tired I felt, I finished my homework before bed.
body.zh: 不管我有多累，还是在睡前完成了作业。

body.en: Grandma gave me a warm hug at the station.
body.zh: 奶奶在车站热情地拥抱了我。

body.en: I hugged my brother when he returned from his trip.
body.zh: 弟弟旅行回来时，我拥抱了他。

body.en: A huge tree stands beside the entrance to our school.
body.zh: 学校入口旁有一棵巨大的树。

body.en: The museum has a huge model of a blue whale.
body.zh: 博物馆有一个巨大的蓝鲸模型。

body.en: Every human needs clean water and enough food.
body.zh: 每个人都需要干净的水和足够的食物。

body.en: Making mistakes is a normal part of being human.
Our teacher uses humour to make difficult lessons interesting.
body.zh: 老师用幽默让难懂的课变得有趣。

body.en: My uncle has a good sense of humour.
I felt hungry after playing football all afternoon.
body.zh: 踢了一下午足球后，我饿了。

body.en: The hungry cat waited beside its empty bowl.
body.zh: 饥饿的猫在空碗旁等着。

body.en: Some birds hunt for food during the night.
We had to hunt for my missing glove before leaving.
body.zh: 出门前，我们得找我丢失的手套。

body.en: Please hurry, or we will miss the school bus.
body.zh: 请快一点，否则我们会错过校车。

body.en: There is no hurry because the shop opens at nine.
body.zh: 不用着急，商店九点才开门。

body.en: My knee hurt after I fell off my bike.
body.zh: 我从自行车上摔下来后，膝盖很疼。

body.en: She did not mean to hurt her friend's feelings.
body.zh: 她不是有意伤害朋友的感情。

body.en: Her husband packed lunch for their daughter before school.
body.zh: 她丈夫在女儿上学前为她准备了午餐。

body.en: My uncle and his husband both enjoy gardening.
body.zh: 我的叔叔和他的丈夫都喜欢园艺。

body.en: There was a thin layer of ice on the pond.
Dad put some ice in the glass of lemonade.
body.zh: 爸爸在那杯柠檬水里放了些冰。

body.en: We ate ice cream in the shade after our walk.
body.zh: 散步后，我们在阴凉处吃了冰淇淋。

body.en: This shop makes ice cream with fresh strawberries.
body.zh: 这家店用新鲜草莓做冰淇淋。

body.en: I have an idea for our class science project.
body.zh: 我对班级的科学项目有个点子。

body.en: Her idea helped us save both paper and time.
body.zh: 她的办法帮我们既节省纸张又节省时间。

body.en: If it rains after school, Dad will bring an umbrella.
body.zh: 如果放学后下雨，爸爸会带把伞来。

body.en: Mia asked if the library was open on Sunday.
body.zh: 米娅问图书馆星期天是否开放。

body.en: Tom stayed at home because he felt ill.
body.zh: 汤姆感到不舒服，所以待在家里。

body.en: My aunt brought soup when I was ill last week.
body.zh: 上周我生病时，阿姨送来了汤。

body.en: She missed two days of school because of an illness.
The nurse explained how rest could help during his illness.
body.zh: 护士解释了休息如何帮助他养病。

body.en: Imagine a garden full of flowers of every colour.
body.zh: 想象一座开满各种颜色花朵的花园。

body.en: I cannot imagine living in a house without windows.
body.zh: 我无法想象住在没有窗户的房子里。

body.en: Getting enough sleep is important for growing students.
body.zh: 充足的睡眠对正在成长的学生很重要。

body.en: Please write down the important dates for our class trip.
body.zh: 请记下我们班旅行的重要日期。

body.en: It is impossible to finish this puzzle without looking carefully.
body.zh: 不仔细观察就不可能完成这道拼图。

body.en: Dad said it was impossible to drive through the flooded road.
body.zh: 爸爸说开车通过被水淹的道路是不可能的。

body.en: Reading aloud can help me improve my English.
body.zh: 大声朗读能帮助我提高英语水平。

body.en: Our team improved its plan after listening to everyone's ideas.
body.zh: 听取大家的想法后，我们队改进了计划。

body.en: There are three clean cups in the cupboard.
body.zh: 碗柜里有三个干净的杯子。

body.en: We usually go swimming in the summer holidays.
body.zh: 我们通常在暑假里去游泳。

body.en: The lunch menu includes rice, vegetables, and a bowl of soup.
body.zh: 午餐菜单包括米饭、蔬菜和一碗汤。

body.en: Please include your name when you send the school form.
body.zh: 发送学校表格时请写上你的名字。

body.en: The number of birds in our garden increased this spring.
body.zh: 今年春天，我们花园里的鸟变多了。

body.en: We can increase our reading time by putting phones away.
body.zh: 把手机收起来，我们就能增加阅读时间。

body.en: My uncle works in the food industry and visits many farms.
body.zh: 我叔叔在食品行业工作，经常拜访许多农场。

body.en: The town's history includes the growth of its textile industry.
body.zh: 这座小镇的历史包括纺织业的发展。

body.en: My older sister's kindness had a good influence on me.
body.zh: 姐姐的善良对我产生了积极影响。

body.en: Friends can influence the music we enjoy listening to.
body.zh: 朋友可能会影响我们喜欢听的音乐。

body.en: The teacher gave us information about the school trip.
body.zh: 老师告诉了我们有关学校旅行的信息。

body.en: You can find bus information on this map.
body.zh: 你可以在这张地图上查到公交信息。

body.en: A tiny insect landed on the leaf beside me.
body.zh: 一只小昆虫落在我旁边的叶子上。

body.en: We drew the insect carefully before letting it go.
body.zh: 我们仔细画下这只昆虫，然后放走了它。

body.en: The children stayed inside because it was raining.
body.zh: 因为下雨，孩子们待在屋里。

body.en: I found a small note inside the birthday card.
body.zh: 我在生日卡里发现了一张小便条。

body.en: We walked home instead of waiting for the bus.
body.zh: 我们没有等公交车，而是走路回家。

body.en: There was no orange juice, so I chose water instead.
body.zh: 没有橙汁，所以我改选了水。

body.en: Read the instructions before you start building the model plane.
body.zh: 开始拼装模型飞机前先阅读说明。

body.en: Our coach gave us clear instructions for the relay race.
body.zh: 教练给我们讲清了接力赛的要求。

body.en: Ella practices the piano, her favorite musical instrument, every day.
body.zh: 埃拉每天练习她最喜欢的乐器钢琴。

body.en: The doctor used a small instrument to check my ear.
body.zh: 医生用一件小工具检查我的耳朵。

body.en: My interest in space began after I read a book about planets.
body.zh: 我读了一本关于行星的书后，开始对太空感兴趣。

body.en: This science show may interest students who enjoy building things.
body.zh: 这档科学节目可能会让喜欢动手制作的学生感兴趣。

body.en: The museum guide told us an interesting story.
body.zh: 博物馆讲解员给我们讲了一个有趣的故事。

body.en: I found the book interesting from the first page.
body.zh: 我从第一页起就觉得这本书有趣。

body.en: Our school held an international food day with dishes from many countries.
body.zh: 我们学校举办了国际美食日，展示许多国家的菜肴。

body.en: My cousin made friends with international students at summer camp.
body.zh: 我表亲在夏令营结识了外国学生。

body.en: Our school reporter will interview the new music teacher.
body.zh: 我们学校的小记者将采访新来的音乐老师。

body.en: My sister prepared carefully for her first job interview.
body.zh: 姐姐认真准备了她的第一次求职面试。

body.en: The puppy ran into the kitchen when I called it.
body.zh: 我叫小狗时，它跑进了厨房。

body.en: Our science club turned an old box into a birdhouse.
body.zh: 我们的科学社把一个旧箱子改成了鸟屋。

body.en: Our teacher introduced the new student to the class this morning.
body.zh: 今天早上老师把新同学介绍给全班。

body.en: Dad introduced a simple rule to help us save water at home.
body.zh: 爸爸提出了一条简单的规则，帮助我们在家节约用水。

body.en: The students tried to invent a machine that sorts rubbish.
body.zh: 学生们尝试发明一台分类垃圾的机器。

body.en: Our team invented a new game using coloured cards.
body.zh: 我们队用彩色卡片创造了一种新游戏。

body.en: Lucy invited her classmates to her birthday party.
body.zh: 露西邀请同学们参加她的生日派对。

body.en: Our teacher invited a local writer to speak to the class.
body.zh: 老师邀请了一位当地作家给全班讲话。

body.en: We took a small boat to the island during our summer holiday.
body.zh: 暑假期间我们乘小船去了那座岛。

body.en: A tiny island sits in the middle of the lake near our town.
body.zh: 我们镇附近的湖中央有一座小岛。

body.en: The puppy was tired, so it slept beside my chair.
body.zh: 小狗累了，便睡在我的椅子旁。

body.en: I borrowed a book and returned it the next day.
body.zh: 我借了一本书，第二天就还了。

body.en: The cat cleaned its paws after playing in the garden.
body.zh: 猫在花园里玩耍后舔干净了自己的爪子。

body.en: Our school opened its new library to students yesterday.
body.zh: 我们学校昨天向学生开放了新图书馆。

body.en: The little cat cleaned itself after playing in the garden.
body.zh: 小猫在花园里玩耍后自己清理了身体。

body.en: The door itself is easy to open, but the lock is stuck.
body.zh: 门本身很容易打开，但锁卡住了。

body.en: Take a jacket because it may get cold later.
body.zh: 带件夹克吧，晚些时候可能会冷。

body.en: My blue jacket has two deep pockets for my gloves.
body.zh: 我的蓝夹克有两个能放手套的深口袋。

body.en: These jeans are too short for me now.
body.zh: 这条牛仔裤现在对我来说太短了。

body.en: My brother wore jeans and a white shirt to the picnic.
body.zh: 哥哥穿牛仔裤和白衬衫去野餐。

body.en: My aunt got a new job at the library.
body.zh: 阿姨在图书馆找到了一份新工作。

body.en: It is my job to water the classroom plants.
body.zh: 给教室里的植物浇水是我的任务。

body.en: Dad likes to jog along the river before breakfast.
body.zh: 爸爸喜欢早饭前沿河慢跑。

body.en: We went for a gentle jog around the park.
body.zh: 我们在公园里轻松地慢跑了一圈。

body.en: Would you like to join our table tennis club after school?
body.zh: 你放学后想加入我们的乒乓球俱乐部吗？

body.en: Two small streams join near the old stone bridge.
body.zh: 两条小溪在那座旧石桥附近汇合。

body.en: His funny joke made everyone at the table laugh.
body.zh: 他有趣的笑话让桌边每个人都笑了。

body.en: Please do not joke about things that upset your friends.
body.zh: 请别拿让朋友难过的事情开玩笑。

body.en: The train journey took us through several beautiful valleys.
body.zh: 这趟火车旅程带我们穿过几座美丽的山谷。

body.en: We packed sandwiches for the long journey to the coast.
body.zh: 我们为去海边的长途旅行带了三明治。

body.en: She smiled with joy when she saw her new puppy.
body.zh: 看到自己的新小狗时，她高兴地笑了。

body.en: Playing music together brings our family a lot of joy.
body.zh: 一起演奏音乐给我们家带来了许多欢乐。

body.en: The judge listened carefully to both sides in court.
body.zh: 法官在法庭上仔细听取了双方的陈述。

body.en: We should not judge a person by their clothes.
body.zh: 我们不应该以衣着来评判一个人。

body.en: Mum poured apple juice into three small glasses.
body.zh: 妈妈把苹果汁倒进了三个小玻璃杯。

body.en: We squeezed the oranges to make fresh juice.
body.zh: 我们把橙子榨成了新鲜果汁。

body.en: The dog can jump over the low garden wall.
body.zh: 这只狗能跳过花园的矮墙。

body.en: I heard a sudden noise and jumped in surprise.
body.zh: 我突然听到声音，吃惊地跳了起来。

body.en: My cousin starts junior high school this September.
body.zh: 我表弟今年九月开始上初中。

body.en: The sports centre has a swimming class for junior members.
body.zh: 体育中心为少年会员开设了游泳课。

body.en: We just got home, so our coats are still wet.
body.zh: 我们刚到家，所以外套还是湿的。

body.en: You need just one clean cup for the juice.
body.zh: 这果汁只需要一个干净的杯子。

body.en: Please keep your shoes away from the open fire.
She kept the postcard in a box under her bed.
body.zh: 她把明信片保存在床下的盒子里。

body.en: I found the missing key under the kitchen table.
body.zh: 我在厨房桌子下面找到了丢失的钥匙。

body.en: Careful listening is the key to understanding this story.
body.zh: 认真听是理解这个故事的关键。

body.en: I cleaned my keyboard before starting my homework.
body.zh: 开始做作业前，我清洁了键盘。

body.en: Press this button on the keyboard to move the picture.
body.zh: 按键盘上的这个键可以移动图片。

body.en: Ben kicked the ball into the goal during the game.
body.zh: 比赛中，本把球踢进了球门。

body.en: Please do not kick the desk when you are upset.
body.zh: 你心情不好时，请不要踢桌子。

body.en: The kids built a small bridge across the stream.
body.zh: 孩子们在小溪上搭了一座小桥。

body.en: A young kid stood close to its mother on the farm.
body.zh: 农场里，一只小山羊紧挨着妈妈站着。

body.en: Very cold weather can kill the young plants in our garden.
body.zh: 严寒会冻死我们花园里的幼苗。

body.en: We played a word game to kill time on the train.
body.zh: 我们在火车上玩单词游戏消磨时间。

body.en: We bought a kilo of apples at the market.
body.zh: 我们在市场买了一公斤苹果。

body.en: This bag of rice weighs five kilos altogether.
Our school is about a kilometre from the station.
body.zh: 我们学校离车站大约一公里。

body.en: We walked three kilometres before stopping beside the lake.
body.zh: 我们走了三公里才在湖边停下。

body.en: Our kind teacher stayed after class to help me with math.
body.zh: 我们和蔼的老师课后留下来帮我学数学。

body.en: What kind of fruit do you want in your lunch box?
body.zh: 你想在午餐盒里放哪种水果？

body.en: The king in the story lived in a stone castle.
body.zh: 故事里的国王住在石头城堡中。

body.en: My brother played the king in our school play.
body.zh: 哥哥在学校的戏剧中扮演国王。

body.en: Mum gave the baby a gentle kiss on the cheek.
body.zh: 妈妈轻轻亲了亲宝宝的脸颊。

body.en: I kissed Grandma goodbye before getting on the train.
body.zh: 上火车前，我亲吻奶奶向她道别。

body.en: We made soup together in our bright new kitchen.
body.zh: 我们在明亮的新厨房里一起做了汤。

body.en: Please carry these clean plates into the kitchen.
body.zh: 请把这些干净的盘子端进厨房。

body.en: My red kite flew high above the beach.
body.zh: 我的红风筝在海滩上方高高飞起。

body.en: We made a kite from paper and thin sticks.
body.zh: 我们用纸和细木棍做了一个风筝。

body.en: I fell on the grass and hurt my knee during football practice.
body.zh: 足球训练时我摔在草地上，伤了膝盖。

body.en: Please bend your knees before you pick up the box.
body.zh: 捡起箱子前请弯曲膝盖。

body.en: Dad used a knife to cut the birthday cake.
Please put the clean knives beside the plates.
body.zh: 请把干净的餐刀放在盘子旁边。

body.en: Please knock before you open the classroom door.
body.zh: 请先敲门，再打开教室的门。

body.en: We heard a quiet knock while we were eating dinner.
body.zh: 吃晚饭时，我们听到了轻轻的敲门声。

body.en: I know the way to the library, so we can walk there together.
body.zh: 我知道去图书馆的路，所以我们可以一起走过去。

body.en: Mia knows our new classmate from primary school.
body.zh: 米娅从小学时就认识我们的新同学。

body.en: Reading helps us gain knowledge about the world.
body.zh: 阅读帮助我们获得关于世界的知识。

body.en: She shared her knowledge of plants during our walk.
body.zh: 散步时，她分享了自己关于植物的知识。

body.en: My cousin practises kung fu at the sports centre.
body.zh: 我表哥在体育中心练功夫。

body.en: We watched a kung fu show during the school festival.
body.zh: 我们在校园节庆活动中看了功夫表演。

body.en: Our science teacher showed us around the new lab.
body.zh: 科学老师带我们参观了新实验室。

body.en: We must follow the safety rules in the lab.
body.zh: 我们必须遵守实验室的安全规定。

body.en: The lady at the front desk helped us find the school office.
body.zh: 前台的女士帮我们找到了学校办公室。

body.en: An old lady gave the children some apples from her garden.
body.zh: 一位老妇人把花园里的几个苹果送给了孩子们。

body.en: The lake looked silver in the early morning light.
body.zh: 湖泊在清晨的阳光下泛着银色。

body.en: We walked around the lake and watched the ducks.
body.zh: 我们绕湖散步，看了鸭子。

body.en: I turned on the lamp beside my bed.
This small lamp gives enough light for reading.
body.zh: 这盏小灯的亮度足够用来阅读。

body.en: The plane will land at the airport before sunset today.
body.zh: 飞机今天日落前会在机场降落。

body.en: Our class planted flowers on the land behind the library.
body.zh: 我们班在图书馆后面的土地上种了花。

body.en: We painted the green landscape we saw from the train window.
body.zh: 我们画下了从火车窗外看到的绿色风景。

body.en: The mountain landscape looked beautiful after the rain.
body.zh: 雨后的山间风景看起来很美。

body.en: English is the language we use in class on Mondays.
body.zh: 英语是我们周一上课使用的语言。

body.en: Please use kind language when you talk to your classmates.
body.zh: 和同学交谈时，请使用友善的措辞。

body.en: We hung a red lantern outside our front door.
body.zh: 我们在家门外挂了一盏红灯笼。

body.en: The children made paper lanterns for the evening festival.
body.zh: 孩子们为晚上的节庆活动做了纸灯笼。

body.en: My sister uses her laptop to write school reports.
body.zh: 姐姐用笔记本电脑写学校报告。

body.en: Please close the laptop before you put it in the bag.
body.zh: 请合上笔记本电脑，再把它放进包里。

body.en: A large dog waited patiently beside the gate.
body.zh: 一只大狗耐心地等在大门旁。

body.en: Our class collected a large amount of paper for recycling.
body.zh: 我们班收集了大量纸张用于回收。

body.en: This is the last page of my favourite story.
body.zh: 这是我最喜欢的故事的最后一页。

body.en: The concert will last about an hour tonight.
body.zh: 今晚的音乐会将持续大约一小时。

body.en: We were late because the bus stopped in heavy traffic.
body.zh: 因为公交车堵在路上，我们迟到了。

body.en: My brother stayed up late to finish his model plane.
body.zh: 哥哥熬夜完成了他的飞机模型。

body.en: We can finish the poster later, after we eat lunch.
body.zh: 我们可以晚些时候吃完午饭再完成海报。

body.en: I saw my cousin at the shop later that afternoon.
body.zh: 那天下午晚些时候，我在商店见到了表弟。

body.en: We all laughed when the puppy chased its own tail.
body.zh: 小狗追着自己的尾巴跑，把我们都逗笑了。

body.en: Her cheerful laugh made the whole room feel friendly.
body.zh: 她欢快的笑声让整个房间的气氛都亲切起来。

body.en: The new law helps keep drivers and children safe on the road.
body.zh: 这项新法律有助于保障司机和孩子们的道路安全。

body.en: Our class discussed a law about keeping parks clean.
body.zh: 我们班讨论了一项关于保持公园清洁的法律。

body.en: My aunt is a lawyer who helps people understand the law.
body.zh: 阿姨是一位帮助人们了解法律的律师。

body.en: The lawyer listened carefully before giving the family advice.
body.zh: 律师认真听完后，给这家人提出了建议。

body.en: Please lay the clean towels on the chair.
body.zh: 请把干净的毛巾放在椅子上。

body.en: Our hens lay eggs in a quiet corner of the barn.
body.zh: 我们的母鸡在谷仓安静的角落里下蛋。

body.en: The lazy cat spent the afternoon asleep on the sofa.
body.zh: 这只懒猫整个下午都在沙发上睡觉。

body.en: We enjoyed a lazy morning after our long journey.
body.zh: 长途旅行后，我们悠闲地度过了一个早晨。

body.en: Our guide will lead us to the lake.
body.zh: 我们的向导会带我们去湖边。

body.en: A clear map can lead you to the museum.
body.zh: 清晰的地图能带你找到博物馆。

body.en: A yellow leaf landed on my notebook during the walk.
body.zh: 散步时，一片黄叶落在我的笔记本上。

body.en: The tree has many green leaves after the spring rain.
body.zh: 春雨过后，树上长出了许多绿叶。

body.en: We learn a new song in music class each week.
body.zh: 我们每周在音乐课上学一首新歌。

body.en: I learned how to make noodles from my grandmother.
body.zh: 我向奶奶学会了做面条。

body.en: I used the least amount of sugar in my tea.
body.zh: 我在茶里只放了最少的糖。

body.en: This is the least expensive lunch on the menu.
body.zh: 这是菜单上最便宜的一份午餐。

body.en: We must leave home early to catch the train.
body.zh: 我们必须早点出门才能赶上火车。

body.en: Please leave some cake for your sister after dinner.
body.zh: 晚饭后请给妹妹留一点蛋糕。

body.en: Turn left at the next corner to reach the library.
body.zh: 在下一个路口左转就能到图书馆。

body.en: My left shoe has a small hole near the toe.
body.zh: 我的左脚鞋子鞋头附近有个小洞。

body.en: My legs felt tired after the long walk.
body.zh: 走了很久以后，我的腿感到很累。

body.en: One leg of the old table is shorter than the others.
body.zh: 旧桌子的一条腿比其他几条短。

body.en: I put a slice of lemon in my water.
body.zh: 我在水里放了一片柠檬。

body.en: The yellow lemon smelled fresh when Dad cut it open.
body.zh: 爸爸切开黄色柠檬时，它散发着清新的气味。

body.en: Could you lend me your ruler for a minute?
body.zh: 你能把尺子借给我用一会儿吗？

body.en: She lent her brother a book about space.
body.zh: 她借给弟弟一本关于太空的书。

body.en: I spend less time on games when I have a test tomorrow.
body.zh: 明天有考试时，我玩游戏的时间会少一些。

body.en: This bag weighs less than my old schoolbag.
body.zh: 这个包比我的旧书包轻。

body.en: Our first lesson on Monday is English this term.
body.zh: 这学期我们周一的第一节课是英语。

body.en: Losing my wallet taught me a lesson about being careful.
body.zh: 丢钱包这件事教会了我要细心。

body.en: Please let me know when you arrive at the station.
body.zh: 到车站后，请告诉我一声。

body.en: Mum let us play outside after we finished our homework.
body.zh: 我们完成作业后，妈妈让我们出去玩。

body.en: I wrote a letter to my cousin in another city.
body.zh: 我给住在另一座城市的表亲写了信。

body.en: Write the first letter of your name on the card.
body.zh: 请在卡片上写下你名字的首字母。

body.en: The water level in the bottle is very low.
This game has a new level with harder puzzles.
body.zh: 这个游戏有一关新的谜题，难度更高。

body.en: We borrowed three books from the school library.
body.zh: 我们从学校图书馆借了三本书。

body.en: The library has a quiet corner for young readers.
body.zh: 图书馆为小读者设有一个安静的角落。

body.en: I like to lie on the grass and watch the clouds.
body.zh: 我喜欢躺在草地上看云。

body.en: The small shop lies across the street from our school.
body.zh: 那家小商店在我们学校街对面。

body.en: Grandpa tells us stories about his life on the farm.
body.zh: 爷爷给我们讲他在农场生活的故事。

body.en: Plants need sunlight and water to support their life.
body.zh: 植物需要阳光和水来维持生命。

body.en: Please lift the box carefully and put it on the table.
body.zh: 请小心地把箱子举起来，放到桌上。

body.en: We took the lift to the fifth floor of the hotel.
body.zh: 我们乘电梯到了酒店五楼。

body.en: Please turn on the light so we can see the map.
body.zh: 请开灯，让我们能看清地图。

body.en: This bag is light enough for my little sister to carry.
body.zh: 这个包很轻，我妹妹也提得动。

body.en: A flash of lightning lit up the dark sky.
body.zh: 一道闪电照亮了漆黑的天空。

body.en: We went indoors when we saw lightning over the hills.
body.zh: 看到山上的闪电后，我们进了屋。

body.en: I like reading comics before bed on rainy evenings.
body.zh: 我喜欢在下雨的晚上睡前看漫画。

body.en: Would you like some apple juice with your lunch?
body.zh: 午饭时你想喝些苹果汁吗？

body.en: It is likely to rain this afternoon, so bring your coat.
body.zh: 今天下午可能会下雨，所以带上外套。

body.en: The team is likely to finish its game before dinner.
body.zh: 这支队伍很可能在晚饭前结束比赛。

body.en: Please stand in line while we wait for the school bus.
Draw a straight line between the two points on the map.
body.zh: 在地图上的两个点之间画一条直线。

body.en: The lion rested in the shade beside a tree.
body.zh: 狮子在树旁的阴凉处休息。

body.en: We watched a film about lions living in Africa.
body.zh: 我们看了一部讲非洲狮子生活的电影。

body.en: I made a shopping list before we went to the supermarket.
body.zh: 去超市前，我列了一张购物清单。

body.en: Please list three animals that live near your home.
body.zh: 请列出三种生活在你家附近的动物。

body.en: Please listen carefully while your classmate explains the answer.
body.zh: 同学解释答案时，请仔细听。

body.en: I like to listen to soft music before bed.
body.zh: 我喜欢睡前听轻柔的音乐。

body.en: Our teacher read a short piece of literature aloud during class.
body.zh: 老师在课堂上朗读了一篇短篇文学作品。

body.en: I enjoy Chinese literature because its stories make me think.
body.zh: 我喜欢中国文学，因为其中的故事引人思考。

body.en: We picked up litter along the path after the picnic.
body.zh: 野餐后，我们捡起了小路上的垃圾。

body.en: Please do not litter when you visit the beach.
body.zh: 到海滩游玩时，请不要乱扔垃圾。

body.en: There is little milk left, so we need to buy more.
body.zh: 牛奶所剩不多了，所以我们得再买一些。

body.en: My little brother can tie his shoes by himself now.
body.zh: 我弟弟现在能自己系鞋带了。

body.en: My cousins live in a small town near the mountains.
body.zh: 我的表兄弟姐妹住在山附近的小镇。

body.en: The school concert will be shown live on local television tonight.
body.zh: 学校音乐会今晚将在当地电视台现场直播。

body.en: Our lively puppy runs around the garden every morning.
body.zh: 我们活泼的小狗每天早上都在花园里奔跑。

body.en: The class had a lively discussion about the story's ending.
body.zh: 全班热烈讨论了故事的结局。

body.en: We buy fresh eggs from a local farm near our town.
body.zh: 我们从镇子附近的当地农场买新鲜鸡蛋。

body.en: The local library opens early on Saturday mornings.
body.zh: 当地的图书馆星期六早上开门很早。

body.en: Remember to lock the door before you leave home.
The key would not turn in the old lock.
I felt lonely when my best friend moved away.
body.zh: 最好的朋友搬走后，我感到孤独。

body.en: A friendly smile can help a lonely person feel welcome.
body.zh: 友善的微笑能让孤独的人感到被接纳。

body.en: We waited a long time for the school play to begin.
body.zh: 我们等了很久，学校话剧才开始。

body.en: My sister has long wanted to visit the ocean.
body.zh: 我姐姐一直很想去海边看看。

body.en: Look at the sky; dark clouds are coming from the west.
body.zh: 看看天空，乌云正从西边飘来。

body.en: You look tired, so let's sit down and drink some water.
body.zh: 你看起来累了，我们坐下喝点水吧。

body.en: I do not want to lose the library book I borrowed yesterday.
body.zh: 我不想弄丢昨天借的图书馆藏书。

body.en: Our team may lose the match, but we will keep trying.
body.zh: 我们队可能会输掉比赛，但我们会继续努力。

body.en: The loss of my notebook made me feel upset.
body.zh: 丢了笔记本让我很难过。

body.en: Our team learned a lot from its first loss.
body.zh: 我们队从第一次失利中学到了很多。

body.en: We found a lost dog near the school gate.
body.zh: 我们在校门附近发现了一只走失的狗。

body.en: I got lost because I took the wrong bus.
body.zh: 我因为坐错公交车而迷路了。

body.en: There are a lot of books on the table for our group.
body.zh: 桌上有很多书，是给我们小组的。

body.en: We drew lots to decide who would go first in the game.
body.zh: 我们抽签决定谁在游戏中先开始。

body.en: A loud noise woke me up before sunrise.
body.zh: 日出前，一阵巨响把我吵醒了。

body.en: The music was too loud for us to talk comfortably.
body.zh: 音乐太响，我们没法轻松地交谈。

body.en: I love reading stories with my little brother.
body.zh: 我喜欢和弟弟一起读故事。

body.en: Grandma showed her love by making our favourite meal.
body.zh: 奶奶做了我们最爱吃的饭来表达关爱。

body.en: We had a lovely afternoon in the riverside park.
body.zh: 我们在河边公园度过了愉快的下午。

body.en: The lovely little kitten slept in a warm basket.
body.zh: 可爱的小猫睡在温暖的篮子里。

body.en: The little table is low enough for my sister to reach.
body.zh: 这张小桌子够低，妹妹能够得着。

body.en: The sun was low when we walked home.
body.zh: 我们走回家时，太阳已经很低了。

body.en: Good luck with your music exam tomorrow morning!
body.zh: 祝你明天上午音乐考试顺利！

body.en: By luck, we found the missing ball under a bench.
body.zh: 我们碰巧在长椅下找到了丢失的球。

body.en: We usually eat lunch in the school dining hall.
body.zh: 我们通常在学校食堂吃午饭。

body.en: I packed a sandwich and an apple for lunch.
body.zh: 我带了一个三明治和一个苹果当午饭。

body.en: This machine helps farmers sort apples by size.
body.zh: 这台机器帮助农民按大小分拣苹果。

body.en: The washing machine stopped when I opened its door.
body.zh: 我打开门时，洗衣机停止了运转。

body.en: Dad was mad when he saw the broken window.
body.zh: 爸爸看到破窗户时很生气。

body.en: My cousin is mad about football and never misses a match.
body.zh: 表哥痴迷足球，从不错过比赛。

body.en: Can I help you carry that heavy bag, madam?
body.zh: 女士，我能帮您提那个重包吗？

body.en: The waiter said, "Your table is ready, madam."
body.zh: 服务员说，女士，您的餐桌准备好了。

body.en: I read a magazine about animals on the train.
body.zh: 我在火车上读了一本动物杂志。

body.en: This magazine has a page of science questions for children.
body.zh: 这本杂志有一页给孩子们的科学问题。

body.en: The magician performed a magic trick with three cards.
body.zh: 魔术师用三张卡片表演了一个魔术。

body.en: In the story, a magic ring made the boy invisible.
body.zh: 故事里，一枚魔法戒指让男孩隐形了。

body.en: The main entrance to the museum is on this street.
body.zh: 博物馆的主要入口在这条街上。

body.en: Our main aim is to finish the project together.
body.zh: 我们的主要目标是一起完成这个项目。

body.en: We made a paper lantern together for the school festival.
body.zh: 我们一起为校园节日做了一盏纸灯笼。

body.en: Loud music can make it hard to hear the teacher.
body.zh: 音乐太响会让人难以听见老师说话。

body.en: We met our cousins at the shopping mall yesterday.
body.zh: 昨天我们在购物中心见到了表亲。

body.en: The mall has a bookshop beside its largest restaurant.
body.zh: 购物中心最大的餐馆旁有一家书店。

body.en: A man helped us carry the heavy box into the house.
body.zh: 一位男士帮我们把重箱子搬进了屋。

body.en: The two men waited for the bus under the rain shelter.
body.zh: 两位男士在雨棚下等公交车。

body.en: She manages a small bookshop near the station.
body.zh: 她管理着车站附近的一家小书店。

body.en: We managed to finish the model before the school fair.
body.zh: 我们设法在学校展览会前完成了模型。

body.en: She spoke in a friendly manner when the new student arrived.
body.zh: 新同学到来时，她亲切地和他说话。

body.en: Good table manners make family meals more pleasant.
body.zh: 良好的餐桌礼仪让家庭用餐更愉快。

body.en: Many students walk to school together on sunny mornings.
body.zh: 许多学生在晴朗的早晨一起步行上学。

body.en: We saw many birds near the lake during our picnic.
body.zh: 野餐时我们在湖边看到了许多鸟。

body.en: We followed the map to find the old bridge.
body.zh: 我们按照地图找到了那座古桥。

body.en: This map shows all the rivers in our county.
body.zh: 这张地图标出了我们县所有的河流。

body.en: Please mark the correct answer with a small circle.
body.zh: 请用一个小圆圈标出正确答案。

body.en: There was a muddy mark on my clean shirt.
body.zh: 我干净的衬衫上有一处泥渍。

body.en: We bought apples and carrots at the market this morning.
body.zh: 今天早上我们在市场买了苹果和胡萝卜。

body.en: The weekend market near our home sells fresh vegetables.
body.zh: 我们家附近的周末集市卖新鲜蔬菜。

body.en: My aunt will marry her best friend next spring.
body.zh: 我阿姨明年春天会和她最好的朋友结婚。

body.en: In the story, the prince married a kind village girl.
body.zh: 故事里，王子娶了一位善良的村庄女孩。

body.en: It takes regular practice to master a new skill.
body.zh: 掌握一项新技能需要经常练习。

body.en: The master showed the young artist how to mix colours.
body.zh: 大师向年轻画家展示了怎样调色。

body.en: Our football match begins at three o'clock this afternoon.
body.zh: 我们的足球赛今天下午三点开始。

body.en: These blue socks match my new school uniform.
body.zh: 这双蓝袜子和我的新校服很相配。

body.en: We used recycled material to make a bird feeder in class.
body.zh: 我们在课堂上用回收材料制作了一个喂鸟器。

body.en: Cotton is a soft material for summer shirts.
body.zh: 棉花是一种适合做夏季衬衫的柔软材料。

body.en: Maths is my first lesson on Tuesday mornings.
body.zh: 周二上午，我的第一节课是数学。

body.en: Our maths teacher showed us a different way to solve it.
body.zh: 数学老师给我们展示了另一种解题方法。

body.en: It does not matter if your drawing is not perfect.
body.zh: 你的画不完美也没关系。

body.en: This small key matters because it opens the garden gate.
body.zh: 这把小钥匙很重要，因为它能打开花园门。

body.en: You may borrow my book until next Friday.
body.zh: 你可以借用我的书到下周五。

body.en: Take an umbrella because it may rain this afternoon.
body.zh: 带把伞吧，今天下午可能下雨。

body.en: Maybe we can ride our bikes to the park this afternoon.
body.zh: 也许今天下午我们可以骑车去公园。

body.en: The bus is late, so maybe Dad will drive us to school.
body.zh: 公交车晚点了，所以爸爸或许会开车送我们上学。

body.en: My brother gave me his seat on the crowded bus.
body.zh: 拥挤的公交车上，哥哥把座位让给了我。

body.en: Could you help me carry these books to the classroom?
body.zh: 你能帮我把这些书搬到教室吗？

body.en: We shared a warm meal after the long journey.
body.zh: 长途旅行后，我们一起吃了一顿热饭。

body.en: Breakfast is an important meal before a busy school day.
body.zh: 开始忙碌的上学日之前，早餐是重要的一餐。

body.en: What does this sign mean beside the school gate?
body.zh: 校门旁这个标志是什么意思？

body.en: I did not mean to leave you waiting outside.
body.zh: 我不是有意让你在外面等的。

body.en: I looked up the meaning of the new word in a dictionary.
body.zh: 我在词典里查了这个新单词的意思。

body.en: The red light has a special meaning in this game.
body.zh: 在这个游戏里，红灯有特殊含义。

body.en: We bought fresh meat and vegetables for dinner.
body.zh: 我们买了新鲜的肉和蔬菜做晚饭。

body.en: Dad cut the meat into small pieces for the soup.
body.zh: 爸爸把肉切成小块用来煮汤。

body.en: She won a medal in the school swimming race.
body.zh: 她在学校游泳比赛中赢得了一枚奖牌。

body.en: The runner showed his gold medal to the cheering crowd.
body.zh: 跑步选手向欢呼的人群展示了他的金牌。

body.en: The school nurse gave me medical help after I hurt my knee.
body.zh: 我膝盖受伤后，校医给了我医疗帮助。

body.en: My brother wants to study medical science when he grows up.
body.zh: 我哥哥长大后想学习医学。

body.en: The doctor gave me medicine for my cough and told me to rest.
body.zh: 医生给我开了治咳嗽的药，并让我休息。

body.en: My sister wants to study medicine when she finishes school.
body.zh: 我姐姐想在毕业后学习医学。

body.en: I need a medium shirt because the small one is tight.
body.zh: 我需要中号衬衫，小号的太紧了。

body.en: Television is a medium for sharing news and stories.
body.zh: 电视是一种传播新闻和故事的媒介。

body.en: I will meet my cousin at the library after school.
body.zh: 放学后，我会在图书馆和一位表亲见面。

body.en: Our class met the new music teacher this morning.
body.zh: 今天早上我们班见到了新来的音乐老师。

body.en: Our class meeting starts after lunch in the music room.
body.zh: 我们的班会午饭后在音乐教室开始。

body.en: I had a meeting with my teacher to talk about the school play.
body.zh: 我和老师见面讨论了学校话剧。

body.en: Each member of our team brought a snack to share.
body.zh: 我们队的每个成员都带了零食来分享。

body.en: My uncle became a member of the local swimming club.
body.zh: 我叔叔成了当地游泳俱乐部的一名会员。

body.en: Did you mention the school trip in your letter?
body.zh: 你在信里提到学校旅行了吗？

body.en: She mentioned that her brother was learning to swim.
body.zh: 她提到她的弟弟正在学游泳。

body.en: The menu has several dishes without meat.
body.zh: 菜单上有几道不含肉的菜。

body.en: I chose tomato soup after reading the menu.
body.zh: 看过菜单后，我选了番茄汤。

body.en: My desk was a mess after the art project.
body.zh: 美术项目结束后，我的桌子乱成一团。

body.en: We cleaned up the mess before our parents came home.
body.zh: 父母回家前，我们把乱七八糟的东西收拾好了。

body.en: I left a message to say I would be late.
body.zh: 我留言说明自己会迟到。

body.en: Her message arrived while I was waiting for the bus.
body.zh: 我等公交车时收到了她的信息。

body.en: Our teacher showed us a simple method for learning spellings.
body.zh: 老师教了我们一个学习拼写的简单方法。

body.en: This method uses less water to keep the plants healthy.
body.zh: 这种方法用更少的水让植物健康生长。

body.en: The garden wall is about two metres high.
body.zh: 花园的墙大约有两米高。

body.en: We measured a metre of string for the model.
body.zh: 我们为模型量出了一米长的细绳。

body.en: A large table stands in the middle of the room.
body.zh: 房间中央放着一张大桌子。

body.en: I found the photo between the middle pages of the book.
body.zh: 我在书的中间几页之间找到了照片。

body.en: We might visit the museum if it rains tomorrow.
body.zh: 如果明天下雨，我们可能会去博物馆。

body.en: She said she might join our walking group.
body.zh: 她说她可能加入我们的步行小组。

body.en: The nearest shop is a mile from our house.
body.zh: 最近的商店离我们家一英里。

body.en: We walked two miles along the river after lunch.
body.zh: 午饭后，我们沿河走了两英里。

body.en: I poured some milk over my breakfast cereal.
body.zh: 我往早餐麦片上倒了一些牛奶。

body.en: The farmer showed us how to milk a cow.
body.zh: 农民向我们展示了怎样给奶牛挤奶。

body.en: Would you mind closing the window before we start the lesson?
body.zh: 上课前请你关一下窗户好吗？

body.en: Keep your mind on the road when you ride your bike.
body.zh: 骑自行车时要专心看路。

body.en: Your umbrella is blue, but mine is yellow.
body.zh: 你的伞是蓝色的，我的是黄色的。

body.en: We visited an old coal mine on our school trip.
body.zh: 学校旅行时，我们参观了一座旧煤矿。

body.en: Please wait a minute while I find my coat.
body.zh: 请等一分钟，我找一下外套。

body.en: The walk to school takes about twenty minutes.
body.zh: 走到学校大约需要二十分钟。

body.en: I checked my hair in the mirror before leaving home.
body.zh: 出门前，我照了照镜子，整理头发。

body.en: The lake mirrored the mountains on a calm morning.
body.zh: 宁静的早晨，湖面映出了群山。

body.en: I missed the bus, so Dad drove me to school.
body.zh: 我没赶上公交车，所以爸爸开车送我上学。

body.en: Ella misses her grandparents when they are away.
body.zh: 爷爷奶奶不在身边时，埃拉会想念他们。

body.en: I made a spelling mistake in the first sentence.
body.zh: 我在第一句话里犯了一个拼写错误。

body.en: She took my coat by mistake after the party.
body.zh: 聚会后，她误拿了我的外套。

body.en: Mix the eggs and milk in a bowl before adding flour.
body.zh: 加面粉前，先把鸡蛋和牛奶在碗里混合。

body.en: Our class is a mix of students from different towns.
body.zh: 我们班的学生来自不同的城镇。

body.en: Please turn off your mobile phone during the lesson.
A mobile library visits our village every Friday.
body.zh: 流动图书馆每周五来到我们村。

body.en: We built a model of the solar system for science class.
body.zh: 我们为科学课制作了一个太阳系模型。

body.en: Our art teacher asked us to model a clay cup after a real one.
body.zh: 美术老师让我们照着真杯子做一个黏土杯。

body.en: Our town has a modern library with large windows.
body.zh: 我们镇上有一座带大窗户的现代图书馆。

body.en: Modern trains can carry many people at high speed.
body.zh: 现代列车能高速运送许多乘客。

body.en: Wait a moment while I tie my shoelaces.
body.zh: 等我一会儿，我系一下鞋带。

body.en: The team cheered when the winning goal came at the last moment.
body.zh: 最后一刻进球时，队员们欢呼起来。

body.en: I saved my pocket money to buy a new schoolbag.
body.zh: 我把零花钱存起来买了一个新书包。

body.en: Dad gave me some money for lunch at school.
body.zh: 爸爸给了我一些钱，让我在学校吃午饭。

body.en: The monkey picked up a banana and climbed the tree.
body.zh: 猴子拿起一根香蕉，爬上了树。

body.en: We watched a young monkey playing beside its mother.
body.zh: 我们看着一只小猴在妈妈身旁玩耍。

body.en: Our class will visit the science museum next month.
body.zh: 我们班下个月要参观科学博物馆。

body.en: My brother learned to swim in just one month.
body.zh: 我哥哥只用了一个月就学会了游泳。

body.en: The full moon shone above the quiet village.
body.zh: 满月在安静的村庄上空照耀。

body.en: We used a telescope to look at the moon.
body.zh: 我们用望远镜观察了月球。

body.en: Could I have some more rice with my dinner?
body.zh: 我吃晚饭时能再添些米饭吗？

body.en: This puzzle is more difficult than the last one.
body.zh: 这道谜题比上一道更难。

body.en: I open the curtains every morning after getting up.
body.zh: 我每天早上起床后都会拉开窗帘。

body.en: We spent the morning drawing flowers in the garden.
body.zh: 我们上午一直在花园里画花。

body.en: Most students in our class walk to school.
body.zh: 我们班的大多数学生步行上学。

body.en: This was the most exciting game I had ever watched.
body.zh: 这是我看过的最激动人心的比赛。

body.en: My mother works at the bookshop near our school.
body.zh: 我妈妈在学校附近的书店工作。

body.en: The mother bird brought food back to her chicks.
body.zh: 鸟妈妈把食物带回来喂小鸟。

body.en: Our family climbed the mountain during the summer holiday.
body.zh: 暑假期间，我们全家爬了那座山。

body.en: From the top of the mountain, we could see the village below.
body.zh: 从山顶上，我们能看到下面的村庄。

body.en: A small mouse ran behind the kitchen cupboard.
body.zh: 一只小老鼠跑到了厨房橱柜后面。

body.en: Move the mouse to point at the picture on the screen.
body.zh: 移动鼠标，指向屏幕上的图片。

body.en: Please cover your mouth when you cough.
The river becomes wider near its mouth by the sea.
body.zh: 这条河在海边的河口附近变宽了。

body.en: We moved to a new apartment near my school last month.
body.zh: 上个月我们搬到了学校附近的新公寓。

body.en: Please move your chair so everyone can see the screen.
body.zh: 请挪一下椅子，这样大家都能看到屏幕。

body.en: We watched a funny movie together on the rainy afternoon.
body.zh: 那个下雨的下午，我们一起看了一部有趣的电影。

body.en: The movie starts at seven, so let's meet outside the cinema.
body.zh: 电影七点开始，我们在电影院外见吧。

body.en: There is not much water left in the bottle.
body.zh: 瓶子里剩下的水不多了。

body.en: This new bag is much lighter than my old one.
body.zh: 这个新包比我的旧包轻得多。

body.en: We visited a museum full of old farming tools.
body.zh: 我们参观了一座藏有许多旧农具的博物馆。

body.en: The museum guide showed us a model of an ancient ship.
body.zh: 博物馆讲解员给我们看了一艘古船模型。

body.en: Soft music played while we waited for the show.
body.zh: 我们等待演出时，轻柔的音乐响着。

body.en: My sister writes music for the school band.
You must wear a helmet when you ride your bike.
body.zh: 骑自行车时你必须戴头盔。

body.en: The lights are off, so the shop must be closed now.
body.zh: 灯关着，所以这家店现在一定关门了。

body.en: Grandpa cooked mutton with carrots for our evening meal.
body.zh: 爷爷炖了羊肉和胡萝卜给我们当晚饭。

body.en: This restaurant is famous for its warm mutton soup.
body.zh: 这家餐馆以热腾腾的羊肉汤闻名。

body.en: My sister and I planted beans in the garden yesterday.
body.zh: 昨天我和姐姐在花园里种了豆子。

body.en: I keep my football shoes beside the door.
I made this paper plane myself, and it flies very far.
body.zh: 这架纸飞机是我自己做的，而且飞得很远。

body.en: I taught myself to play a simple song on the piano.
body.zh: 我自学会了在钢琴上弹一首简单的歌。

body.en: Please write your name at the top of the homework page.
body.zh: 请在作业页的顶部写上你的名字。

body.en: Our class named the new kitten Snowball after a vote.
body.zh: 我们班投票后给小猫取名叫雪球。

body.en: We walked along a narrow path beside the small river.
body.zh: 我们沿着小河边一条狭窄的小路行走。

body.en: The narrow doorway made it hard to carry the desk inside.
body.zh: 门口很窄，桌子很难搬进去。

body.en: The whole nation watched the team play in the final.
body.zh: 全国人民都在观看这支队伍参加决赛。

body.en: Our nation has many beautiful mountains and rivers.
body.zh: 我们的国家有许多秀丽的山川。

body.en: We picked up litter to help protect nature near the lake.
body.zh: 我们捡起垃圾，帮助保护湖边的大自然。

body.en: Her kind nature makes new students feel welcome.
body.zh: 她善良的性格让新同学感到受欢迎。

body.en: A small bookshop opened near the railway station.
body.zh: 火车站附近开了一家小书店。

body.en: We could hear the river as we came near.
body.zh: 我们走近时，能听见河水声。

body.en: We nearly missed the bus because we left home late.
body.zh: 我们差点错过公交车，因为出门晚了。

body.en: The library is nearly empty after the school day ends.
body.zh: 放学后，图书馆里几乎没人了。

body.en: It is necessary to wash your hands before eating.
body.zh: 吃东西前洗手是必要的。

body.en: We packed only the things necessary for a short trip.
body.zh: 我们只打包了短途旅行必需的物品。

body.en: I wear a scarf around my neck on cold mornings.
body.zh: 寒冷的早晨，我会在脖子上围一条围巾。

body.en: The giraffe stretched its long neck toward the leaves.
body.zh: 长颈鹿伸长脖子去够树叶。

body.en: These young plants need water every morning.
body.zh: 这些幼苗每天早上都需要水。

body.en: There is no need to hurry because we have enough time.
body.zh: 不用着急，我们有足够的时间。

body.en: The answer is negative because seven is not less than five.
body.zh: 答案是否定的，因为七并不小于五。

body.en: Try to find something good instead of thinking negative thoughts all day.
body.zh: 试着发现好的一面，别整天想着消极的事情。

body.en: Our neighbour brings us fresh vegetables from her garden.
body.zh: 我们的邻居把她花园里新鲜的蔬菜送给我们。

body.en: The new neighbor helped us carry a heavy box upstairs.
body.zh: 新邻居帮我们把一个重箱子搬上楼。

body.en: Neither Tom nor his sister likes getting up early.
body.zh: 汤姆和他姐姐都不喜欢早起。

body.en: I offered her tea or juice, but she wanted neither.
body.zh: 我让她在茶和果汁中选，但她两样都不要。

body.en: I felt nervous before speaking to the whole class.
body.zh: 在全班面前发言之前，我感到紧张。

body.en: Her kind smile made the nervous child feel calmer.
body.zh: 她亲切的微笑让紧张的孩子平静了些。

body.en: I have never seen snow in my hometown.
Grandma never forgets to water the flowers in the morning.
body.zh: 奶奶早上从不会忘记给花浇水。

body.en: My sister got a new bike for her birthday.
body.zh: 我姐姐生日时得到了一辆新自行车。

body.en: There is a new student in our class this week.
body.zh: 这周我们班来了一位新同学。

body.en: We heard the good news about our class trip after lunch.
body.zh: 午饭后我们听到了班级旅行的好消息。

body.en: Dad watches the evening news with us after dinner.
body.zh: 晚饭后爸爸和我们一起看晚间新闻。

body.en: Dad reads the newspaper while he eats breakfast.
body.zh: 爸爸吃早饭时会看报纸。

body.en: Our school newspaper printed a story about the science fair.
body.zh: 校报刊登了一篇关于科技展的报道。

body.en: We will visit the science museum next Saturday.
body.zh: 我们下周六将参观科学博物馆。

body.en: The next bus should arrive in about ten minutes.
body.zh: 下一班公交车大约十分钟后到。

body.en: It was nice to meet your family at the picnic.
body.zh: 很高兴在野餐时见到了你的家人。

body.en: Our new neighbour is nice to everyone in the building.
body.zh: 新邻居对楼里的每个人都很友善。

body.en: We watched the stars together on a clear summer night.
body.zh: 一个晴朗的夏夜，我们一起看了星星。

body.en: My father works at night and sleeps during the day.
body.zh: 我爸爸晚上工作，白天睡觉。

body.en: There is no milk left, so I will buy some after school.
body.zh: 牛奶没有了，所以我放学后会去买一些。

body.en: Dad said no when I asked to stay up late.
body.zh: 我请求晚点睡时，爸爸说不行。

body.en: Nobody was in the classroom when I arrived.
body.zh: 我到达时，教室里没有人。

body.en: I knocked twice, but nobody came to the door.
body.zh: 我敲了两次门，但没有人来开门。

body.en: I nodded to show the teacher that I understood the question.
body.zh: 我点头表示我听懂了老师的问题。

body.en: Dad nodded as I told him about my good news.
body.zh: 我告诉爸爸好消息时，他点了点头。

body.en: The loud noise from the street woke my baby brother.
body.zh: 街上的吵闹声把我弟弟吵醒了。

body.en: We heard a strange noise coming from the empty classroom.
body.zh: 我们听见空教室里传来奇怪的响声。

body.en: I offered some biscuits, but she wanted none.
body.zh: 我拿出一些饼干，但她一个也不要。

body.en: We checked three shops, but none had the book.
body.zh: 我们找了三家商店，但没有一家有这本书。

body.en: I helped Grandma make noodles for our family lunch.
body.zh: 我帮奶奶做面条，给全家当午饭。

body.en: The noodles in this soup are soft and warm.
body.zh: 这碗汤里的面条软软的、热热的。

body.en: We agreed to meet outside the library at noon.
body.zh: 我们约好中午在图书馆外见面。

body.en: The sun was high above the garden by noon.
body.zh: 到了中午，太阳高高挂在花园上空。

body.en: Neither my brother nor I knew the answer.
body.zh: 我和哥哥都不知道答案。

body.en: She did not laugh, nor did she say anything.
body.zh: 她没有笑，也什么都没说。

body.en: It is normal to feel nervous before your first school performance.
body.zh: 第一次参加学校演出前感到紧张是正常的。

body.en: After a good night's sleep, Leo felt normal again.
body.zh: 睡了个好觉后，利奥又恢复了正常状态。

body.en: The birds fly north when the weather gets warm in spring.
body.zh: 春天天气转暖时，鸟儿向北飞。

body.en: Our town is north of the lake, near the green hills.
body.zh: 我们镇在湖的北面，靠近青山。

body.en: The puppy touched my hand with its wet nose.
body.zh: 小狗用湿漉漉的鼻子碰了碰我的手。

body.en: I wiped my nose with a clean tissue.
body.zh: 我用干净的纸巾擦了鼻子。

body.en: I am not hungry, but I would like some water.
The shop is not open on Sunday mornings.
body.zh: 这家商店周日早上不开门。

body.en: I wrote a note to remind Dad to buy some apples.
body.zh: 我写了张便条，提醒爸爸买些苹果。

body.en: Please note the library's new opening hours on this sign.
body.zh: 请留意这个标牌上的图书馆新开放时间。

body.en: I wrote the new words in my small notebook.
body.zh: 我把新单词写进了小笔记本。

body.en: Her notebook was full of drawings of garden birds.
body.zh: 她的笔记本里画满了花园里的鸟。

body.en: There was nothing in my lunch box after school.
body.zh: 放学后，我的饭盒里什么也没有了。

body.en: Nothing makes Grandpa happier than a call from us.
body.zh: 没有什么比我们打电话更让爷爷高兴。

body.en: Did you notice the new painting by the door?
body.zh: 你注意到门边那幅新画了吗？

body.en: A notice on the gate said the park was closed.
body.zh: 门口的通知说公园已经关闭。

body.en: I borrowed a novel from the library and read it on the bus.
body.zh: 我从图书馆借了一本小说，在公交车上读。

body.en: The class tried a novel way to remember new English words.
body.zh: 全班尝试了一种新奇的方法来记英语新单词。

body.en: I am doing my homework now, and I will play later.
body.zh: 我现在正在做作业，之后再玩。

body.en: The bus is now waiting outside the school gate.
body.zh: 公交车现在正在校门外等候。

body.en: Please write your phone number on this form.
body.zh: 请把你的电话号码写在这张表上。

body.en: The number of students in our club grew this year.
body.zh: 今年我们社团的学生人数增加了。

body.en: The nurse helped the child feel calm before the test.
body.zh: 检查前，护士帮助孩子平静下来。

body.en: My cousin hopes to become a nurse after leaving school.
body.zh: 我表姐希望毕业后成为一名护士。

body.en: Our first lesson starts at eight o'clock every morning.
body.zh: 我们每天早上八点开始上第一节课。

body.en: I will meet you at three o'clock outside the library.
body.zh: 我将在三点钟到图书馆外与你见面。

body.en: We found a small metal object under the tree.
body.zh: 我们在树下发现了一个小金属物件。

body.en: Some parents object to the plan for a longer school day.
body.zh: 一些家长反对延长在校时间的计划。

body.en: We watched the sun set over the ocean during our holiday.
body.zh: 假期里，我们看着太阳在海面上落下。

body.en: A blue whale swims across the ocean to find food.
body.zh: 蓝鲸游过海洋寻找食物。

body.en: The colour of this flower changes as it grows.
body.zh: 这朵花的颜色随着生长而变化。

body.en: She gave me a cup of warm water.
Please turn off the television before you go to bed.
He took off his wet shoes at the door.
My friend offered to carry the books to the library.
body.zh: 朋友主动提出把这些书搬到图书馆。

body.en: The school offers free lunch to students who need it.
body.zh: 学校为有需要的学生提供免费午餐。

body.en: Dad works in an office near the train station.
body.zh: 爸爸在火车站附近的一间办公室工作。

body.en: Please take this form to the school office.
body.zh: 请把这张表交到学校办公室。

body.en: A police officer helped us find the way to the museum.
body.zh: 一位警察帮我们找到了去博物馆的路。

body.en: The officer at the crossing stopped cars so we could walk.
body.zh: 路口的交警拦下车辆，让我们能够通过。

body.en: I often ride my bike to the park after school.
body.zh: 我放学后常骑自行车去公园。

body.en: Our family often eats dinner together on weekends.
body.zh: 我们家周末常常一起吃晚饭。

body.en: Dad adds a little oil to the pan before cooking eggs.
body.zh: 爸爸煎鸡蛋前往锅里加一点油。

body.en: Our car needs more oil before the long trip north.
body.zh: 我们的汽车在向北长途旅行前需要加些机油。

body.en: This old bridge has stood here for many years.
body.zh: 这座古桥已经在这里矗立了多年。

body.en: My younger brother is seven years old today.
There is a family photo on the wall above my desk.
body.zh: 我书桌上方的墙上挂着一张全家福。

body.en: The lights are on, so someone must be home.
body.zh: 灯亮着，所以家里肯定有人。

body.en: I visit my grandparents once a month and help in their garden.
body.zh: 我每月去看望祖父母一次，并帮他们打理花园。

body.en: Once you finish your homework, you can watch the new cartoon.
body.zh: 你一做完作业，就可以看新动画片。

body.en: Dad cut an onion into small pieces for the soup.
body.zh: 爸爸把一个洋葱切成小块来煮汤。

body.en: The onion made my eyes water when I sliced it.
body.zh: 切洋葱时，我的眼睛流泪了。

body.en: We found the museum's opening times online.
body.zh: 我们在网上查到了博物馆的开放时间。

body.en: My cousin takes an online drawing class every Saturday.
body.zh: 我表妹每周六上一节在线绘画课。

body.en: There is only one apple left in the basket.
body.zh: 篮子里只剩下一个苹果。

body.en: She is the only person who knows the answer.
body.zh: 她是唯一知道答案的人。

body.en: Please open the window to let some fresh air in.
