body.zh: 请打开窗户，让新鲜空气进来。

body.en: The library is open until six this evening.
body.zh: 图书馆今天晚上营业到六点。

body.en: We watched a Chinese opera with our grandparents.
body.zh: 我们和祖父母一起看了一场中国戏曲。

body.en: The opera singer practised her song before the show.
body.zh: 歌剧演员在演出前练习了歌曲。

body.en: Our teacher explained how to operate the new printer.
body.zh: 老师解释了怎样操作这台新打印机。

body.en: The doctor will operate on his injured leg tomorrow.
body.zh: 医生明天将为他受伤的腿动手术。

body.en: In my opinion, the second plan is easier to follow.
body.zh: 我认为第二个方案更容易执行。

body.en: We listened to everyone's opinion before making our choice.
body.zh: 我们听取了每个人的意见后才作出选择。

body.en: The bank is opposite the library on this street.
body.zh: 这条街上，银行在图书馆对面。

body.en: We started at opposite ends and met in the middle.
body.zh: 我们从相对的两端出发，在中间相遇。

body.en: Would you like an apple or a banana for your snack?
body.zh: 你想吃苹果还是香蕉当点心？

body.en: We can walk to the park or take the bus.
body.zh: 我们可以步行去公园，也可以乘公交车。

body.en: I peeled an orange and shared it with my brother.
body.zh: 我剥了一个橙子，和弟弟分着吃。

body.en: The sky turned orange as the sun went down.
body.zh: 太阳落山时，天空变成了橙色。

body.en: We put the picture cards in order before telling the story.
body.zh: 讲故事前，我们把图片卡片按顺序排好。

body.en: I ordered noodles and vegetables for lunch at the small cafe.
body.zh: 我在小餐馆点了午饭，要了面条和蔬菜。

body.en: Our class will organise a concert to raise money.
body.zh: 我们班将组织一场音乐会来筹款。

body.en: I organise my books by subject on the shelf.
body.zh: 我把书架上的书按学科分类整理。

body.en: I put the other shoe beside the front door.
body.zh: 我把另一只鞋放在前门旁边。

body.en: Some children chose apples, and the others chose bananas.
body.zh: 一些孩子选了苹果，其他孩子选了香蕉。

body.en: Our class planted flowers beside the school gate last spring.
body.zh: 去年春天，我们班在校门旁种了花。

body.en: We invited our neighbors to watch the school play.
body.zh: 我们邀请邻居来看学校的话剧。

body.en: Their classroom is upstairs, but ours is on this floor.
body.zh: 他们的教室在楼上，我们的在这一层。

body.en: We invited some friends of ours to the picnic.
body.zh: 我们邀请了几位朋友去野餐。

body.en: We made lunch ourselves while our parents were at work.
body.zh: 父母上班时，我们自己做了午饭。

body.en: We enjoyed ourselves at the school music festival.
body.zh: 我们在学校音乐节上玩得很开心。

body.en: The children went out to play after finishing their homework.
body.zh: 孩子们做完作业后出去玩了。

body.en: Please take the rubbish out before dinner tonight.
body.zh: 今晚晚饭前请把垃圾拿出去。

body.en: Please wait outside while I get my coat.
body.zh: 请在外面等一下，我去拿外套。

body.en: It is cold outside, so take a warm hat.
body.zh: 外面很冷，所以带上一顶暖和的帽子。

body.en: Mum put the bread in the hot oven.
body.zh: 妈妈把面包放进热烤箱里。

body.en: Let the oven cool before you clean it.
body.zh: 等烤箱冷却后再清洁它。

body.en: A small bird flew over the garden wall.
body.zh: 一只小鸟飞过了花园的围墙。

body.en: The game is over, but everyone is still excited.
body.zh: 比赛结束了，但大家仍然很兴奋。

body.en: She wants to buy a bike with her own money.
body.zh: 她想用自己的钱买一辆自行车。

body.en: Do you own this little shop near the station?
body.zh: 车站附近的这家小店是你的吗？

body.en: The library closes at six p.m. on Fridays.
body.zh: 图书馆星期五下午六点关门。

body.en: Our train leaves at two p.m., so we have time.
body.zh: 我们的火车下午两点出发，所以还有时间。

body.en: Please pack your bag before you go to bed.
body.zh: 请在睡觉前收拾好你的包。

body.en: We need to pack some food for the trip.
body.zh: 我们需要为这次旅行打包一些食物。

body.en: I bought a packet of seeds for our garden.
body.zh: 我买了一包种子，准备种在我们的花园里。

body.en: Read the instructions on the packet before you begin.
body.zh: 开始前先阅读包装袋上的说明。

body.en: Please turn to page twelve and read the first story.
body.zh: 请翻到第十二页，读第一个故事。

body.en: I left a note on the last page of your notebook.
body.zh: 我在你笔记本的最后一页留了张便条。

body.en: He felt a sharp pain in his left leg.
The pain in my back kept me awake.
body.zh: 背部的疼痛让我无法入睡。

body.en: We painted the classroom wall light blue during the holiday.
body.zh: 假期里我们把教室墙壁刷成了浅蓝色。

body.en: My sister uses watercolors to paint birds in her sketchbook.
body.zh: 我姐姐用水彩在速写本上画鸟。

body.en: I need a new pair of shoes for running.
body.zh: 我需要一双新的跑步鞋。

body.en: Put each pair of socks in the drawer.
body.zh: 把每双袜子放进抽屉里。

body.en: The king lived in a palace beside the river.
body.zh: 国王住在河边的一座宫殿里。

body.en: Visitors can see old paintings inside the palace.
body.zh: 游客可以在宫殿里看到古老的画作。

body.en: Her face looked pale after the long journey.
body.zh: 长途旅行后，她的脸色显得苍白。

body.en: He chose a pale blue shirt for the party.
body.zh: 他为聚会选了一件浅蓝色衬衫。

body.en: I put some fresh fruit on my pancake.
body.zh: 我在薄煎饼上放了一些新鲜水果。

body.en: Dad made a pancake in a small frying pan.
body.zh: 爸爸用一个小煎锅做了一张薄煎饼。

body.en: The panda was eating bamboo when we arrived.
body.zh: 我们到的时候，那只熊猫正在吃竹子。

body.en: My little sister drew a panda with black ears.
body.zh: 我妹妹画了一只长着黑耳朵的熊猫。

body.en: Please write your name on this piece of paper.
body.zh: 请把你的名字写在这张纸上。

body.en: We can use both sides of the paper.
body.zh: 我们可以使用纸的两面。

body.en: Read the first paragraph and answer the question.
body.zh: 阅读第一段，然后回答问题。

body.en: Write a short paragraph about your favourite animal.
body.zh: 写一小段话，介绍你最喜欢的动物。

body.en: I beg your pardon; I did not hear your name.
body.zh: 对不起，我没听清你的名字。

body.en: Please pardon me for arriving so late.
body.zh: 我来得这么晚，请原谅我。

body.en: A parent must sign this form before Friday.
body.zh: 家长必须在星期五之前签署这张表格。

body.en: Each parent can bring one child to the event.
body.zh: 每位家长可以带一个孩子参加这次活动。

body.en: We often walk through the park after dinner.
body.zh: 晚饭后，我们经常穿过公园散步。

body.en: You cannot park your car in front of this gate.
body.zh: 你不能把车停在这扇大门前。

body.en: The best part of the trip was the boat ride.
body.zh: 旅行中最精彩的部分是乘船游览。

body.en: I want to take part in the school play.
body.zh: 我想参加学校的话剧演出。

body.en: Discuss your answer with a partner before you write.
body.zh: 动笔前，先和搭档讨论你的答案。

body.en: My dance partner helped me learn the new steps.
body.zh: 我的舞伴帮助我学会了新的舞步。

body.en: We are having a party for Grandma this weekend.
body.zh: 这个周末我们要为奶奶办一场聚会。

body.en: Please bring your favourite game to the party.
body.zh: 请把你最喜欢的游戏带到聚会上。

body.en: Please pass the salt to your brother at dinner.
body.zh: 晚饭时请把盐递给你弟弟。

body.en: We passed the bakery on our way home from school.
body.zh: 我们放学回家时经过了面包店。

body.en: Read the passage carefully before choosing your answer.
body.zh: 选择答案前，请仔细阅读这篇短文。

body.en: A narrow passage leads from the kitchen to the garden.
body.zh: 一条狭窄的通道从厨房通向花园。

body.en: A passenger asked the driver to stop near the school.
body.zh: 一名乘客请司机在学校附近停车。

body.en: Every passenger must show a ticket before getting on.
body.zh: 每位乘客上车前都必须出示车票。

body.en: Keep your passport in a safe place during the trip.
body.zh: 旅行期间，请把护照放在安全的地方。

body.en: She checked her bag to make sure her passport was there.
body.zh: 她检查了包，确认护照在里面。

body.en: We walked past the bakery on our way to the library.
body.zh: 去图书馆的路上，我们经过了面包店。

body.en: My grandmother tells funny stories about her past at dinner.
body.zh: 晚饭时，奶奶讲起她过去的有趣故事。

body.en: The patient waited quietly while the doctor checked her arm.
body.zh: 医生检查她的手臂时，病人安静地等着。

body.en: Be patient with your little brother while he learns to read.
body.zh: 弟弟学习阅读时，请耐心对待他。

body.en: I paid for my lunch with the money from my pocket.
body.zh: 我用口袋里的钱付了午餐费。

body.en: Dad pays the phone bill online at the end of each month.
body.zh: 爸爸每个月底在线支付电话费。

body.en: The two countries worked together to bring lasting peace.
body.zh: 这两个国家共同努力，争取实现持久和平。

body.en: I need some peace and quiet to finish my homework.
body.zh: 我需要安静一下，好完成作业。

body.en: She cut a pear into small pieces for the baby.
body.zh: 她把一个梨切成小块给宝宝吃。

body.en: There is a pear tree behind our house.
body.zh: 我们房子后面有一棵梨树。

body.en: May I borrow your pen to sign this card?
body.zh: 我可以借你的笔在这张卡片上签名吗？

body.en: He put down his pen and read his story again.
body.zh: 他放下笔，又读了一遍自己写的故事。

body.en: Draw the shape in pencil before you colour it.
body.zh: 上色前，先用铅笔画出形状。

body.en: My pencil broke, so I borrowed one from Tom.
body.zh: 我的铅笔断了，所以向汤姆借了一支。

body.en: The penguin jumped into the cold water to catch fish.
body.zh: 那只企鹅跳进冷水里捕鱼。

body.en: We watched a film about a young penguin.
body.zh: 我们看了一部关于小企鹅的电影。

body.en: Many people visit the park to walk their dogs each morning.
body.zh: 每天早上许多人到公园遛狗。

body.en: The people in our town planted trees along the river.
body.zh: 我们镇上的人们沿着河边种了树。

body.en: Please add a little pepper to the soup before serving it.
body.zh: 上汤前请加一点胡椒粉。

body.en: My brother put a green pepper in his lunch salad.
body.zh: 我弟弟在午餐沙拉里放了一个青椒。

body.en: About fifty per cent of our class walk to school.
body.zh: 我们班大约百分之五十的学生步行上学。

body.en: The shop cut its prices by ten per cent.
body.zh: 这家商店把价格降低了百分之十。

body.en: This quiet room is perfect for reading after school.
body.zh: 这间安静的房间非常适合放学后阅读。

body.en: Your drawing does not have to be perfect.
Our music club will perform at the school festival.
body.zh: 我们音乐社团将在校园节上演出。

body.en: The students will perform a short play in English.
body.zh: 学生们将用英语表演一部短剧。

body.en: Perhaps we can visit the zoo after the rain stops.
body.zh: 也许雨停后我们可以去动物园。

body.en: The small kitten is perhaps hiding under the sofa.
body.zh: 那只小猫也许藏在沙发下面。

body.en: Our English period begins at nine o'clock on Monday.
body.zh: 星期一的英语课九点开始。

body.en: I felt tired for a short period after the long walk.
body.zh: 长途步行后，我有一小段时间觉得很累。

body.en: Each person in our group brought one colored pencil.
body.zh: 我们组里的每个人都带了一支彩色铅笔。

body.en: The person at the desk helped us find the room.
body.zh: 桌旁的那个人帮我们找到了房间。

body.en: Please keep your personal things in the locker near the classroom.
body.zh: 请把你的个人物品放在教室附近的储物柜里。

body.en: My teacher gave me some personal advice about speaking clearly.
body.zh: 老师给了我一些关于清晰表达的个人建议。

body.en: Her pet rabbit likes to hide under the table.
body.zh: 她的宠物兔喜欢躲在桌子下面。

body.en: Taking care of a pet can teach us responsibility.
body.zh: 照顾宠物可以培养我们的责任心。

body.en: Please turn off your phone before the film starts.
body.zh: 电影开始前，请关闭手机。

body.en: I will phone you when I get home.
body.zh: 我到家后会给你打电话。

body.en: This photo shows our family at the beach last summer.
body.zh: 这张照片是我们一家去年夏天在海边拍的。

body.en: May I take a photo of your dog?
body.zh: 我可以给你的狗拍张照片吗？

body.en: In physics, we learned why things fall to the ground.
body.zh: 物理课上，我们学习了物体为什么会落到地面上。

body.en: Our physics teacher showed us a simple experiment.
body.zh: 我们的物理老师给我们演示了一个简单的实验。

body.en: She practises the piano for twenty minutes every evening.
body.zh: 她每天晚上练二十分钟钢琴。

body.en: There is an old piano in the music room.
body.zh: 音乐教室里有一架旧钢琴。

body.en: We pick fresh tomatoes from Grandma's garden in summer.
body.zh: 夏天我们从奶奶的菜园里摘新鲜的西红柿。

body.en: Please pick a book for our reading time tonight.
body.zh: 请为我们今晚的阅读时间选一本书。

body.en: We had a picnic beside the lake on Sunday.
body.zh: 星期天，我们在湖边野餐。

body.en: Bring a blanket and some sandwiches for the picnic.
body.zh: 带一条毯子和一些三明治去野餐吧。

body.en: She drew a picture of her new classroom.
body.zh: 她画了一幅新教室的画。

body.en: The picture on the wall shows a snowy mountain.
body.zh: 墙上的那幅画描绘了一座雪山。

body.en: Grandma made an apple pie for us this afternoon.
body.zh: 今天下午，奶奶给我们做了一个苹果派。

body.en: Would you like a small piece of pie?
I ate a piece of bread before walking to school.
body.zh: 我步行上学前吃了一片面包。

body.en: Mia put the last piece of the puzzle in the right place.
body.zh: 米娅把拼图的最后一块放到了正确的位置。

body.en: The farmer fed the pig before going home.
body.zh: 农民回家前喂了那头猪。

body.en: We saw a pink pig sleeping beside the fence.
body.zh: 我们看见一头粉红色的猪睡在栅栏旁。

body.en: The doctor explained when she should take each pill.
body.zh: 医生解释了她应该什么时候服用每粒药。

body.en: Keep the pill bottle away from young children.
body.zh: 把药瓶放在幼儿拿不到的地方。

body.en: The pilot welcomed the passengers before the plane took off.
body.zh: 飞机起飞前，飞行员向乘客致意。

body.en: My aunt wants to be a pilot when she grows up.
body.zh: 我阿姨长大后想当飞行员。

body.en: We play ping-pong in the school hall after lunch.
body.zh: 午饭后，我们在学校礼堂打乒乓球。

body.en: My brother taught me how to hold a ping-pong bat.
body.zh: 我哥哥教我怎样握乒乓球拍。

body.en: She wore a pink hat to the beach.
body.zh: 她戴着一顶粉红色的帽子去了海边。

body.en: The sky turned pink just before the sun rose.
body.zh: 太阳升起前，天空变成了粉红色。

body.en: She was a pioneer in the study of ocean life.
body.zh: 她是海洋生物研究领域的先驱。

body.en: The museum tells the story of a pioneer in flight.
body.zh: 这座博物馆讲述了一位飞行先驱的故事。

body.en: It is a pity that you cannot join us today.
body.zh: 你今天不能和我们一起去，真可惜。

body.en: He felt pity for the hungry dog in the street.
body.zh: 他很同情街上那只饥饿的狗。

body.en: We shared a large pizza after the football match.
body.zh: 足球赛后，我们分着吃了一个大比萨饼。

body.en: Would you like mushrooms on your pizza tonight?
body.zh: 你今晚的比萨饼上要放蘑菇吗？

body.en: Please put your shoes in their place by the front door.
body.zh: 请把鞋子放回前门旁边的位置。

body.en: This park is a lovely place for a family picnic.
body.zh: 这个公园是适合全家野餐的好地方。

body.en: We plan to visit the science museum on Saturday.
body.zh: 我们计划星期六去参观科学博物馆。

body.en: Our plan is to walk home together after the game.
body.zh: 我们的计划是比赛后一起走回家。

body.en: Our plane landed safely despite the heavy rain.
body.zh: 虽然下着大雨，我们的飞机还是安全降落了。

body.en: She watched a plane fly above the clouds.
body.zh: 她看着一架飞机在云层上方飞行。

body.en: Our science teacher showed us a picture of the planet Mars.
body.zh: 科学老师给我们看了一张火星的图片。

body.en: Earth is the only planet in our solar system known to support life.
body.zh: 地球是太阳系中目前已知唯一存在生命的行星。

body.en: Remember to water this plant twice a week.
body.zh: 记得每周给这株植物浇两次水。

body.en: We will plant a tree beside the school gate.
body.zh: 我们将在校门旁种一棵树。

body.en: Please put the clean plastic bottles in the blue recycling bin.
body.zh: 请把干净的塑料瓶放进蓝色回收箱。

body.en: We use a plastic ruler to draw straight lines in class.
body.zh: 我们在课堂上用塑料尺画直线。

body.en: Please put the washed plate beside the sink to dry.
body.zh: 请把洗好的盘子放在水槽旁晾干。

body.en: Grandma served rice and vegetables on a large plate.
body.zh: 奶奶用一个大盘子盛了米饭和蔬菜。

body.en: The children play football in the park after school.
body.zh: 孩子们放学后在公园踢足球。

body.en: Dad plays the piano while I finish my homework.
body.zh: 我做作业时，爸爸在弹钢琴。

body.en: The children ran to the playground after class.
body.zh: 下课后，孩子们跑向了操场。

body.en: Our new playground has a slide and two swings.
body.zh: 我们的新游乐场有一个滑梯和两个秋千。

body.en: Could you please close the window before you leave?
body.zh: 你离开前能关上窗户吗？

body.en: Please tell me if you need any help.
body.zh: 如果你需要帮助，请告诉我。

body.en: It was a pleasure to meet the new students at our school.
body.zh: 很高兴认识我们学校的新同学。

body.en: Reading a funny book is one of my simple pleasures.
body.zh: 读一本有趣的书是我生活中的小乐趣之一。

body.en: There is plenty of time to finish our homework before dinner.
body.zh: 晚饭前我们有充足的时间完成作业。

body.en: We brought plenty of water for the long walk in the hills.
body.zh: 我们带了足够的水去山里长途徒步。

body.en: I put the bus ticket in my coat pocket.
body.zh: 我把公交车票放进外套口袋里。

body.en: He found a small toy in the pocket of his schoolbag.
body.zh: 他在书包的口袋里发现了一个小玩具。

body.en: She wrote a short poem about the rain.
body.zh: 她写了一首关于雨的短诗。

body.en: Our teacher read the poem aloud to the class.
body.zh: 老师把这首诗朗读给全班同学听。

body.en: The poet used simple words to describe the sea.
body.zh: 这位诗人用简单的词语描写大海。

body.en: My brother hopes to become a poet one day.
body.zh: 我哥哥希望有一天能成为诗人。

body.en: Mia pointed to the map and found the school quickly.
body.zh: 米娅指着地图，很快找到了学校。

body.en: The main point of the story is to help others.
body.zh: 这个故事的要点是帮助他人。

body.en: The police helped the lost child find her parents.
body.zh: 警察帮助迷路的小女孩找到了父母。

body.en: Someone called the police after seeing the broken window.
body.zh: 有人看见窗户被打破后报了警。

body.en: A policeman showed us the way to the station.
body.zh: 一名男警察给我们指了去车站的路。

body.en: The policewoman helped an old man cross the road.
body.zh: 那位女警察帮助一位老人过马路。

body.en: It is polite to say thank you after receiving help.
body.zh: 得到帮助后说谢谢是有礼貌的表现。

body.en: She gave a polite smile and opened the door.
body.zh: 她礼貌地笑了笑，打开了门。

body.en: Factories must not pollute the river with dirty water.
body.zh: 工厂不能用污水污染河流。

body.en: Too many cars can pollute the air in cities.
body.zh: 过多的汽车会污染城市空气。

body.en: We swim in the school pool every Friday after class.
body.zh: 我们每周五放学后在学校游泳池游泳。

body.en: A small pool of rainwater formed beside the garden path.
body.zh: 花园小路旁积起了一小滩雨水。

body.en: The poor puppy needed food and a warm place to sleep.
body.zh: 那只可怜的小狗需要食物和温暖的睡觉地方。

body.en: I got a poor score because I forgot to check my answers.
body.zh: 我因为忘记检查答案，成绩不太理想。

body.en: Basketball is a popular sport at our school.
body.zh: 篮球在我们学校是一项很受欢迎的运动。

body.en: This book is popular with children of all ages.
body.zh: 这本书受到各个年龄段孩子的喜爱。

body.en: The population of our town grows when new families move here.
body.zh: 新家庭搬来后，我们镇的人口增加了。

body.en: The city has a large population, so buses are often busy.
body.zh: 这座城市人口很多，所以公交车经常很拥挤。

body.en: Dad cooked some pork with potatoes for dinner.
body.zh: 爸爸晚饭用猪肉和土豆做了一道菜。

body.en: Would you prefer pork or fish with your rice?
body.zh: 配米饭你更想吃猪肉还是鱼？

body.en: I usually have a bowl of porridge for breakfast.
The porridge is still hot, so let it cool.
body.zh: 粥还很烫，先让它凉一凉。

body.en: Please put your schoolbag in this position beside the desk.
body.zh: 请把书包放在桌子旁边这个位置。

body.en: She got a position on the school basketball team this year.
body.zh: 今年她在校篮球队获得了一个位置。

body.en: Try to stay positive when the work becomes difficult.
body.zh: 工作变得困难时，尽量保持积极的心态。

body.en: Her kind words had a positive effect on me.
body.zh: 她友善的话语对我产生了积极影响。

body.en: Is it possible to finish this puzzle before dinner?
body.zh: 有可能在晚饭前完成这个拼图吗？

body.en: We took the earliest possible bus to reach the zoo on time.
body.zh: 我们搭乘尽可能早的公交车，准时到达动物园。

body.en: I will post this letter on my way home.
body.zh: 我会在回家路上寄这封信。

body.en: Did anything interesting arrive in the post today?
body.zh: 今天的邮件里有什么有趣的东西吗？

body.en: She sent me a postcard from her holiday in Spain.
body.zh: 她从西班牙的度假地给我寄来了一张明信片。

body.en: Write our address clearly on the postcard, please.
body.zh: 请在明信片上把我们的地址写清楚。

body.en: The postman delivered a letter from my cousin today.
body.zh: 今天，邮递员送来了我表哥的一封信。

body.en: Our postman rides a bike through the village.
body.zh: 我们的邮递员骑着自行车穿行在村里。

body.en: She put the little plant in a larger pot.
body.zh: 她把那株小植物放进了一个更大的花盆里。

body.en: There is a pot of soup on the cooker.
Cut the potato into small pieces before cooking it.
body.zh: 烹饪前，把土豆切成小块。

body.en: I had a baked potato with cheese for lunch.
body.zh: 午饭我吃了一个加奶酪的烤土豆。

body.en: This notebook costs one pound in the shop.
body.zh: 这家店里的这本笔记本售价一英镑。

body.en: Please weigh out a pound of apples for me.
Dad poured warm milk into my cup before bedtime.
body.zh: 睡前爸爸往我的杯子里倒了热牛奶。

body.en: The rain poured down while we waited for the bus.
body.zh: 我们等公交车时，雨下得很大。

body.en: The storm knocked out power in our neighborhood last night.
body.zh: 昨晚暴风雨导致我们社区停电。

body.en: The coach gave the team a chance to share power and make decisions.
body.zh: 教练让队员们有机会共同掌握权力并作决定。

body.en: Our basketball team has practice in the gym after school.
body.zh: 放学后，我们篮球队在体育馆训练。

body.en: I practice the piano for twenty minutes before dinner.
body.zh: 我晚饭前练二十分钟钢琴。

body.en: Our teacher gave us praise for working well together.
body.zh: 老师表扬了我们合作得很好。

body.en: Remember to praise children when they make an effort.
body.zh: 孩子们付出努力时，记得表扬他们。

body.en: I prefer walking to taking a bus on sunny days.
body.zh: 天气晴朗时，比起坐公交车，我更喜欢走路。

body.en: Would you prefer tea or a glass of water?
body.zh: 你更想喝茶还是一杯水？

body.en: We need to prepare some questions before the interview.
body.zh: 采访前，我们需要准备一些问题。

body.en: Let us prepare dinner together before Mum gets home.
body.zh: 妈妈回家前，我们一起准备晚饭吧。

body.en: I bought a small present for my best friend.
body.zh: 我给最好的朋友买了一件小礼物。

body.en: All twenty students were present at the meeting.
body.zh: 二十名学生全部出席了会议。

body.en: The president spoke to students at our school yesterday.
body.zh: 昨天总统在我们学校对学生们讲话。

body.en: Our class president helped plan the spring party.
body.zh: 我们的班长帮忙筹划了春季联欢会。

body.en: Please press the green button to start the machine.
body.zh: 请按绿色按钮启动机器。

body.en: Do not press too hard when you write in pencil.
body.zh: 用铅笔写字时不要太用力按。

body.en: I felt pressure before the match, so my coach helped me relax.
body.zh: 比赛前我感到压力，所以教练帮我放松。

body.en: Press the lid with gentle pressure until it clicks shut.
body.zh: 轻轻按压盖子，直到它咔哒一声合上。

body.en: There are some pretty flowers beside the window.
body.zh: 窗户旁边有一些漂亮的花。

body.en: I am pretty sure we met at the library.
body.zh: 我很确定我们在图书馆见过。

body.en: The price of this notebook is five yuan at the shop.
body.zh: 这家商店里这本笔记本的价格是五元。

body.en: Dad checked the price before choosing a new schoolbag.
body.zh: 爸爸挑选新书包前先看了价格。

body.en: She took pride in the garden she had planted.
body.zh: 她为自己种植的花园感到自豪。

body.en: His face shone with pride when his team won.
body.zh: 他的球队获胜时，他的脸上洋溢着自豪。

body.en: Reading is a primary part of our English homework this week.
body.zh: 阅读是我们本周英语作业的主要部分。

body.en: My little brother started primary school near our home last year.
body.zh: 我弟弟去年在家附近开始上小学。

body.en: The prince rode a horse through the forest.
In the story, the princess saved the little dragon.
body.zh: 故事里，公主救了那条小龙。

body.en: Can you print two copies of this letter for me?
body.zh: 你能帮我把这封信打印两份吗？

body.en: Please print your name clearly at the top.
body.zh: 请在上方用印刷体清楚地写出你的名字。

body.en: Please keep this note private because it contains my phone number.
body.zh: 请把这张纸条保密，因为上面有我的电话号码。

body.en: My cousin studies at a private school near the library.
body.zh: 我的表亲在图书馆附近的一所私立学校上学。

body.en: She won first prize in the school art competition.
body.zh: 她在学校的美术比赛中获得了一等奖。

body.en: The prize for the winner is a new bike.
body.zh: 获胜者的奖品是一辆新自行车。

body.en: The sky is dark, so it will probably rain soon.
body.zh: 天空很暗，所以很可能马上要下雨了。

body.en: Leo probably left his lunch box in the classroom.
body.zh: 利奥大概把饭盒落在教室里了。

body.en: We worked together to solve the difficult maths problem.
body.zh: 我们合作解出了这道数学难题。

body.en: There is a problem with the lights in this room.
body.zh: 这间屋子的灯出了问题。

body.en: This farm produces fresh eggs for shops in our town.
body.zh: 这个农场为镇上的商店生产新鲜鸡蛋。

body.en: Our class will produce a short play for the school festival.
body.zh: 我们班将为校园节日排演一部短剧。

body.en: This shop sells a new product made from recycled paper.
body.zh: 这家商店出售一种用再生纸制成的新产品。

body.en: The product of six and four is twenty-four.
body.zh: 六乘以四的积是二十四。

body.en: My favourite programme about animals starts at seven.
body.zh: 我最喜欢的动物节目七点开始。

body.en: The school made a programme for the sports day.
body.zh: 学校为运动会安排了一个活动计划。

body.en: I made good progress with my reading after practicing each evening.
body.zh: 每天晚上练习后，我的阅读有了很大进步。

body.en: Our class is progressing well with the science project this month.
body.zh: 这个月我们班的科学项目进展顺利。

body.en: Our science project shows how plants grow toward the light.
body.zh: 我们的科学项目展示了植物如何朝着光生长。

body.en: The class will work on a project about local birds this month.
body.zh: 这个月全班要做一个关于本地鸟类的项目。

body.en: I promise to help my sister with her English homework tonight.
body.zh: 我答应今晚帮妹妹做英语作业。

body.en: Dad made a promise to take us to the beach this weekend.
body.zh: 爸爸答应这个周末带我们去海滩。

body.en: Can you teach me how to pronounce your name?
body.zh: 你能教我怎么读你的名字吗？

body.en: Listen carefully, then try to pronounce the word yourself.
body.zh: 仔细听，然后试着自己读出这个单词。

body.en: Please wear proper shoes for the long walk through the forest.
body.zh: 在森林里长途行走时，请穿合适的鞋子。

body.en: The teacher showed us the proper way to wash our hands.
body.zh: 老师给我们示范了正确的洗手方法。

body.en: Wear a helmet to protect your head when you ride a bike.
body.zh: 骑自行车时戴头盔，保护好你的头。

body.en: The students planted trees to protect the river near their school.
body.zh: 学生们种树来保护学校附近的河流。

body.en: My parents were proud when I finished my first long book.
body.zh: 我读完第一本长篇书时，父母为我感到自豪。

body.en: She is proud of the garden she grew with her brother.
body.zh: 她为自己和哥哥一起种的花园感到自豪。

body.en: We need more facts to prove that the story is true.
body.zh: 我们需要更多事实来证明这个故事是真的。

body.en: This experiment will help us prove our idea.
body.zh: 这个实验将帮助我们验证想法。

body.en: The school library provides quiet places for students to read.
body.zh: 学校图书馆为学生提供安静的阅读场所。

body.en: Our teacher provided each group with a map for the trip.
body.zh: 老师给每个小组提供了一张旅行地图。

body.en: The public library closes at six on weekdays.
body.zh: 公共图书馆工作日下午六点关门。

body.en: Our school will hold a public concert in the park.
body.zh: 我们学校将在公园举办一场公开音乐会。

body.en: Our class will publish a newspaper about school life.
body.zh: 我们班将出版一份关于校园生活的报纸。

body.en: The website will publish the results next Monday.
body.zh: 网站将在下星期一公布结果。

body.en: Please pull the door gently; it is heavy.
Our dog pulled me toward the pond when it saw a duck.
body.zh: 狗看到鸭子时，把我拉向池塘。

body.en: The teacher did not punish him for asking questions.
body.zh: 老师没有因为他提问而惩罚他。

body.en: It is unfair to punish everyone for one person's mistake.
body.zh: 因为一个人的错误而惩罚所有人是不公平的。

body.en: She painted the box purple and added yellow stars.
body.zh: 她把盒子涂成紫色，又画上了黄色星星。

body.en: We picked some purple grapes from the garden.
body.zh: 我们从花园里摘了一些紫葡萄。

body.en: What is the purpose of this new school rule?
body.zh: 这条新校规的目的是什么？

body.en: He broke the cup by accident, not on purpose.
body.zh: 他是不小心打碎杯子的，不是故意的。

body.en: Ben pushed the heavy classroom door open for his friend.
body.zh: 本帮朋友推开了沉重的教室门。

body.en: Push the green button to start the washing machine.
body.zh: 按下绿色按钮启动洗衣机。

body.en: Please put your books back on the shelf.
body.zh: 请把你的书放回书架上。

body.en: She put on her coat and walked outside.
body.zh: 她穿上外套，走到了外面。

body.en: This shop sells good quality school bags that last for years.
body.zh: 这家商店卖质量好的书包，可以用很多年。

body.en: The most important quality in a good teammate is kindness.
body.zh: 好队友最重要的品质是善良。

body.en: The school bus leaves at a quarter past seven each morning.
body.zh: 校车每天早上七点一刻出发。

body.en: Please cut the apple into quarters and share it with us.
body.zh: 请把苹果切成四等份，和我们一起分享。

body.en: The queen waved to the people outside the palace.
body.zh: 女王向宫殿外的人们挥手。

body.en: My sister played the queen in our school play.
body.zh: 我姐姐在学校的话剧中扮演女王。

body.en: I have a question about the homework, so I will ask my teacher.
body.zh: 我对作业有个问题，所以要问老师。

body.en: Mia questioned her brother about the missing cookies.
body.zh: 米娅问哥哥那些不见了的饼干去哪儿了。

body.en: We had a quick lunch before the meeting.
body.zh: 开会前，我们匆匆吃了午饭。

body.en: His quick answer surprised the rest of the class.
body.zh: 他迅速作答，让班上其他同学很惊讶。

body.en: Please be quiet while the baby is sleeping.
body.zh: 宝宝睡觉时，请保持安静。

body.en: We found a quiet place to read beside the lake.
body.zh: 我们在湖边找了个安静的地方读书。

body.en: The library is quite quiet in the early morning.
body.zh: 图书馆一大早相当安静。

body.en: My new bike is quite different from my old one.
body.zh: 我的新自行车和旧车相当不同。

body.en: A rabbit ran across the path in front of us.
body.zh: 一只兔子从我们面前的小路上跑了过去。

body.en: The little rabbit has long ears and a short tail.
body.zh: 那只小兔子耳朵长，尾巴短。

body.en: Our class will have a short race around the playground today.
body.zh: 今天我们班要在操场上进行一场短跑比赛。

body.en: The two friends raced to the bus stop after school.
body.zh: 放学后，两个朋友飞快地跑向公交车站。

body.en: Grandpa listens to the radio while making breakfast.
body.zh: 爷爷做早饭时听收音机。

body.en: I heard my favourite song on the radio today.
body.zh: 今天，我在广播里听到了最喜欢的歌。

body.en: The new railway connects our town with the city.
body.zh: 新铁路把我们的小镇与那座城市连接起来。

body.en: We met our cousins outside the railway station.
body.zh: 我们在火车站外见到了表亲们。

body.en: The heavy rain stopped us from playing outside.
body.zh: 大雨使我们无法在外面玩。

body.en: It may rain tonight, so bring in the clothes.
body.zh: 今晚可能下雨，所以把衣服收进来吧。

body.en: A bright rainbow appeared after the afternoon shower.
body.zh: 午后的阵雨过后，出现了一道明亮的彩虹。

body.en: She painted a rainbow above the mountains in her picture.
body.zh: 她在画中的群山上方画了一道彩虹。

body.en: Please raise your hand if you know the answer.
body.zh: 如果你知道答案，请举手。

body.en: Our class raised money to help the animal shelter.
body.zh: 我们班筹款帮助动物收容所。

body.en: The town has seen rapid growth in recent years.
body.zh: 近年来，这座城镇发展迅速。

body.en: She made rapid progress after joining the reading club.
body.zh: 加入阅读俱乐部后，她进步很快。

body.en: I would rather walk than wait for the bus.
body.zh: 我宁愿走路，也不愿等公交车。

body.en: This box is rather heavy; can you help me?
body.zh: 这个箱子相当重，你能帮帮我吗？

body.en: We reached the station before the last train arrived.
body.zh: 末班车到达前，我们就到了车站。

body.en: Can you reach the book on the top shelf?
body.zh: 你够得到最上层架子上的书吗？

body.en: I like to read a little before going to bed.
body.zh: 我喜欢睡前读一会儿书。

body.en: Please read the instructions before you start the game.
body.zh: 开始游戏前，请先阅读说明。

body.en: I packed my schoolbag last night, so I am ready for class.
body.zh: 我昨晚收拾好了书包，所以已经准备好上课了。

body.en: Dinner is ready, and everyone can come to the table now.
body.zh: 晚饭准备好了，现在大家可以来餐桌旁了。

body.en: Is that a real butterfly or a toy?
body.zh: 那是一只真的蝴蝶还是玩具？

body.en: The story is based on a real event.
body.zh: 这个故事是根据真实事件改编的。

body.en: I did not realise how late it was.
body.zh: 我没有意识到时间已经这么晚了。

body.en: You will realise your mistake when you check the answer.
body.zh: 你核对答案时就会发现自己的错误。

body.en: I really enjoyed the story you told us yesterday.
body.zh: 我非常喜欢你昨天给我们讲的故事。

body.en: Did she really finish the whole book in one day?
body.zh: 她真的一天就读完了整本书吗？

body.en: The reason I brought a jacket is that it may rain.
body.zh: 我带夹克的原因是可能会下雨。

body.en: Can you tell me the reason for your choice?
body.zh: 你能告诉我你这样选择的原因吗？

body.en: I received a postcard from my friend yesterday.
body.zh: 我昨天收到了朋友寄来的明信片。

body.en: Our school will receive new books next week.
body.zh: 我们学校下周会收到新书。

body.en: A recent school trip took us to a farm outside town.
body.zh: 最近的一次学校旅行带我们去了镇外的农场。

body.en: The library has a recent book about space for young readers.
body.zh: 图书馆有一本最近出版、适合青少年阅读的太空书。

body.en: I could recognise her voice even in the noisy room.
body.zh: 即使房间里很吵，我也能辨认出她的声音。

body.en: Do you recognise anyone in this old family photo?
body.zh: 这张旧全家福里，你能认出谁吗？

body.en: Can you recommend a good book about space?
body.zh: 你能推荐一本关于太空的好书吗？

body.en: Teachers often recommend reading a little every day.
body.zh: 老师常建议每天读一点书。

body.en: Our teacher keeps a record of each student's reading time.
body.zh: 老师记录每位学生的阅读时间。

body.en: The runner broke the school record in the hundred-meter race.
body.zh: 这名跑步选手打破了学校的百米赛纪录。

body.en: We recycle paper and plastic at our school.
body.zh: 我们学校回收纸张和塑料。

body.en: Please recycle these bottles instead of throwing them away.
body.zh: 请回收这些瓶子，不要扔掉。

body.en: She wore a red scarf on the cold morning.
body.zh: 那个寒冷的早晨，她围了一条红围巾。

body.en: The traffic light turned red as we approached.
body.zh: 我们靠近时，交通灯变红了。

body.en: Our family uses cloth bags to reduce plastic waste.
body.zh: 我们家用布袋来减少塑料垃圾。

body.en: Walking to school can reduce the time we spend in traffic.
body.zh: 步行上学可以减少我们堵在路上的时间。

body.en: Mia refused the extra cake because she was already full.
body.zh: 米娅已经吃饱了，所以拒绝了多给她的蛋糕。

body.en: He refused to leave his little sister alone at the park.
body.zh: 他拒绝把妹妹一个人留在公园里。

body.en: I regret saying those unkind words to my friend.
body.zh: 我后悔对朋友说了那些不友善的话。

body.en: You will not regret joining our school music club.
body.zh: 加入我们学校的音乐社，你不会后悔的。

body.en: Good communication helps build a strong relationship between friends.
body.zh: 良好的沟通有助于建立牢固的友谊。

body.en: The teacher explained the relationship between plants and sunlight.
body.zh: 老师解释了植物和阳光之间的关系。

body.en: A relative from another city came to visit us.
body.zh: 一位外地亲戚来看望了我们。

body.en: My aunt is the relative I visit most often.
body.zh: 我最常看望的亲戚是阿姨。

body.en: I listen to quiet music to relax after school.
body.zh: 我放学后听轻柔的音乐来放松。

body.en: Take a short break and relax your shoulders.
body.zh: 休息一小会儿，放松肩膀。

body.en: Please remain seated until the school bus stops completely.
body.zh: 校车完全停下之前请保持坐好。

body.en: Only two pieces of cake remained after the party.
body.zh: 聚会后只剩下两块蛋糕。

body.en: Please remember to bring your library book tomorrow.
body.zh: 请记得明天把图书馆的书带来。

body.en: I remember our first school trip to the science museum.
body.zh: 我记得我们第一次去科学博物馆的校外活动。

body.en: Please remind me to bring my library book tomorrow.
body.zh: 请提醒我明天带上图书馆的书。

body.en: This song reminds Grandpa of his school days.
body.zh: 这首歌让爷爷想起了他的学生时代。

body.en: Dad will repair my bicycle this weekend.
body.zh: 爸爸这个周末要修我的自行车。

body.en: We need to repair the broken garden gate.
body.zh: 我们需要修理坏掉的花园大门。

body.en: Could you repeat the question more slowly, please?
body.zh: 请你把问题再慢一点重复一遍好吗？

body.en: Our team will repeat the dance at the school show tomorrow.
body.zh: 我们队明天会在学校演出上再次表演这支舞蹈。

body.en: Please reply to my message before Friday.
body.zh: 请在周五前回复我的消息。

body.en: I received a friendly reply from my old classmate.
body.zh: 我收到老同学的一条友好回复。

body.en: Lily wrote a short report about her class trip to the museum.
body.zh: 莉莉写了一篇关于班级博物馆之行的简短报告。

body.en: The school asked students to report any lost books to the office.
body.zh: 学校要求学生把丢失的书报告给办公室。

body.en: This art project requires paper, glue, and a pair of scissors.
body.zh: 这个美术项目需要纸、胶水和一把剪刀。

body.en: The school rules require students to wear clean shoes indoors.
body.zh: 校规要求学生在室内穿干净的鞋子。

body.en: Our class did research on birds that live near the lake.
body.zh: 我们班调查了生活在湖边的鸟类。

body.en: She reads books to research her science project.
body.zh: 她通过读书为科学项目做研究。

body.en: We should respect other people's ideas during our class discussion.
body.zh: 课堂讨论时，我们应该尊重他人的想法。

body.en: Our coach respects every player who practices with care.
body.zh: 教练尊重每一位认真训练的队员。

body.en: I am responsible for watering our classroom plants.
body.zh: 我负责给教室里的植物浇水。

body.en: A responsible student keeps promises and admits mistakes.
body.zh: 有责任心的学生信守承诺并承认错误。

body.en: After the long bike ride, we rested under a shady tree.
body.zh: 骑车走了很久后，我们在一棵阴凉的树下休息。

body.en: I finished the first page, and my sister read the rest.
body.zh: 我读完了第一页，剩下的部分由妹妹来读。

body.en: We had dinner at a restaurant near the river.
body.zh: 我们在河边一家餐厅吃了晚饭。

body.en: This restaurant serves fresh fish and vegetables.
body.zh: 这家餐厅供应新鲜的鱼和蔬菜。

body.en: The team checked the result after the final question.
body.zh: 最后一道题之后，队伍查看了结果。

body.en: Our hard work resulted in a clean school garden.
body.zh: 我们的努力让校园花园变得干净了。

body.en: Please return the library books before Friday afternoon.
body.zh: 请在星期五下午前归还图书馆的书。

body.en: We returned home before the rain started.
I review my English notes for ten minutes after dinner.
body.zh: 晚饭后我会花十分钟复习英语笔记。

body.en: Dad read a review of the new film before buying tickets.
body.zh: 买票前，爸爸读了一篇新电影的评论。

body.en: We had rice and vegetables for lunch.
body.zh: 我们午饭吃了米饭和蔬菜。

body.en: Please put the rice in a large bowl.
This valley has rich soil for growing vegetables.
body.zh: 这个山谷有适合种菜的肥沃土壤。

body.en: The rich businessman gave money to build a library.
body.zh: 那位富商捐款建了一座图书馆。

body.en: Can you ride a bicycle without any help?
We enjoyed a short boat ride on the lake.
body.zh: 我们在湖上愉快地坐了一小会儿船。

body.en: Turn right at the next street to find the bank.
body.zh: 在下一条街右转就能找到银行。

body.en: I checked the book to find the right answer.
body.zh: 我查了书，寻找正确答案。

body.en: I heard the doorbell ring during breakfast.
body.zh: 我吃早饭时听见门铃响了。

body.en: My grandmother wears a silver ring every day.
body.zh: 我奶奶每天都戴一枚银戒指。

body.en: The sun rises behind the hills early each morning.
body.zh: 每天清晨，太阳从山后升起。

body.en: The price of apples may rise before the holiday.
body.zh: 节日前苹果的价格可能会上涨。

body.en: We took a risk by walking home before the storm ended.
body.zh: 暴风雨还没结束我们就步行回家，冒了些风险。

body.en: Wearing a helmet lowers the risk of a head injury.
body.zh: 戴头盔能降低头部受伤的风险。

body.en: A narrow river runs through our village.
body.zh: 一条狭窄的河流穿过我们村。

body.en: We watched boats pass slowly along the river.
body.zh: 我们看着船只沿河缓缓驶过。

body.en: A new road connects our village with the nearest town.
body.zh: 一条新路连接了我们村和最近的小镇。

body.en: Please look both ways before crossing the road.
body.zh: 过马路前请先左右看看。

body.en: The robot can carry small boxes across the room.
body.zh: 这个机器人能把小箱子搬到房间另一边。

body.en: We built a simple robot in our science club.
body.zh: 我们在科学社团里做了一个简易机器人。

body.en: We sat on a large rock beside the path.
body.zh: 我们坐在小路旁的一块大石头上。

body.en: My brother enjoys listening to rock music after school.
body.zh: 哥哥喜欢放学后听摇滚乐。

body.en: The rocket rose slowly before disappearing into the clouds.
body.zh: 火箭缓缓升起，随后消失在云层中。

body.en: Our class made a model rocket from paper.
body.zh: 我们班用纸做了一个火箭模型。

body.en: Ben had the main role in the school play this year.
body.zh: 本今年在学校戏剧中担任主角。

body.en: Everyone has a role in keeping the classroom clean.
body.zh: 保持教室整洁人人有责。

body.en: There is room for one more chair beside the window.
body.zh: 窗边还放得下一把椅子。

body.en: My brother keeps his football and books in his room.
body.zh: 我弟弟把足球和书放在自己的房间里。

body.en: We tied the boat to a post with rope.
body.zh: 我们用绳子把船拴在柱子上。

body.en: Please hold the rope while I tie a knot.
body.zh: 我打结时，请帮忙抓住绳子。

body.en: A red rose grows beside our garden gate.
body.zh: 我们花园大门旁长着一株红玫瑰。

body.en: She put a rose in a glass vase.
body.zh: 她把一枝玫瑰插进玻璃花瓶里。

body.en: We sat around a round table for dinner.
body.zh: 我们围坐在一张圆桌旁吃晚饭。

body.en: The moon looked round and bright last night.
body.zh: 昨晚的月亮看起来又圆又亮。

body.en: Our seats are in the front row of the school theater.
body.zh: 我们的座位在学校剧院的前排。

body.en: Dad and I rowed across the lake in a small boat.
body.zh: 爸爸和我划着小船穿过了湖面。

body.en: Please put your rubbish in the nearest bin.
body.zh: 请把垃圾放进最近的垃圾桶。

body.en: We picked up rubbish along the beach yesterday.
body.zh: 我们昨天沿着海滩捡了垃圾。

body.en: The library rule says we must speak quietly inside.
body.zh: 图书馆的规定要求我们在里面轻声说话。

body.en: Our teacher ruled a straight line across the page.
body.zh: 老师在纸上画了一条直线。

body.en: Use a ruler to draw a straight line.
May I borrow your ruler for a moment?
body.zh: 我可以借你的尺子用一下吗？

body.en: Ben runs to school when he wakes up late.
body.zh: 本起晚时会跑着去学校。

body.en: My parents run a small shop near the station.
body.zh: 我父母在车站附近经营一家小店。

body.en: We had to rush to catch the last bus home.
body.zh: 我们得赶紧去赶最后一班回家的公交车。

body.en: Dad rushed through dinner because we were late for the school concert.
body.zh: 我们要赶不上学校音乐会了，爸爸匆忙吃完晚饭。

body.en: I felt sad when my best friend moved away.
body.zh: 最好的朋友搬走时，我很难过。

body.en: The story has a sad but beautiful ending.
body.zh: 故事有一个悲伤但美丽的结局。

body.en: Keep your money in a safe place.
We were glad that everyone arrived home safe.
body.zh: 所有人都平安到家，我们很高兴。

body.en: Our teacher explained the safety rules before the experiment.
body.zh: 实验前，老师讲解了安全规则。

body.en: We learned about road safety in class today.
body.zh: 我们今天在课上学习了道路安全知识。

body.en: I made a salad with tomatoes and lettuce.
body.zh: 我用番茄和生菜做了一份沙拉。

body.en: Would you like some fruit salad after lunch?
body.zh: 午饭后你想吃点水果沙拉吗？

body.en: These shoes are on sale at half price.
The old bicycle outside the shop is for sale.
body.zh: 商店外的那辆旧自行车正在出售。

body.en: Add a little salt to the soup before serving it.
body.zh: 上汤前往汤里加一点盐。

body.en: After the beach trip, we washed the salt from our shoes.
body.zh: 海边游玩后，我们洗掉了鞋上的盐渍。

body.en: We take the same bus to school.
body.zh: 我们乘同一趟公交车上学。

body.en: My bag is the same colour as yours.
body.zh: 我的包和你的颜色一样。

body.en: The children played in the sand by the sea.
body.zh: 孩子们在海边的沙地上玩耍。

body.en: There was sand inside my shoes after the walk.
body.zh: 散步后，我的鞋里进了沙子。

body.en: I made a cheese sandwich for my lunch.
body.zh: 我做了一个奶酪三明治当午餐。

body.en: She shared her sandwich with her little brother.
body.zh: 她和弟弟分吃了自己的三明治。

body.en: A simple answer did not satisfy the curious child.
body.zh: 一个简单的回答无法让好奇的孩子满意。

body.en: This large meal should satisfy everyone's hunger.
body.zh: 这顿丰盛的饭应该能让大家吃饱。

body.en: Mum saved some soup for me after I came home late.
body.zh: 我晚回家后，妈妈给我留了一些汤。

body.en: We can save water by turning off the tap while brushing our teeth.
body.zh: 刷牙时关掉水龙头，我们就能节约用水。

body.en: Dad says we can invite our cousins to the picnic.
body.zh: 爸爸说我们可以邀请表兄弟姐妹来野餐。

body.en: Please say your name clearly when the teacher calls you.
body.zh: 老师叫到你时，请清楚地说出你的名字。

body.en: Loud noises can scare the animals in the park.
body.zh: 巨响会吓到公园里的动物。

body.en: Please do not scare your sister with that mask.
body.zh: 请不要戴那个面具吓唬妹妹。

body.en: I wrapped a scarf around my neck.
body.zh: 我在脖子上围了一条围巾。

body.en: Grandma knitted a warm scarf for my birthday.
body.zh: 奶奶为我的生日织了一条暖围巾。

body.en: Our school has a garden behind the library.
body.zh: 我们学校图书馆后面有一个花园。

body.en: I walk to school with my cousin every day.
body.zh: 我每天和表亲一起步行上学。

body.en: I packed my schoolbag before going to bed.
Your schoolbag is under the chair by the window.
body.zh: 你的书包在窗边的椅子下面。

body.en: We did an experiment in our science lesson.
body.zh: 我们在科学课上做了一个实验。

body.en: The science museum has a room full of models.
body.zh: 科学博物馆有一间摆满模型的房间。

body.en: A scientist visited our school to talk about birds.
body.zh: 一位科学家到学校来讲鸟类知识。

body.en: My cousin hopes to become a scientist someday.
body.zh: 我表亲希望有一天成为科学家。

body.en: Use these scissors to cut the paper carefully.
body.zh: 用这把剪刀小心地剪纸。

body.en: Please put the scissors away after art class.
The final score was two goals to one.
He hopes to score a goal in today's match.
body.zh: 他希望在今天的比赛中进球。

body.en: The children watched a nature film on the large screen.
body.zh: 孩子们在大银幕上观看了一部自然纪录片。

body.en: Please clean your phone screen before putting it away.
body.zh: 收起手机前，请把屏幕擦干净。

body.en: We could see the sea from our hotel window.
body.zh: 我们从旅馆窗户可以看到大海。

body.en: The sea was calm when the boat left.
We searched the classroom for Ben's missing water bottle.
body.zh: 我们在教室里寻找本丢失的水瓶。

body.en: Dad used the library website to search for books about space.
body.zh: 爸爸用图书馆网站搜索有关太空的书。

body.en: Autumn is my favourite season of the year.
body.zh: 秋天是一年中我最喜欢的季节。

body.en: The rainy season usually brings plenty of water.
body.zh: 雨季通常带来充足的雨水。

body.en: Please take a seat while we find your ticket.
body.zh: 我们找你的票时，请先坐下。

body.en: I gave my seat to an older passenger.
body.zh: 我把座位让给了一位年长的乘客。

body.en: We kept the birthday gift a secret until Saturday.
body.zh: 我们把生日礼物保密到星期六。

body.en: Grandma told me the secret to making soft bread.
body.zh: 奶奶告诉了我做松软面包的秘诀。

body.en: We saw a rainbow over the playground after the rain stopped.
body.zh: 雨停后，我们看见操场上空有一道彩虹。

body.en: I see why my little brother is afraid of the dark.
body.zh: 我明白弟弟为什么害怕黑暗。

body.en: You seem tired after the long journey.
body.zh: 长途旅行后，你似乎很疲倦。

body.en: These questions seem easier than the last ones.
body.zh: 这些问题似乎比上次的容易。

body.en: We seldom watch television on school nights.
body.zh: 上学日的晚上，我们很少看电视。

body.en: My grandfather seldom travels far from home.
body.zh: 爷爷很少到离家很远的地方旅行。

body.en: They sell fresh bread at the corner shop.
body.zh: 街角那家商店卖新鲜面包。

body.en: We will sell our old books at the school fair.
body.zh: 我们将在学校集市出售旧书。

body.en: I will send Grandma a photo of our class garden.
body.zh: 我会给奶奶发一张我们班级花园的照片。

body.en: Please send this card to your cousin before Friday.
body.zh: 请在星期五前把这张卡片寄给你的表亲。

body.en: Use your sense of smell to find the fresh bread in the kitchen.
body.zh: 用你的嗅觉找出厨房里的新鲜面包。

body.en: Mia had the sense to wear a hat on the sunny hiking trail.
body.zh: 米娅很明智，知道在阳光明媚的徒步路上戴帽子。

body.en: I wrote one sentence about my favorite animal in English class.
body.zh: 英语课上，我用一个句子介绍了最喜欢的动物。

body.en: Please read the last sentence aloud before you answer the question.
body.zh: 回答问题前，请把最后一句大声读出来。

body.en: Please separate the clean clothes from the dirty ones.
body.zh: 请把干净衣服和脏衣服分开。

body.en: Our class has separate rooms for music and art lessons.
body.zh: 我们班上音乐课和美术课用不同的教室。

body.en: The teacher had a serious talk with us about road safety.
body.zh: 老师和我们认真谈了道路安全问题。

body.en: A serious storm kept our family at home all afternoon.
body.zh: 一场猛烈的暴风雨让我们一家整个下午都待在家里。

body.en: Dad will serve hot soup after we finish our homework.
body.zh: 我们做完作业后，爸爸会端上热汤。

body.en: The small shop serves fresh bread every morning.
body.zh: 这家小店每天早上供应新鲜面包。

body.en: The hotel offers free bus service to the city center.
body.zh: 这家酒店提供前往市中心的免费巴士服务。

body.en: The service at this restaurant is friendly and quick.
body.zh: 这家餐馆服务热情又快捷。

body.en: Please set the table while I finish cooking dinner.
body.zh: 请你摆好餐具，我把晚饭做完。

body.en: Our teacher set a reading task for the weekend.
body.zh: 老师布置了周末阅读任务。

body.en: Several students brought books to share with the class.
body.zh: 几名学生带了书来和全班分享。

body.en: We waited several minutes for the bus to arrive.
body.zh: 我们等了几分钟，公交车才到。

body.en: Please shake the bottle before opening it.
My hands sometimes shake when I feel nervous.
body.zh: 紧张时，我的双手有时会发抖。

body.en: Shall we walk to the park after lunch?
body.zh: 午饭后我们步行去公园好吗？

body.en: Where shall we meet before the concert starts?
body.zh: 音乐会开始前，我们在哪里碰面呢？

body.en: It is a shame that you missed the concert.
He felt shame after telling his friend a lie.
body.zh: 对朋友说谎后，他感到羞愧。

body.en: The children cut the paper into the shape of a star.
body.zh: 孩子们把纸剪成星星的形状。

body.en: Regular exercise helps keep your body in good shape.
body.zh: 经常锻炼有助于保持身体健康。

body.en: We share a desk during our art lessons.
body.zh: 美术课上，我们共用一张桌子。

body.en: Would you like to share this orange with me?
body.zh: 你想和我分吃这个橙子吗？

body.en: We saw a shark swimming behind the glass.
body.zh: 我们看见一条鲨鱼在玻璃后游动。

body.en: The book has a picture of a large shark.
body.zh: 这本书里有一张大鲨鱼的图片。

body.en: She takes the bus to school with her brother.
body.zh: 她和弟弟一起乘公交车上学。

body.en: I gave her my umbrella because she forgot hers.
body.zh: 我把伞给了她，因为她忘带自己的伞了。

body.en: A sheep stood beside the old farm gate.
body.zh: 一只羊站在农场的旧门旁。

body.en: We counted ten sheep in the green field.
body.zh: 我们数出绿地里有十只羊。

body.en: Please put the dictionary on the top shelf.
body.zh: 请把词典放在最上层的架子上。

body.en: This shelf is too high for me to reach.
body.zh: 这个架子太高，我够不着。

body.en: The stars shine brightly above the quiet village.
body.zh: 星星在宁静的村庄上空闪耀。

body.en: Please shine the torch under the sofa.
body.zh: 请用手电筒照一下沙发下面。

body.en: A large ship entered the harbour this morning.
body.zh: 今天上午，一艘大船驶入了港口。

body.en: We watched the ship disappear into the distance.
body.zh: 我们看着船消失在远方。

body.en: He wore a white shirt to the school concert.
body.zh: 他穿着白衬衫参加学校音乐会。

body.en: This cotton shirt is comfortable on hot days.
body.zh: 这件棉衬衫在热天穿着很舒服。

body.en: The sudden noise gave everyone a shock.
body.zh: 突如其来的响声让大家吃了一惊。

body.en: The news came as a shock to our family.
body.zh: 这个消息让我们全家都很震惊。

body.en: My left shoe has a small hole.
body.zh: 我左脚的鞋上有个小洞。

body.en: I found my missing shoe under the bed.
body.zh: 我在床下找到了丢失的鞋。

body.en: We watched the photographer shoot a family photo in the park.
body.zh: 我们看着摄影师在公园里拍家庭照。

body.en: The basketball player shot the ball toward the hoop.
body.zh: 篮球运动员把球投向篮筐。

body.en: We bought fresh bread at the corner shop.
body.zh: 我们在街角商店买了新鲜面包。

body.en: My grandparents shop at the market every Saturday.
body.zh: 爷爷奶奶每周六去市场购物。

body.en: We took a short break after the first lesson.
body.zh: 第一节课后，我们短暂休息了一下。

body.en: Her hair was short when she was younger.
I wear shorts when playing football in summer.
body.zh: 夏天踢足球时，我穿短裤。

body.en: These shorts are too small for me now.
body.zh: 这条短裤现在对我来说太小了。

body.en: You should check your answers before handing in homework.
body.zh: 交作业前，你应该检查答案。

body.en: We should listen carefully when other people speak.
body.zh: 别人说话时，我们应该认真听。

body.en: She carried the light bag on her shoulder.
body.zh: 她把那个轻便的包挎在肩上。

body.en: He looked over his shoulder and saw his friend.
body.zh: 他转头往后看，看到了朋友。

body.en: Please do not shout inside the quiet library.
body.zh: 请不要在安静的图书馆里大喊。

body.en: We heard a shout from across the playground.
body.zh: 我们听见操场另一边传来喊声。

body.en: Lily showed her science project to the class after lunch.
body.zh: 午饭后，莉莉向全班展示了她的科学项目。

body.en: The map shows a safe path from our school to the park.
body.zh: 这张地图标出了从学校到公园的一条安全路线。

body.en: I took a shower after football practice.
body.zh: 足球训练后，我洗了个淋浴。

body.en: A sudden shower made us hurry indoors.
body.zh: 一阵突如其来的阵雨让我们赶紧进屋。

body.en: Please shut the window before the rain comes into the room.
body.zh: 下雨进屋前请关上窗户。

body.en: The little shop shuts at six, so we should hurry.
body.zh: 这家小店六点关门，所以我们该抓紧时间。

body.en: The shy child stood close to his mother.
body.zh: 那个害羞的孩子紧紧站在妈妈身边。

body.en: I felt shy when introducing myself to the class.
body.zh: 向全班做自我介绍时，我很害羞。

body.en: Leo stayed home because he felt sick after breakfast.
body.zh: 利奥吃过早饭后觉得不舒服，所以待在家里。

body.en: The doctor told my sick brother to drink more water.
body.zh: 医生让生病的弟弟多喝水。

body.en: We sat on the sunny side of the playground during lunch.
body.zh: 午餐时我们坐在操场向阳的一边。

body.en: On the other side of the street, a bakery sells fresh bread.
body.zh: 街道另一边有一家面包店卖新鲜面包。

body.en: Please read the sign before you enter the swimming pool.
body.zh: 进入游泳池前，请先看标牌。

body.en: Dad signed the note to show that he had read it.
body.zh: 爸爸在便条上签了名，表示他已经读过。

body.en: Everyone became silent when the music began.
body.zh: 音乐开始时，所有人都安静了下来。

body.en: The house was silent after the guests left.
body.zh: 客人离开后，屋子里一片安静。

body.en: This scarf is made of soft silk.
body.zh: 这条围巾是用柔软的丝绸制成的。

body.en: She chose a silk dress for the party.
body.zh: 她为聚会选了一条丝绸连衣裙。

body.en: We laughed at the silly joke during lunch.
body.zh: 午饭时，我们被那个傻乎乎的笑话逗笑了。

body.en: It was silly of me to forget my umbrella.
The ring is made of pure silver.
body.zh: 这枚戒指是纯银制成的。

body.en: She won a silver medal in the swimming race.
body.zh: 她在游泳比赛中获得了一枚银牌。

body.en: My brother and I have similar tastes in music.
body.zh: 我和哥哥的音乐品味相似。

body.en: These two bags look similar, but one is much lighter.
body.zh: 这两个包看起来相似，但其中一个轻得多。

body.en: We made a simple paper plane during art class.
body.zh: 美术课上我们做了一架简单的纸飞机。

body.en: The teacher gave us simple directions to the school library.
body.zh: 老师给了我们去学校图书馆的简单路线说明。

body.en: I have known Amy since we started middle school.
body.zh: 从我们上初中起，我就认识艾米了。

body.en: Since the bus was late, Dad drove us to the museum.
body.zh: 因为公交车晚点，爸爸开车送我们去了博物馆。

body.en: We sing together at the end of music class.
body.zh: 音乐课结束时，我们一起唱歌。

body.en: My sister likes to sing while washing dishes.
body.zh: 我姐姐喜欢一边洗碗一边唱歌。

body.en: I packed a single sandwich for the short trip.
body.zh: 短途旅行时，我只带了一个三明治。

body.en: Each student wrote a single sentence about the picture.
body.zh: 每位学生都写了一句关于这幅图的话。

body.en: Sir, could you help me find this room?
body.zh: 先生，您能帮我找一下这个房间吗？

body.en: Please take a seat, sir, while we wait.
body.zh: 先生，请您坐着等一会儿。

body.en: My older sister taught me to ride a bike.
body.zh: 姐姐教会了我骑自行车。

body.en: I shared my room with my younger sister.
body.zh: 我和妹妹共用一个房间。

body.en: We sit together at lunch and talk about our day.
body.zh: 午餐时我们坐在一起聊聊当天的生活。

body.en: Please sit by the window while you wait for your mother.
We stayed calm in a difficult situation.
body.zh: 在困难的处境中，我们保持了冷静。

body.en: The teacher explained the situation to our parents.
body.zh: 老师向我们的父母说明了情况。

body.en: These shoes are the wrong size, so I need a larger pair.
body.zh: 这双鞋尺码不合适，所以我需要一双更大的。

body.en: The size of our garden is perfect for playing catch.
body.zh: 我们花园的大小很适合玩接球游戏。

body.en: We learned to skate at the ice rink.
body.zh: 我们在溜冰场学会了滑冰。

body.en: Can you skate backwards without falling over?
body.zh: 你能倒着滑冰而不摔倒吗？

body.en: My cousin taught me to ski last winter.
body.zh: 去年冬天，我表亲教会了我滑雪。

body.en: We hope to ski in the mountains this holiday.
body.zh: 我们希望这个假期去山区滑雪。

body.en: Cooking is a useful skill for daily life.
body.zh: 烹饪是一项日常生活中有用的技能。

body.en: Learning a new skill takes time and practice.
body.zh: 学习新技能需要时间和练习。

body.en: She wore a blue skirt to the party.
body.zh: 她穿了一条蓝色半身裙去聚会。

body.en: This skirt has two small pockets at the front.
body.zh: 这条半身裙前面有两个小口袋。

body.en: The sky became dark before the heavy rain.
We watched birds flying across the evening sky.
body.zh: 我们看着鸟儿飞过傍晚的天空。

body.en: I need enough sleep to stay awake in class.
body.zh: 我需要充足的睡眠，好在课上保持清醒。

body.en: The children sleep in separate rooms at home.
body.zh: 孩子们在家里分房间睡。

body.en: He is tall and slim, like his brother.
body.zh: 他和哥哥一样，又高又瘦。

body.en: She chose a slim notebook for her small bag.
body.zh: 她为小包选了一本薄笔记本。

body.en: The bus was slow because the road was crowded.
body.zh: 道路拥挤，公交车开得很慢。

body.en: Please slow down near the school gate.
Our small garden has enough space for three tomato plants.
body.zh: 我们的小花园有足够空间种三株番茄。

body.en: Please add a small amount of milk to my tea.
body.zh: 请在我的茶里加少量牛奶。

body.en: Lena found a smart way to carry all her books.
body.zh: 莉娜想到了一个巧妙的办法，把所有书都带上。

body.en: My brother looked smart in his new school uniform.
body.zh: 我弟弟穿着新校服看起来很精神。

body.en: The smell of fresh bread filled the kitchen.
body.zh: 新鲜面包的香气弥漫了厨房。

body.en: These flowers smell sweet after the morning rain.
body.zh: 晨雨过后，这些花闻起来很香。

body.en: Her friendly smile helped me feel welcome.
body.zh: 她友好的微笑让我感到受欢迎。

body.en: I always smile when I see our dog.
body.zh: 我每次看到我家的狗都会微笑。

body.en: Dark smoke rose from the chimney above the house.
body.zh: 深色的烟从房屋上方的烟囱冒出。

body.en: Please do not smoke near the school entrance.
body.zh: 请不要在学校入口附近吸烟。

body.en: I found a smooth stone beside the river.
body.zh: 我在河边找到一块光滑的石头。

body.en: The road became smooth after we left the village.
body.zh: 离开村庄后，道路变得平坦了。

body.en: I ate a small snack after basketball practice.
body.zh: 篮球训练后，我吃了一点零食。

body.en: Fruit can be a simple snack between meals.
body.zh: 水果可以作为两餐之间的简单零食。

body.en: A snake moved slowly through the long grass.
body.zh: 一条蛇缓缓穿过高草丛。

body.en: We saw a snake behind the glass at the zoo.
body.zh: 我们在动物园的玻璃后面看到了一条蛇。

body.en: Fresh snow covered the road during the night.
body.zh: 夜里，新下的雪覆盖了道路。

body.en: It may snow before we leave tomorrow.
body.zh: 明天出发前可能会下雪。

body.en: It was raining, so we played a board game at home.
body.zh: 当时正在下雨，所以我们在家玩棋盘游戏。

body.en: The soup was so hot that I waited before eating it.
body.zh: 汤太烫了，我等了一会儿才喝。

body.en: Our school has a social club for new students.
body.zh: 我们学校有一个面向新生的社交俱乐部。

body.en: The social event gave families a chance to meet.
body.zh: 这场社交活动让各个家庭有机会见面。

body.en: We discussed the meaning of socialism in class.
body.zh: 我们在课堂上讨论了社会主义的含义。

body.en: The textbook has a chapter about socialism.
body.zh: 课本里有一章介绍社会主义。

body.en: Our school society planted flowers around the playground on Friday.
body.zh: 星期五，我们学校的社团在操场周围种了花。

body.en: People in a society can help one another in many ways.
body.zh: 社会中的人们可以用许多方式互相帮助。

body.en: I found a hole in my left sock.
body.zh: 我发现左脚的袜子破了一个洞。

body.en: One sock was missing after I washed the clothes.
body.zh: 洗完衣服后，有一只袜子不见了。

body.en: The cat was asleep on the soft sofa.
body.zh: 猫在柔软的沙发上睡着了。

body.en: We sat on the sofa to watch a film.
body.zh: 我们坐在沙发上看电影。

body.en: This pillow is soft, so it feels nice under my head.
body.zh: 这个枕头很软，枕着很舒服。

body.en: Grandma spoke in a soft voice so the baby could sleep.
body.zh: 奶奶轻声说话，好让宝宝睡觉。

body.en: Grandpa put the seeds into soft soil in the garden.
body.zh: 爷爷把种子放进花园松软的土里。

body.en: We should keep plastic bags out of the soil.
body.zh: 我们应该避免塑料袋污染土壤。

body.en: The soldier helped carry supplies into the village.
body.zh: 那位士兵帮忙把物资搬进了村子。

body.en: Her grandfather was a soldier when he was young.
We solved the puzzle together after trying several ideas.
body.zh: 尝试了几种办法后，我们一起解开了谜题。

body.en: Our class is trying to solve the problem of food waste.
body.zh: 我们班正在努力解决食物浪费问题。

body.en: We picked some apples from the tree after lunch.
body.zh: 午饭后我们从树上摘了一些苹果。

body.en: Some of my classmates walk to school every day.
body.zh: 我的一些同学每天步行上学。

body.en: Somebody left an umbrella beside the classroom door.
body.zh: 有人把伞落在了教室门旁。

body.en: I need someone to help carry this box.
body.zh: 我需要有人帮忙搬这个箱子。

body.en: There is something strange inside this old box.
body.zh: 这个旧箱子里有个奇怪的东西。

body.en: Would you like something warm to drink?
I sometimes read on the bus to school.
body.zh: 我有时在上学的公交车上看书。

body.en: My father sometimes cooks dinner on busy evenings.
body.zh: 晚上大家忙时，爸爸有时会做饭。

body.en: I left my blue water bottle somewhere in the school library.
body.zh: 我把蓝色水瓶落在学校图书馆某处了。

body.en: Let's find somewhere quiet to read after lunch.
body.zh: 我们找个安静的地方午饭后读书吧。

body.en: Their son helps feed the dog before school every morning.
body.zh: 他们的儿子每天早晨上学前帮忙喂狗。

body.en: Mrs Green's son is learning to play the piano.
body.zh: 格林夫人的儿子正在学弹钢琴。

body.en: We sang a quiet song while the baby fell asleep.
body.zh: 宝宝入睡时，我们轻声唱了一首歌。

body.en: This song reminds Grandpa of his first year at school.
body.zh: 这首歌让爷爷想起了上学的第一年。

body.en: Our school trip will start soon, so please get ready.
body.zh: 学校旅行马上就要开始了，请做好准备。

body.en: Dad will be home soon after he finishes work.
body.zh: 爸爸下班后很快就会到家。

body.en: My feet were sore after the long walk home.
body.zh: 走了很长的路回家后，我的脚疼了。

body.en: I could not sing because I had a sore throat.
I am sorry that I broke your blue cup.
body.zh: 我打碎了你的蓝杯子，真对不起。

body.en: We felt sorry for the dog waiting alone in the rain.
body.zh: 那只狗独自在雨中等待，让我们很难过。

body.en: I heard the sound of rain on the roof last night.
body.zh: 昨晚我听见雨打在屋顶上的声音。

body.en: Your plan sounds good, so let's try it after school.
body.zh: 你的计划听起来不错，我们放学后试试吧。

body.en: Dad added a few mushrooms to the soup.
body.zh: 爸爸在汤里加了几朵蘑菇。

body.en: This soup is hot, so let it cool a little.
body.zh: 这汤很烫，让它稍微凉一凉。

body.en: My cousins live in the south of China near the sea.
body.zh: 我的表亲住在中国南方的海边。

body.en: We drove south until we reached a quiet village.
body.zh: 我们一路向南开，直到到达一个安静的村庄。

body.en: There is enough space in my bag for your book.
body.zh: 我的包里还有地方放你的书。

body.en: The film follows a small robot on a journey through space.
body.zh: 这部电影讲述了一台小机器人在太空中的旅程。

body.en: I keep a spare pencil in my schoolbag.
body.zh: 我在书包里放了一支备用铅笔。

body.en: Can you spare a minute to help me move this chair?
body.zh: 你能抽一分钟帮我挪一下这把椅子吗？

body.en: Please speak clearly so everyone at the back can hear.
body.zh: 请说清楚些，让后面的人都能听见。

body.en: My grandmother can speak both English and Chinese.
body.zh: 我的奶奶会说英语和中文。

body.en: Mum made a special cake for my birthday party.
body.zh: 妈妈为我的生日派对做了一个特别的蛋糕。

body.en: Our class has a special room for art and music lessons.
body.zh: 我们班有一间专门上美术和音乐课的教室。

body.en: Our teacher gave a short speech at the school festival.
body.zh: 老师在学校节庆活动上作了简短发言。

body.en: I practised my speech in front of the mirror.
The driver reduced his speed near the school gate.
body.zh: 靠近学校大门时，司机降低了车速。

body.en: We measured the speed of our toy cars in class.
body.zh: 课堂上，我们测量了玩具车的速度。

body.en: Can you spell your family name for me?
body.zh: 你能把姓氏拼给我听吗？

body.en: I used a dictionary to check how to spell this word.
body.zh: 我查了词典，核对这个词怎么拼。

body.en: I spend twenty minutes reading before bed each night.
body.zh: 我每晚睡前花二十分钟阅读。

body.en: We spent Saturday afternoon playing badminton together.
body.zh: 我们周六下午一起打了羽毛球。

body.en: Our team kept its fighting spirit even after losing a point.
body.zh: 即使丢了一分，我们队仍保持着斗志。

body.en: The story is about a friendly spirit in an old house.
body.zh: 这个故事讲的是一座老房子里的友善幽灵。

body.en: Please stir the soup gently with this wooden spoon.
body.zh: 请用这把木勺轻轻搅动汤。

body.en: I put a spoon beside each bowl before dinner.
body.zh: 晚饭前，我在每个碗旁放了一把勺子。

body.en: Swimming is my favourite sport during the summer.
body.zh: 游泳是我夏天最喜欢的运动。

body.en: You can try a new sport at the school club.
body.zh: 你可以在学校社团尝试一项新运动。

body.en: We spread a clean blanket on the grass for our picnic.
body.zh: 我们在草地上铺开干净的毯子野餐。

body.en: The good news spread quickly through our class.
body.zh: 这个好消息很快在我们班传开了。

body.en: Small flowers appear beside the path every spring.
body.zh: 每年春天，小路边都会开出小花。

body.en: We filled our bottles from a clear mountain spring.
body.zh: 我们用清澈的山泉水装满了水瓶。

body.en: Cut the paper into a square before folding it.
body.zh: 折纸之前，先把纸裁成正方形。

body.en: We met beside the fountain in the town square.
body.zh: 我们在镇上广场的喷泉旁见面。

body.en: The actors stood on the stage and thanked everyone.
body.zh: 演员们站在舞台上向大家致谢。

body.en: We have reached the final stage of our garden project.
body.zh: 我们的花园项目已进入最后阶段。

body.en: Please put a stamp on the envelope before posting it.
body.zh: 寄信前，请在信封上贴一张邮票。

body.en: Grandpa showed me a stamp with a panda on it.
body.zh: 爷爷给我看了一张印着熊猫的邮票。

body.en: Please stand beside your desk while the teacher checks attendance.
body.zh: 老师点名时，请站在课桌旁。

body.en: The bus stop stands near the entrance to the school.
body.zh: 公交车站就在学校入口附近。

body.en: The new library has a high standard of service.
body.zh: 新图书馆的服务水平很高。

body.en: This is the standard size for our class photo cards.
body.zh: 这是我们班照片卡片的标准尺寸。

body.en: A bright star appeared above the trees after sunset.
body.zh: 日落后，树木上方出现了一颗明亮的星星。

body.en: Our class made a paper star for the top of the tree.
body.zh: 我们班做了一颗纸星星，放在树顶。

body.en: We will start the game when everyone is ready.
body.zh: 等大家都准备好，我们就开始游戏。

body.en: At the start of the lesson, we checked our homework.
body.zh: 课程开始时，我们检查了作业。

body.en: The old bicycle was in a poor state when we found it.
body.zh: 我们找到那辆旧自行车时，它的状况很差。

body.en: Please state your name clearly when the teacher asks.
body.zh: 老师询问时，请清楚地说出你的名字。

body.en: We waited at the station for Grandma's train.
body.zh: 我们在车站等奶奶乘坐的火车。

body.en: The radio station played my favourite song this morning.
body.zh: 今天早上，电台播了我最喜欢的歌。

body.en: We stayed at my aunt's house during the school holiday.
body.zh: 学校放假期间，我们住在姑妈家。

body.en: Please stay here while I ask the teacher for help.
body.zh: 我去请老师帮忙时，请待在这里。

body.en: Someone tried to steal my bike outside the library.
body.zh: 有人试图偷走我放在图书馆外的自行车。

body.en: The cat stole a piece of chicken from the table.
body.zh: 猫从桌上叼走了一块鸡肉。

body.en: Read each step before you make the paper airplane.
body.zh: 制作纸飞机前，先读懂每个步骤。

body.en: She took a careful step onto the wet floor.
body.zh: 她小心地迈步走上湿滑的地板。

body.en: We found a long stick beside the path and used it as a walking pole.
body.zh: 我们在小路旁找到一根长棍子，把它当作拐杖。

body.en: Use glue to stick the photo onto the front of your notebook.
body.zh: 用胶水把照片粘在笔记本的封面上。

body.en: It is late, but the library is still open.
body.zh: 时间不早了，但图书馆还开着。

body.en: Keep still while I take a picture of you.
My stomach felt full after the large family dinner.
body.zh: 吃完那顿丰盛的家庭晚餐后，我觉得肚子很饱。

body.en: The nurse asked whether the pain was in my stomach.
body.zh: 护士问我是不是肚子疼。

body.en: Dad picked up a smooth stone beside the river.
body.zh: 爸爸在河边捡起一块光滑的石头。

body.en: The path to the garden is made of small stones.
body.zh: 通往花园的小路是用小石块铺成的。

body.en: The bus will stop outside the museum entrance.
body.zh: 公交车会在博物馆入口外停车。

body.en: Please stop talking while your classmate is reading aloud.
body.zh: 同学朗读时，请停止交谈。

body.en: Dad stopped at the store to buy some fresh bread.
body.zh: 爸爸在商店停下来买了些新鲜面包。

body.en: We store our winter coats in a box under the bed.
body.zh: 我们把冬衣收在床下的箱子里。

body.en: The storm kept us inside for most of the afternoon.
body.zh: 暴风雨使我们大半个下午都待在室内。

body.en: After the storm, we picked up branches from the path.
body.zh: 暴风雨过后，我们把小路上的树枝捡走了。

body.en: Grandpa told us a funny story before bedtime.
body.zh: 睡觉前，爷爷给我们讲了一个有趣的故事。

body.en: I read a story about a girl who found a lost dog.
body.zh: 我读了一个关于女孩找到一只走失小狗的故事。

body.en: Walk straight past the library, and the gym is on your left.
body.zh: 直走经过图书馆，体育馆就在你的左边。

body.en: Please draw a straight line across the top of the page.
body.zh: 请在页面上方画一条直线。

body.en: A strange noise came from the kitchen while we watched TV.
body.zh: 我们看电视时，厨房里传来一阵奇怪的声音。

body.en: Everything felt strange to the new student on his first day.
body.zh: 对新同学来说，第一天周围的一切都很陌生。

body.en: I saved the biggest strawberry for my little sister.
body.zh: 我把最大的草莓留给了妹妹。

body.en: We made strawberry jam with fruit from the garden.
body.zh: 我们用园子里的草莓做了果酱。

body.en: A new bookshop has opened across the street.
body.zh: 街对面新开了一家书店。

body.en: Look both ways before you cross the street.
A quiet walk helps me deal with stress after a busy day.
body.zh: 忙碌一天后，安静地散步帮我缓解压力。

body.en: The teacher put stress on the importance of checking our work.
body.zh: 老师强调了检查作业的重要性。

body.en: Our coach is strict about arriving on time.
body.zh: 教练对准时到场要求很严格。

body.en: The school has strict rules about using phones in class.
body.zh: 学校对上课使用手机有严格的规定。

body.en: A strong wind blew my hat across the field.
body.zh: 一阵大风把我的帽子吹过了田野。

body.en: This rope is strong enough to hold the swing.
body.zh: 这根绳子足够结实，能吊住秋千。

body.en: A new student joined our class after the winter holiday.
body.zh: 寒假后，一位新同学加入了我们班。

body.en: Each student chose a book to read during the trip.
body.zh: 每位学生都选了一本旅途中读的书。

body.en: I study English with my brother for twenty minutes each evening.
body.zh: 我每天晚上和哥哥一起学二十分钟英语。

body.en: Our class studied the life of a famous scientist last week.
body.zh: 上周我们班学习了一位著名科学家的生平。

body.en: I like the simple style of your room.
body.zh: 我喜欢你房间简洁的风格。

body.en: Our art teacher showed us a different style of painting.
body.zh: 美术老师给我们展示了一种不同的绘画风格。

body.en: History is the subject I enjoy most at school.
body.zh: 历史是我在学校最喜欢的学科。

body.en: Our conversation turned to the subject of summer holidays.
body.zh: 我们的话题转到了暑假上。

body.en: Lily practiced every day and succeeded in finishing the piano piece.
body.zh: 莉莉每天练习，终于成功弹完了那首钢琴曲。

body.en: You can succeed if you keep trying and ask for help when needed.
body.zh: 只要坚持尝试，并在需要时寻求帮助，你就能成功。

body.en: The school fair was a success despite the rain.
body.zh: 尽管下雨，学校活动会还是办得很成功。

body.en: We celebrated our success after finishing the difficult model.
body.zh: 完成那个难做的模型后，我们庆祝了成功。

body.en: It was such a sunny day that we ate outside.
body.zh: 天气那么晴朗，我们便在外面吃了饭。

body.en: Small animals, such as rabbits, can hide in the tall grass.
body.zh: 兔子等小动物能躲在高草丛中。

body.en: A sudden noise outside made the cat jump.
body.zh: 外面突然传来的声音吓得猫跳了起来。

body.en: The sudden change in weather made us go indoors.
body.zh: 天气突然变化，我们便进了屋。

body.en: Some plants suffer when they get too little water.
body.zh: 有些植物缺水时会受到损害。

body.en: My aunt sometimes suffers from headaches after long journeys.
body.zh: 我阿姨长途旅行后有时会头痛。

body.en: Mia added a little sugar to her tea after school.
body.zh: 米娅放学后往茶里加了一点糖。

body.en: The baker used sugar to make the cake sweet.
body.zh: 面包师用糖把蛋糕做得很甜。

body.en: I suggest taking an umbrella because the sky looks cloudy.
body.zh: 我建议带把伞，因为天看起来阴沉沉的。

body.en: Our teacher suggested a quiet place for the class meeting.
body.zh: 老师为班会推荐了一个安静的地方。

body.en: This blue jacket suits you well for the school concert.
body.zh: 这件蓝色夹克很适合你穿去学校音乐会。

body.en: Dad wore a dark suit to my aunt's wedding.
body.zh: 爸爸穿深色西装参加了我阿姨的婚礼。

body.en: We learned to swim at the local pool last summer.
body.zh: 去年夏天，我们在当地泳池学会了游泳。

body.en: The shop stays open later during the summer.
The sun came out just as we reached the beach.
body.zh: 我们刚到海滩，太阳就出来了。

body.en: Please move the chair out of the hot sun.
body.zh: 请把椅子从烈日下挪开。

body.en: We chose a sunny corner of the garden for our tomatoes.
body.zh: 我们选了菜园里阳光充足的角落种番茄。

body.en: Tomorrow looks sunny, so we can dry the blankets outside.
body.zh: 明天看来是晴天，我们可以在外面晒毯子。

body.en: I helped Dad carry the shopping home from the supermarket.
body.zh: 我帮爸爸把超市买的东西提回家。

body.en: The supermarket has moved the bread near the entrance.
body.zh: 超市把面包摆到了入口附近。

body.en: My family support me when I feel nervous before a game.
body.zh: 比赛前我感到紧张时，家人会支持我。

body.en: These strong legs support the table in our kitchen.
body.zh: 这些结实的桌腿支撑着我们厨房里的桌子。

body.en: I suppose we can walk home if the rain stops.
body.zh: 我想，要是雨停了，我们可以走回家。

body.en: Suppose the bus is late; how will we reach the station?
body.zh: 假如公交车晚点，我们要怎样赶到车站呢？

body.en: Are you sure this is the right way to the station?
body.zh: 你确定这是去车站的正确路线吗？

body.en: Make sure you close the window before leaving the classroom.
body.zh: 离开教室前，一定要关好窗户。

body.en: Small leaves floated on the surface of the pond.
body.zh: 小叶子漂在池塘水面上。

body.en: Wipe the table's surface before you put the plates down.
body.zh: 放盘子之前，请擦一擦桌面。

body.en: We planned a surprise party for our teacher after class.
body.zh: 下课后，我们为老师筹划了一场惊喜派对。

body.en: The birthday gift surprised my little brother.
body.zh: 生日礼物让我的弟弟很惊讶。

body.en: Our class did a survey about students' favorite sports.
body.zh: 我们班做了一项关于学生最喜欢的运动的调查。

body.en: The teacher asked us to survey our classmates about lunch choices.
body.zh: 老师让我们调查同学们对午餐的选择。

body.en: The small plant survived the cold winter beside our window.
body.zh: 这株小植物熬过了窗边寒冷的冬天。

body.en: After the long hike, we found water and survived.
body.zh: 长途徒步后，我们找到了水，活了下来。

body.en: Grandma made a warm sweater for my birthday.
body.zh: 奶奶为我的生日织了一件暖和的毛衣。

body.en: Take a sweater because it may get cold later.
body.zh: 带件毛衣吧，晚些时候可能会变冷。

body.en: I help sweep the classroom floor after school.
body.zh: 放学后，我帮忙打扫教室地面。

body.en: Please sweep the fallen leaves into a small pile.
The strawberries taste sweet after we wash them well.
body.zh: 草莓洗干净后吃起来很甜。

body.en: Our sweet neighbor brought homemade cookies for the children.
body.zh: 我们和蔼的邻居给孩子们带来了自制饼干。

body.en: I learned to swim at the local pool last summer.
body.zh: 去年夏天，我在当地游泳池学会了游泳。

body.en: Our teacher watches us carefully while we swim.
body.zh: 我们游泳时，老师仔细地看护着我们。

body.en: The heart is often used as a symbol of love.
body.zh: 心形常被用作爱的象征。

body.en: Each symbol on the map stands for a different place.
body.zh: 地图上的每个符号代表不同的地点。

body.en: Please put the bowls and chopsticks on the table.
body.zh: 请把碗和筷子放在桌上。

body.en: The table in our report shows how each plant grew.
body.zh: 我们报告里的表格展示了每株植物的生长情况。

body.en: The dog wagged its tail when it saw me.
body.zh: 狗看见我时摇起了尾巴。

body.en: We added a long paper tail to our kite.
body.zh: 我们给风筝加了一条长长的纸尾巴。

body.en: Please take your umbrella because the sky looks dark.
body.zh: 请带上雨伞，因为天色看起来很暗。

body.en: It takes me twenty minutes to walk to school each morning.
body.zh: 我每天早上步行上学要花二十分钟。

body.en: Mia has a talent for drawing animals and funny cartoons.
body.zh: 米娅擅长画动物和有趣的漫画。

body.en: Our music teacher noticed his talent during the school concert.
body.zh: 学校音乐会上，音乐老师注意到了他的才华。

body.en: Can we talk about our class trip after lunch?
body.zh: 我们午饭后可以聊聊班级旅行吗？

body.en: The guide gave a short talk before opening the garden gate.
body.zh: 向导在打开花园大门前作了简短介绍。

body.en: A tall tree stands beside the gate of our school.
body.zh: 学校大门旁有一棵高大的树。

body.en: The shelf is too high, even for my tall brother.
body.zh: 那个架子太高了，连我高个子的哥哥都够不着。

body.en: Please turn off the tap after washing your hands.
I felt a gentle tap on my shoulder.
body.zh: 我感到有人轻轻拍了一下我的肩膀。

body.en: Use a little tape to hold the paper in place.
body.zh: 用一点胶带把纸固定好。

body.en: Grandpa played an old tape of his favourite songs.
body.zh: 爷爷放了一盘录有他最爱歌曲的旧磁带。

body.en: Our first task is to clear the leaves from the path.
body.zh: 我们的第一项任务是清除小路上的落叶。

body.en: We shared the task of watering the plants during the holiday.
body.zh: 假期里，我们分担了给植物浇水的任务。

body.en: This tomato soup tastes sweet because Mom added some carrots.
body.zh: 这道番茄汤尝起来有点甜，因为妈妈加了些胡萝卜。

body.en: My brother has a taste for adventure stories about brave explorers.
body.zh: 我弟弟喜欢读关于勇敢探险家的冒险故事。

body.en: We took a taxi to the station because we were late.
body.zh: 我们迟到了，所以坐出租车去了车站。

body.en: The taxi driver helped Mum put her bags in the car.
body.zh: 出租车司机帮妈妈把包放进了车里。

body.en: Grandpa likes to drink tea while reading the newspaper.
body.zh: 爷爷喜欢一边看报纸一边喝茶。

body.en: Would you like a cup of tea after your walk?
My sister will teach me how to ride her new bike.
body.zh: 姐姐会教我骑她的新自行车。

body.en: Mr Lee teaches English at our school every weekday.
body.zh: 李老师每个工作日都在我们学校教英语。

body.en: Our science teacher showed us how to plant seeds.
body.zh: 科学老师向我们展示了怎样播种。

body.en: I asked the teacher to explain the question again.
body.zh: 我请老师再解释一遍这道题。

body.en: Our team practises basketball in the gym after school.
body.zh: 我们队放学后在体育馆练习篮球。

body.en: The science team built a small model of a bridge.
body.zh: 科学小组搭建了一座小桥模型。

body.en: Good teamwork helped us finish the model before lunch.
body.zh: 良好的团队合作帮助我们在午饭前完成了模型。

body.en: We learned the value of teamwork during the school play.
body.zh: 排演校园剧时，我们体会到了团队合作的价值。

body.en: This new technology helps farmers use less water.
body.zh: 这项新技术帮助农民减少用水。

body.en: Our class discussed how technology has changed travel.
body.zh: 我们班讨论了技术怎样改变旅行。

body.en: The story is about two teenage friends starting a band.
body.zh: 这个故事讲的是两位少年朋友组建乐队的事。

body.en: My teenage cousin helps children learn to read on Saturdays.
body.zh: 我十几岁的表姐每周六帮助孩子们学习阅读。

body.en: Please tell me where you found this key.
body.zh: 请告诉我，你在哪里找到这把钥匙的。

body.en: Grandma likes to tell stories about her childhood.
body.zh: 奶奶喜欢讲她童年的故事。

body.en: The temperature dropped, so I put on my warm jacket.
body.zh: 气温下降了，所以我穿上了暖和的夹克。

body.en: The nurse checked my temperature when I felt unwell.
body.zh: 我感觉不舒服时，护士给我量了体温。

body.en: My sister and I play tennis at the weekend.
body.zh: 周末，我和姐姐一起打网球。

body.en: We watched a close tennis match on Saturday afternoon.
body.zh: 周六下午，我们看了一场势均力敌的网球赛。

body.en: We put up our tent before the sun went down.
body.zh: 太阳落山前，我们搭好了帐篷。

body.en: Rain fell all night, but our tent stayed dry inside.
body.zh: 雨下了一整夜，但帐篷里面一直很干燥。

body.en: Our new term starts next week, and I need fresh notebooks.
body.zh: 新学期下周开始，我需要准备新笔记本。

body.en: Please ask your teacher what this science term means.
body.zh: 请问老师这个科学术语是什么意思。

body.en: I felt terrible when I forgot my friend's birthday.
body.zh: 我忘了朋友的生日，心里很难受。

body.en: The soup tasted terrible, so Dad made us some noodles.
body.zh: 汤的味道很糟，所以爸爸给我们煮了些面条。

body.en: We have a science test on Friday, so I am reviewing my notes.
body.zh: 周五有科学测验，所以我正在复习笔记。

body.en: The teacher tested our new robot on the classroom floor.
body.zh: 老师在教室地板上测试了我们的新机器人。

body.en: Read the text carefully before you answer the questions.
body.zh: 答题前，请仔细阅读课文。

body.en: I will text you when our train reaches the station.
body.zh: 火车到站时，我会给你发短信。

body.en: My schoolbag is lighter than the one I carried last year.
body.zh: 我的书包比去年背的那个轻。

body.en: We finished the puzzle sooner than our parents expected.
body.zh: 我们比爸妈预想的更早完成了拼图。

body.en: I want to thank you for helping me carry these books.
body.zh: 我想感谢你帮我搬这些书。

body.en: We wrote a card to thank our teacher for her help.
body.zh: 我们写了一张卡片，感谢老师的帮助。

body.en: That blue bike belongs to my older brother.
body.zh: 那辆蓝色自行车是我哥哥的。

body.en: I think that our team can finish the project today.
body.zh: 我认为我们队今天能完成这个项目。

body.en: The bus to school arrives at seven thirty every morning.
body.zh: 每天早上，开往学校的公交车七点半到。

body.en: Please put the apples on the table beside the window.
body.zh: 请把苹果放在窗边的桌子上。

body.en: We saw a funny play at the theatre with our grandparents.
body.zh: 我们和爷爷奶奶在剧院看了一出有趣的戏。

body.en: The theater near our home shows a new film every weekend.
body.zh: 我们家附近的电影院每个周末都会放映一部新电影。

body.en: The children put their coats on the hooks by the door.
body.zh: 孩子们把外套挂在门边的钩子上。

body.en: Their dog waits beside the gate every afternoon.
body.zh: 他们的狗每天下午都在大门旁等着。

body.en: Our classroom is on this floor, and theirs is upstairs.
body.zh: 我们的教室在这一层，他们的在楼上。

body.en: We lent them our tent because theirs was broken.
body.zh: 他们的帐篷坏了，所以我们把自己的借给了他们。

body.en: I put the clean cups on the table and left them there.
body.zh: 我把干净的杯子放在桌上，没有再挪动它们。

body.en: Our teacher invited them to join the school music club.
body.zh: 我们的老师邀请他们加入学校音乐社团。

body.en: The children made lunch themselves while their parents were away.
body.zh: 父母不在时，孩子们自己做了午饭。

body.en: They introduced themselves to the new teacher after class.
body.zh: 下课后，他们向新老师作了自我介绍。

body.en: First, wash the apples, and then cut them into small pieces.
body.zh: 先洗苹果，然后把它们切成小块。

body.en: We lived near the beach then, so we swam every weekend.
body.zh: 那时我们住在海边，所以每个周末都去游泳。

body.en: Your red umbrella is over there beside the classroom door.
body.zh: 你的红雨伞就在那边的教室门旁。

body.en: We went there by bus to visit my cousin last Sunday.
body.zh: 上星期天我们乘公交车去那里看望表姐。

body.en: The road was closed; therefore, we took a different route.
body.zh: 道路封闭了，因此我们换了一条路线。

body.en: I forgot my umbrella and therefore got wet on the walk home.
body.zh: 我忘了带伞，所以走回家时淋湿了。

body.en: These apples are sweet, so let's share them after lunch.
body.zh: 这些苹果很甜，咱们午饭后一起吃吧。

body.en: I made these cards for my friends on their birthdays.
body.zh: 我为朋友们制作了这些生日卡片。

body.en: They planted flowers beside the school gate last spring.
body.zh: 去年春天，他们在校门旁种了花。

body.en: I asked the twins if they wanted to join our game.
body.zh: 我问那对双胞胎是否想加入我们的游戏。

body.en: The book is too thick to fit in my small bag.
body.zh: 这本书太厚，放不进我的小包。

body.en: We wore thick socks during our winter camping trip.
body.zh: 冬季露营时，我们穿了厚袜子。

body.en: Cut the bread into thin slices for our sandwiches.
body.zh: 把面包切成薄片，做我们的三明治。

body.en: The thin branch could not hold the heavy bag.
body.zh: 细细的树枝承受不住那个沉重的包。

body.en: The first thing I do each morning is open the curtains.
body.zh: 我每天早晨做的第一件事是拉开窗帘。

body.en: Please put your things away before dinner is ready.
body.zh: 晚饭做好之前，请把你的东西收好。

body.en: I think our class can finish decorating the room before lunch.
body.zh: 我认为我们班能在午饭前布置好房间。

body.en: Think about what you want to pack for the school trip.
body.zh: 想想你想为学校旅行带些什么。

body.en: We were thirsty after playing basketball in the sun.
body.zh: 在阳光下打完篮球后，我们口渴了。

body.en: The thirsty dog drank from a bowl of clean water.
body.zh: 口渴的狗喝了碗里的清水。

body.en: This sandwich is for you, and that one is for your sister.
body.zh: 这个三明治是给你的，那个是给你姐姐的。

body.en: I found this note beside my lunch box this morning.
body.zh: 今天早上我在饭盒旁发现了这张便条。

body.en: Those clouds look dark, so we should head home.
body.zh: 那些云看起来很暗，我们该回家了。

body.en: Can you pass me those books on the top shelf?
body.zh: 你能把最上层架子上的那些书递给我吗？

body.en: Though it was cold, we played basketball after school.
body.zh: 虽然天气很冷，我们还是放学后打了篮球。

body.en: The cake looked simple; it tasted wonderful, though.
body.zh: 蛋糕看起来很普通，不过味道很棒。

body.en: I thought we could ride our bikes to the park after lunch.
body.zh: 我想午饭后我们可以骑车去公园。

body.en: Her thought was to make a card for Grandma's birthday.
body.zh: 她的想法是给奶奶做一张生日卡片。

body.en: My throat felt dry after I talked for an hour.
body.zh: 说了一个小时的话后，我感到喉咙发干。

body.en: The speaker cleared his throat before starting his talk.
body.zh: 发言者开始讲话前清了清嗓子。

body.en: We walked through the tunnel to reach the beach.
body.zh: 我们穿过隧道，到达了海滩。

body.en: Sunlight came through the curtains and fell across my bed.
body.zh: 阳光透过窗帘，洒在我的床上。

body.en: Please throw the ball gently so the little dog can catch it.
body.zh: 请轻轻地扔球，这样小狗才能接住。

body.en: He threw his wet coat over the chair after the walk.
body.zh: 散步后，他把湿外套搭在椅子上。

body.en: We heard loud thunder while watching the rain from indoors.
body.zh: 我们在室内看雨时，听到了响亮的雷声。

body.en: The sudden sound of thunder woke the sleeping dog.
body.zh: 突然响起的雷声惊醒了熟睡的狗。

body.en: Dad bought two train tickets for our trip to the city.
body.zh: 爸爸为我们去城里的旅行买了两张火车票。

body.en: Keep your ticket until the museum visit is over.
body.zh: 参观博物馆结束前请保留好门票。

body.en: Please keep your desk tidy so you can find things easily.
body.zh: 请保持书桌整洁，这样找东西就容易了。

body.en: I will tidy my room before my friends arrive.
body.zh: 朋友们来之前，我会收拾好房间。

body.en: I tie my sports shoes before running around the playground.
body.zh: 我绕操场跑步前会系好运动鞋。

body.en: The football game ended in a tie after two goals each.
body.zh: 双方各进两球，足球比赛最终打成平局。

body.en: The tiger in the picture is resting beside a river.
body.zh: 图片里的老虎正在河边休息。

body.en: We learned about the tiger and its forest home.
body.zh: 我们了解了老虎和它在森林中的家园。

body.en: We have enough time to walk to school before the first lesson.
body.zh: 第一节课前，我们有足够的时间走到学校。

body.en: Dad times my swim while I practice in the pool.
body.zh: 我在泳池练习时，爸爸为我计时。

body.en: A tiny bird made a nest above our front door.
body.zh: 一只小鸟在我们前门上方筑了巢。

body.en: She wrote her name in tiny letters on the label.
body.zh: 她用很小的字在标签上写了名字。

body.en: I felt tired after carrying the boxes upstairs.
body.zh: 把箱子搬上楼后，我觉得累了。

body.en: We are tired of waiting and want to go home.
body.zh: 我们等得不耐烦了，想回家。
