body.en: We walked to the library after our art lesson.
body.zh: 美术课后，我们走到图书馆。

body.en: I want to learn how to make bread.
Today we are making sandwiches for the class picnic.
body.zh: 今天我们要为班级野餐做三明治。

body.en: Grandma says life is busier today than it was years ago.
body.zh: 奶奶说，现在的生活比多年前更忙碌。

body.en: We cooked tofu with vegetables for dinner last night.
body.zh: 昨晚我们把豆腐和蔬菜一起烹调，作为晚饭。

body.en: Grandma puts soft tofu into the hot soup.
body.zh: 奶奶把嫩豆腐放进热汤里。

body.en: My sister and I bake cookies together on Sundays.
body.zh: 我和姐姐每周日一起烤饼干。

body.en: The students worked together to clean the classroom.
body.zh: 学生们一起打扫了教室。

body.en: Excuse me, is there a toilet near the entrance?
body.zh: 打扰一下，入口附近有洗手间吗？

body.en: Please leave the toilet clean for the next person.
body.zh: 请保持厕所清洁，方便下一位使用。

body.en: I added a fresh tomato to my cheese sandwich.
body.zh: 我在奶酪三明治里加了一个新鲜番茄。

body.en: This tomato plant needs more sunlight to grow well.
body.zh: 这株番茄需要更多阳光才能长得好。

body.en: We will visit the science museum tomorrow afternoon.
body.zh: 明天下午，我们将参观科学博物馆。

body.en: Please bring your library book back to school tomorrow.
body.zh: 请明天把借的图书带回学校。

body.en: The farmer sold a ton of rice at the market.
body.zh: 农民在市场上卖出了一吨大米。

body.en: This small truck can carry one ton of sand.
body.zh: 这辆小卡车能装一吨沙子。

body.en: We will eat outside tonight if the weather stays warm.
body.zh: 如果天气一直暖和，今晚我们就在外面吃饭。

body.en: Please finish packing tonight because our train leaves early.
body.zh: 请今晚收好行李，因为火车出发得早。

body.en: This box is too heavy for me to carry alone.
body.zh: 这个箱子太重，我一个人搬不动。

body.en: My brother likes swimming, and I like it too.
body.zh: 我哥哥喜欢游泳，我也喜欢。

body.en: This small tool helps us remove weeds from the garden.
body.zh: 这个小工具能帮我们清除花园里的杂草。

body.en: Put each tool back in its place after you finish.
body.zh: 做完后，请把每件工具放回原处。

body.en: I brush each tooth carefully before going to bed.
body.zh: 睡觉前，我仔细刷每一颗牙。

body.en: The dentist said two teeth need a little care.
body.zh: 牙医说有两颗牙需要稍加护理。

body.en: Please write your name at the top of the page.
body.zh: 请在页面上方写下你的名字。

body.en: We reached the top of the hill before lunch.
body.zh: 午饭前，我们到达了山顶。

body.en: The total cost of our picnic was eighty yuan.
body.zh: 我们的野餐总共花了八十元。

body.en: We collected a total of thirty books for the library.
body.zh: 我们一共为图书馆收集了三十本书。

body.en: Please do not touch the wet paint on the bench.
body.zh: 请别碰长椅上还没干的油漆。

body.en: The kitten woke at the touch of my hand.
body.zh: 我的手一碰，小猫就醒了。

body.en: Our family took a tour of the old town during the holiday.
body.zh: 假期里，我们全家游览了老城区。

body.en: The singer will tour several cities with her band this summer.
body.zh: 今年夏天，这位歌手将和乐队巡演几个城市。

body.en: A tourist asked me how to get to the museum.
body.zh: 一位游客向我打听去博物馆的路。

body.en: The village has a tourist centre near the lake.
body.zh: 村里的游客中心在湖边。

body.en: The dog ran towards me when I opened the garden gate.
body.zh: 我打开花园门时，狗朝我跑来。

body.en: Our class walked towards the museum after lunch.
body.zh: 午饭后，我们班朝博物馆走去。

body.en: We could see the river from the old stone tower.
body.zh: 从那座古老的石塔上，我们能看到河流。

body.en: The clock tower stands in the centre of our town.
body.zh: 钟楼位于我们小镇的中心。

body.en: My grandparents live in a small town near the mountains.
body.zh: 我的祖父母住在山附近的一座小镇上。

body.en: We took the bus into town to buy some fruit.
body.zh: 我们乘公交车进城买了一些水果。

body.en: My little sister keeps her favourite toy beside her bed.
body.zh: 我妹妹把最喜欢的玩具放在床边。

body.en: We made a toy boat from an empty milk carton.
body.zh: 我们用空牛奶盒做了一艘玩具船。

body.en: The two shops trade with farms in the nearby villages.
body.zh: 这两家商店与附近村庄的农场做生意。

body.en: Would you like to trade your blue card for my red one?
body.zh: 你愿意用蓝色卡片换我的红色卡片吗？

body.en: It is a family tradition to make dumplings together before the New Year.
body.zh: 新年前一起包饺子是我们家的传统。

body.en: Our school has a tradition of singing together at the winter concert.
body.zh: 我们学校有在冬季音乐会上一起唱歌的传统。

body.en: Heavy traffic made our bus arrive ten minutes late.
body.zh: 交通拥堵使我们的公交车晚到了十分钟。

body.en: We waited for the traffic lights to turn green.
Our train leaves at nine, so we must hurry.
body.zh: 我们的火车九点出发，所以必须抓紧时间。

body.en: The coach will train the new players after school.
body.zh: 放学后，教练将训练新队员。

body.en: Our football training starts at four on Wednesday.
body.zh: 我们的足球训练每周三四点开始。

body.en: The new library helpers received training before their first day.
body.zh: 新来的图书馆助理上岗前接受了培训。

body.en: Can you translate this short letter into Chinese?
body.zh: 你能把这封简短的信翻译成中文吗？

body.en: We used a dictionary to translate the words on the sign.
body.zh: 我们用词典翻译了牌子上的文字。

body.en: We usually travel by train when we visit another city.
body.zh: 去别的城市时，我们通常乘火车。

body.en: I hope to travel around China when I am older.
body.zh: 我希望长大后能游历中国。

body.en: The children drew a map to look for hidden treasure.
body.zh: 孩子们画了一张地图，寻找藏起来的宝藏。

body.en: I treasure the letters my grandparents sent me.
body.zh: 我珍藏着祖父母寄给我的信。

body.en: Please treat the new student as part of our team.
body.zh: 请把新同学当作我们团队的一员。

body.en: Grandma bought us ice cream as a special treat.
body.zh: 奶奶特意买冰淇淋给我们解馋。

body.en: We sat under a tree to rest after our walk.
body.zh: 走了一段路后，我们坐在树下休息。

body.en: The tree we planted last year is much taller now.
body.zh: 我们去年种的树现在高多了。

body.en: We took a short trip to the coast last weekend.
body.zh: 上周末，我们去海边作了一次短途旅行。

body.en: Be careful not to trip over the bag by the door.
body.zh: 小心，别被门边的包绊倒。

body.en: I had trouble opening the jar, so Dad helped me.
body.zh: 我拧不开罐子，爸爸帮了我。

body.en: The old bike gave us trouble on the steep hill.
body.zh: 上陡坡时，那辆旧自行车给我们添了麻烦。

body.en: These trousers are too long, so I need a smaller pair.
body.zh: 这条裤子太长了，我需要一条小一点的。

body.en: Dad put on his black trousers before leaving for work.
body.zh: 爸爸出门上班前穿上了黑色长裤。

body.en: A delivery truck brought new books to our school library.
body.zh: 一辆送货卡车给我们学校的图书馆送来了新书。

body.en: We watched a big truck carry boxes along the country road.
body.zh: 我们看着一辆大卡车沿乡间公路运送箱子。

body.en: The story about the lost dog is true; I saw it happen.
body.zh: 关于那只走失小狗的故事是真的，我亲眼看到了。

body.en: A true friend listens when you have a problem.
body.zh: 真正的朋友会在你遇到困难时倾听。

body.en: I trust my best friend to keep my birthday surprise secret.
body.zh: 我相信好朋友会替我保守生日惊喜的秘密。

body.en: Our dog trusts the vet after many kind visits.
body.zh: 经过多次友善的看诊，我们的狗信任这位兽医。

body.en: I told the truth about the broken window.
body.zh: 我如实说明了窗户被打破的情况。

body.en: The children searched for clues to discover the truth.
body.zh: 孩子们寻找线索，想查明真相。

body.en: I will try to finish this picture before dinner.
body.zh: 我会尽量在晚饭前画完这幅画。

body.en: Would you like to try some of this vegetable soup?
body.zh: 你想尝一点这道蔬菜汤吗？

body.en: Turn left at the next street, and you will see the library.
body.zh: 在下一条街左转，你就会看到图书馆。

body.en: Please turn off the lights before you leave the classroom.
An ugly stain appeared on the new white tablecloth.
body.zh: 新的白桌布上出现了一块难看的污渍。

body.en: We cleaned the ugly marks off the garden wall.
body.zh: 我们清除了花园墙上难看的印记。

body.en: I shared my umbrella with a friend in the rain.
body.zh: 下雨时，我和朋友共用一把伞。

body.en: Please leave your wet umbrella beside the front door.
body.zh: 请把湿伞放在前门旁边。

body.en: My uncle taught me how to repair a bicycle.
body.zh: 叔叔教我如何修理自行车。

body.en: We stayed at my uncle's house during the holiday.
body.zh: 假期里，我们住在叔叔家。

body.en: The cat is sleeping under the warm blanket on the sofa.
body.zh: 猫正在沙发上的暖毯子下面睡觉。

body.en: Our classroom is under the library on the second floor.
body.zh: 我们的教室在二楼图书馆的下面。

body.en: We took the underground to the museum in London.
body.zh: 我们在伦敦乘地铁去了博物馆。

body.en: Some small animals live underground during the cold winter.
body.zh: 寒冷的冬天，一些小动物生活在地下。

body.en: I understand the rules, so I can start the game.
body.zh: 我懂这些规则了，可以开始游戏了。

body.en: Did you understand what the teacher said?
body.zh: 你听懂老师说的话了吗？

body.en: Please wear your school uniform for the class photograph.
body.zh: 拍班级合照时，请穿校服。

body.en: The worker's uniform has bright lines that are easy to see.
body.zh: 这位工人的制服上有显眼的亮色条纹。

body.en: Our class will finish this unit by the end of the week.
body.zh: 我们班将在本周结束前学完这个单元。

body.en: A metre is a unit for measuring length.
Scientists use large telescopes to study the universe.
body.zh: 科学家用大型望远镜研究宇宙。

body.en: The book helped me understand our place in the universe.
body.zh: 这本书帮助我理解了我们在宇宙中的位置。

body.en: My sister studies history at a university near our town.
body.zh: 我姐姐在我们镇附近的一所大学学历史。

body.en: The university opened its gardens to visitors on Saturday.
body.zh: 那所大学周六向游客开放了校园花园。

body.en: We cannot play outside unless the rain stops soon.
body.zh: 除非雨很快停下来，否则我们不能在外面玩。

body.en: Unless you save your work, you may lose your story.
body.zh: 如果不保存作品，你可能会丢失故事。

body.en: We waited until the rain stopped before walking home.
body.zh: 我们等到雨停后才步行回家。

body.en: The library stays open till six on school days.
body.zh: 上学日图书馆开放到六点。

body.en: The little dog ran up the hill to meet its owner.
body.zh: 小狗跑上山去迎接主人。

body.en: Please pick up your toys before you go outside.
body.zh: 出门前请把玩具收起来。

body.en: The cat jumped upon the warm chair by the window.
body.zh: 猫跳到了窗边温暖的椅子上。

body.en: Upon arriving home, Leo called his grandmother.
body.zh: 到家后，利奥给奶奶打了电话。

body.en: Our teacher asked us to bring leaves for the art lesson.
body.zh: 老师让我们带些树叶上美术课。

body.en: Grandpa told us a story while we waited for dinner.
body.zh: 等晚饭时，爷爷给我们讲了一个故事。

body.en: You can use my ruler to draw a straight line.
body.zh: 你可以用我的尺子画直线。

body.en: This old chair is still in use in our kitchen.
body.zh: 这把旧椅子还在我们厨房里使用。

body.en: The bus arrived at its usual time this morning.
body.zh: 今天早晨，公交车按平常的时间到了。

body.en: As usual, Dad made breakfast before we got up.
body.zh: 和往常一样，爸爸在我们起床前做好了早餐。

body.en: Our family will visit the mountains during the summer vacation.
body.zh: 暑假期间，我们一家将去山里游玩。

body.en: I learned to ride a bike while on vacation.
body.zh: 度假时，我学会了骑自行车。

body.en: This old photo has great value to my grandparents.
body.zh: 这张旧照片对我的祖父母来说很珍贵。

body.en: Our teacher values every student's ideas during class discussions.
body.zh: 课堂讨论时，老师重视每位学生的想法。

body.en: Which vegetable would you like to add to the soup?
body.zh: 你想往汤里加哪种蔬菜？

body.en: Grandpa grows beans and carrots in his vegetable garden.
body.zh: 爷爷在菜园里种豆角和胡萝卜。

body.en: The water in this part of the lake is very clear.
Thank you very much for helping me find my cat.
body.zh: 非常感谢你帮我找到了猫。

body.en: Our team celebrated its victory with a picnic after the final game.
body.zh: 决赛后，我们队用野餐庆祝胜利。

body.en: The players thanked their coach after their hard-earned victory.
body.zh: 取得来之不易的胜利后，队员们感谢了教练。

body.en: We watched a short video about how bread is made.
body.zh: 我们看了一段介绍面包制作过程的短视频。

body.en: My cousin sent a video of her new puppy.
body.zh: 我的表亲发来了一段她家新小狗的视频。

body.en: The view from the top of the hill was beautiful at sunset.
body.zh: 日落时从山顶看到的景色很美。

body.en: We viewed the old photos together after dinner.
body.zh: 晚饭后我们一起看了那些旧照片。

body.en: My grandparents live in a quiet village near the river.
body.zh: 我的祖父母住在河边一个安静的村庄里。

body.en: We bought fresh vegetables from a small shop in the village.
body.zh: 我们在村里的一家小店买了新鲜蔬菜。

body.en: My cousin practises the violin for half an hour every day.
body.zh: 我的表弟每天练半个小时小提琴。

body.en: The violin in this shop costs more than my bike.
body.zh: 这家店里的那把小提琴比我的自行车还贵。

body.en: The doctor explained how a virus can spread between people.
body.zh: 医生解释了病毒如何在人与人之间传播。

body.en: A virus damaged some files on the old computer.
body.zh: 病毒损坏了旧电脑上的一些文件。

body.en: We plan to visit our grandparents during the winter holiday.
body.zh: 我们计划寒假去看望祖父母。

body.en: Our visit to the science museum lasted three hours.
body.zh: 我们在科学博物馆参观了三个小时。

body.en: Nina used a clear voice when she read the story to the class.
body.zh: 妮娜在班上朗读故事时声音清晰。

body.en: I heard Dad's voice outside and opened the front door.
body.zh: 我听见爸爸在外面说话，便打开了前门。

body.en: Our class plays volleyball in the playground after lunch.
body.zh: 午饭后，我们班在操场上打排球。

body.en: She hit the volleyball over the net to her friend.
body.zh: 她把排球打过网，传给朋友。

body.en: Joining the after-school running club is completely voluntary.
body.zh: 参加课后跑步社团完全出于自愿。

body.en: My sister does voluntary work at the local animal centre.
body.zh: 姐姐在当地动物中心做志愿工作。

body.en: A volunteer helped us find our seats in the theatre.
body.zh: 一位志愿者帮我们找到了剧院里的座位。

body.en: I want to volunteer at the library during the holidays.
body.zh: 我想在假期去图书馆做志愿服务。

body.en: Each student has one vote when we choose the class film.
body.zh: 选择班级电影时，每位学生都有一票。

body.en: We will vote for a team captain after lunch.
body.zh: 午饭后，我们会投票选队长。

body.en: Please wait here while I look for your book.
body.zh: 我去找你的书，请在这里等一会儿。

body.en: We had to wait ten minutes for the next bus.
body.zh: 我们不得不等十分钟才有下一班公交车。

body.en: Please wake me at seven so I can catch the bus.
body.zh: 请七点叫醒我，好让我赶上公交车。

body.en: I often wake up early when birds sing outside.
body.zh: 窗外鸟儿歌唱时，我常常早早醒来。

body.en: We walk to school together when the weather is good.
body.zh: 天气好的时候，我们一起步行去上学。

body.en: A short walk after dinner helps me feel relaxed.
body.zh: 晚饭后散一小会儿步让我感到放松。

body.en: We put a map of China on the classroom wall.
body.zh: 我们在教室墙上贴了一幅中国地图。

body.en: The garden wall is too high for the dog to jump over.
body.zh: 花园的墙太高，狗跳不过去。

body.en: I found my wallet under a pile of books.
body.zh: 我在一堆书下面找到了钱包。

body.en: She returned the lost wallet to the school office.
body.zh: 她把捡到的钱包交到了学校办公室。

body.en: I want to learn how to bake bread with my grandmother.
body.zh: 我想学着和奶奶一起烤面包。

body.en: The plants want more sunlight, so move them near the window.
body.zh: 这些植物需要更多阳光，把它们移到窗边吧。

body.en: We read a story about children who lived through a war.
body.zh: 我们读了一个关于经历战争的孩子们的故事。

body.en: The history book explains how the war ended.
body.zh: 这本历史书讲述了战争是如何结束的。

body.en: This thick coat keeps me warm on cold mornings.
body.zh: 寒冷的早晨，这件厚外套让我保持暖和。

body.en: We received a warm welcome from the children at our new school.
body.zh: 新学校的孩子们热情地欢迎了我们。

body.en: Mom warned us not to run on the wet floor.
body.zh: 妈妈提醒我们不要在湿地板上跑。

body.en: The sign warns visitors about the deep water.
body.zh: 这个标志提醒游客注意深水。

body.en: warn sb. not to do sth.
Please wash your hands before you help make dinner.
body.zh: 请先洗手，再来帮忙做晚饭。

body.en: I help my father wash the car on Sundays.
body.zh: 每逢周日，我都帮爸爸洗车。

body.en: Please do not waste water while you brush your teeth.
We put paper waste in a box for recycling at school.
body.zh: 我们把废纸放进学校的回收箱。

body.en: We like to watch the birds outside our kitchen window.
body.zh: 我们喜欢看厨房窗外的鸟。

body.en: My watch stopped, so I asked Dad for the time.
body.zh: 我的手表停了，所以我问爸爸几点了。

body.en: Please water the flowers before you leave for school.
After our long walk, we stopped to drink some cool water.
body.zh: 长途步行后，我们停下来喝了些凉水。

body.en: We shared a large watermelon after playing in the garden.
body.zh: 在花园里玩耍后，我们分着吃了一个大西瓜。

body.en: Mum cut the watermelon into small pieces for everyone.
body.zh: 妈妈把西瓜切成小块，分给大家。

body.en: The children wave to their parents after the school concert.
body.zh: 学校音乐会结束后，孩子们向家长挥手。

body.en: A big wave carried the ball back onto the beach.
body.zh: 一个大浪把球冲回了沙滩。

body.en: This is the easiest way to carry the books to class.
body.zh: 这是把书带去教室最简单的方法。

body.en: We found our way home by following the blue signs.
body.zh: 我们沿着蓝色路标找到了回家的路。

body.en: We walk to school together every morning.
body.zh: 我们每天早上一起步行去学校。

body.en: Our teacher said we could borrow these books.
body.zh: 老师说我们可以借这些书。

body.en: The little bird was too weak to fly away.
The signal is weak, so I cannot hear you clearly.
body.zh: 信号很弱，所以我听不清你说的话。

body.en: The museum has a wealth of information about local history.
body.zh: 博物馆有大量关于当地历史的信息。

body.en: He used part of his wealth to build a village library.
body.zh: 他用一部分财富建了一座乡村图书馆。

body.en: I usually wear a hat when I work in the garden.
body.zh: 在花园里干活时，我通常戴着帽子。

body.en: You should wear comfortable shoes for the long walk.
body.zh: 走这么远的路，你应该穿舒适的鞋子。

body.en: The weather was sunny, so we ate lunch outside.
body.zh: 天气晴朗，所以我们在外面吃了午饭。

body.en: Check the weather before you pack for the school trip.
body.zh: 为学校旅行收拾行李前，先看看天气。

body.en: Our school website has a list of all the clubs.
body.zh: 学校网站上有所有社团的名单。

body.en: I found the museum's opening hours on its website.
body.zh: 我在博物馆的网站上查到了开放时间。

body.en: I borrowed this library book for one week.
body.zh: 这本图书馆的书我借一周。

body.en: We practise our play twice a week after school.
body.zh: 我们每周放学后排练两次话剧。

body.en: I get up at seven every weekday.
body.zh: 每个工作日我都七点起床。

body.en: The shop closes earlier on a weekday than on Saturday.
body.zh: 这家商店工作日比周六关门早。

body.en: We visited my grandparents in the village last weekend.
body.zh: 上周末我们去村里看望了祖父母。

body.en: I usually finish my homework before dinner on weekends.
body.zh: 我通常在周末晚饭前完成作业。

body.en: Please weigh these apples before putting them in the bag.
body.zh: 请先称这些苹果，再把它们装进袋子。

body.en: We need to weigh both ideas before making a decision.
body.zh: 做决定之前，我们需要权衡这两个想法。

body.en: The shelf cannot hold the weight of all these books.
body.zh: 这个架子承受不了这些书的全部重量。

body.en: We checked the weight of our bags before the flight.
body.zh: 乘飞机前，我们检查了行李的重量。

body.en: Our teacher stood at the door to welcome the new students.
body.zh: 老师站在门口欢迎新同学。

body.en: You are welcome to join our reading group after school.
body.zh: 欢迎你放学后加入我们的阅读小组。

body.en: My sister plays the piano very well.
Are you feeling well enough to come outside?
body.zh: 你身体感觉好些了吗，能出来吗？

body.en: The sun sets in the west, behind the hills near our home.
body.zh: 太阳在西边落下，落在我们家附近的山后。

body.en: We drove west to visit my aunt in the next town.
body.zh: 我们向西开车去邻镇看望阿姨。

body.en: My shoes got wet when I walked through the rain.
body.zh: 我冒雨走路时，鞋子湿了。

body.en: Be careful; the floor is still wet after cleaning.
body.zh: 小心，清洁后的地面还没干。

body.en: We saw a whale rise above the water near our boat.
body.zh: 我们看到一头鲸在船附近浮出水面。

body.en: The film shows a young whale swimming beside its mother.
body.zh: 影片中，一头幼鲸在妈妈身旁游动。

body.en: What did you put in your lunch box today?
body.zh: 你今天在饭盒里放了什么？

body.en: I know what my little brother wants for his birthday.
body.zh: 我知道弟弟生日想要什么。

body.en: You can choose whatever color you like for the kite.
body.zh: 你可以给风筝选任何自己喜欢的颜色。

body.en: Whatever happens in the game, we will keep trying.
body.zh: 无论比赛中发生什么，我们都会继续努力。

body.en: The front wheel of my bicycle will not turn.
body.zh: 我的自行车前轮转不动了。

body.en: The driver turned the wheel slowly at the quiet corner.
body.zh: 司机在安静的路口慢慢转动方向盘。

body.en: When the bell rings, we put away our books and leave quietly.
body.zh: 铃声响时，我们收好书，安静地离开。

body.en: Do you remember when we first met at the school gate?
body.zh: 你还记得我们第一次在校门口见面是什么时候吗？

body.en: You can ask me a question whenever you need help.
body.zh: 你需要帮助时，随时都可以问我问题。

body.en: Whenever it rains, we play board games at home.
body.zh: 每逢下雨，我们就在家玩棋盘游戏。

body.en: Where did you put the map we need for our walk?
body.zh: 你把我们散步要用的地图放在哪儿了？

body.en: This is the garden where my grandparents grow vegetables.
body.zh: 这就是我祖父母种菜的园子。

body.en: I don't know whether the shop is open today.
body.zh: 我不知道这家商店今天是否营业。

body.en: We can play outside whether it rains or not.
body.zh: 无论下不下雨，我们都可以在外面玩。

body.en: Which bus should we take to get to the city museum?
body.zh: 我们应该坐哪辆公交车去市博物馆？

body.en: I found the book which you left on the classroom desk.
body.zh: 我找到了你落在教室课桌上的书。

body.en: I dried the plates while my brother washed them.
body.zh: 哥哥洗盘子，我把洗好的盘子擦干。

body.en: We rested for a while before climbing the next hill.
body.zh: 我们休息了一会儿，才继续攀登下一座山。

body.en: My brother wore a white shirt to the school concert.
body.zh: 弟弟穿着一件白衬衫参加学校音乐会。

body.en: We painted the walls white to make the room brighter.
body.zh: 我们把墙刷成白色，让房间更明亮。

body.en: Who is waiting for you outside the school gate?
Do you know who left this lunch box here?
body.zh: 你知道是谁把这个饭盒落在这里了吗？

body.en: We spent the whole afternoon making a kite in the garden.
body.zh: 我们整个下午都在花园里做风筝。

body.en: She ate a whole apple after finishing her homework.
body.zh: 写完作业后，她吃了一整个苹果。

body.en: The man with whom Dad works lives near our school.
body.zh: 和爸爸一起工作的那个人住在我们学校附近。

body.en: The friend to whom I sent the letter lives abroad.
body.zh: 我寄信给的那位朋友住在国外。

body.en: Do you know whose coat is on this chair?
body.zh: 你知道这把椅子上的外套是谁的吗？

body.en: The girl whose bike broke down walked home with us.
body.zh: 自行车坏了的那个女孩和我们一起走回家。

body.en: Why did you choose this book for our reading group?
body.zh: 你为什么给我们的阅读小组选这本书？

body.en: I understand why the little dog was frightened.
body.zh: 我明白那只小狗为什么害怕了。

body.en: The road is wide enough for two buses to pass.
body.zh: 这条路够宽，两辆公交车可以错车通过。

body.en: She opened her eyes wide when she saw the birthday cake.
body.zh: 看到生日蛋糕时，她睁大了眼睛。

body.en: Uncle Tom and his wife brought fruit to our family picnic.
body.zh: 汤姆叔叔和他的妻子带了水果来参加家庭野餐。

body.en: The story is about a farmer and his wife who live near a forest.
body.zh: 这个故事讲的是一位住在森林附近的农夫和他的妻子。

body.en: We saw wild rabbits near the edge of the field.
body.zh: 我们在田边看到了野兔。

body.en: Please leave the wild flowers growing beside the path.
body.zh: 请让路边的野花继续生长，别摘它们。

body.en: I will help you carry those books after lunch.
body.zh: 午饭后我会帮你搬那些书。

body.en: Will your family visit the science museum this weekend?
body.zh: 你家人这个周末会去参观科学博物馆吗？

body.en: Our team hopes to win the next basketball game.
body.zh: 我们队希望赢得下一场篮球赛。

body.en: The young runner worked hard to win a place on the team.
body.zh: 这位年轻跑者努力争取入队的机会。

body.en: The wind carried our paper plane across the garden.
body.zh: 风把我们的纸飞机吹过了花园。

body.en: We could hear the wind moving through the trees at night.
body.zh: 夜里，我们听得见风穿过树林的声音。

body.en: Please open the window to let some fresh air in.
body.zh: 请打开窗户，让新鲜空气进来。

body.en: I saw my friend waving outside the bus window.
body.zh: 我看见朋友在公交车窗外挥手。

body.en: It is too windy to play badminton outside today.
body.zh: 今天风太大，不适合在外面打羽毛球。

body.en: On windy days, we keep the classroom windows closed.
body.zh: 刮风的日子里，我们关着教室的窗户。

body.en: The bird hurt one wing, so it could not fly home.
body.zh: 这只鸟的一只翅膀受了伤，所以不能飞回家。

body.en: We saw a small plane with a red wing at the air show.
body.zh: 我们在航展上看到一架红色机翼的小飞机。

body.en: The winner of the school race received a gold medal.
body.zh: 校运会赛跑的获胜者得到了一枚金牌。

body.en: Every winner shook hands with the other players after the game.
body.zh: 比赛结束后，每位获胜者都和其他选手握手。

body.en: We wear thick coats when winter comes to our town.
body.zh: 冬天来到我们小镇时，我们会穿上厚外套。

body.en: I learned to cook soup during the winter holiday.
body.zh: 寒假期间，我学会了煮汤。

body.en: It was wise to ask for directions before leaving.
body.zh: 出发前问清路线是明智的。

body.en: My grandfather gave me some wise advice about saving money.
body.zh: 爷爷给了我一些有关存钱的明智建议。

body.en: I made a wish before blowing out the birthday candles.
body.zh: 吹灭生日蜡烛前，我许了个愿。

body.en: We wish our teacher a happy and relaxing holiday.
body.zh: 我们祝老师假期愉快、轻松。

body.en: I walked to the park with my cousin after lunch.
body.zh: 午饭后我和表妹一起步行去了公园。

body.en: She opened the box with a small key.
body.zh: 她用一把小钥匙打开了盒子。

body.en: Please finish your homework within one hour.
body.zh: 请在一小时内完成作业。

body.en: The library is within walking distance of our school.
body.zh: 图书馆离我们学校很近，步行就能到。

body.en: I cannot finish this puzzle without your help.
body.zh: 没有你的帮助，我完成不了这个拼图。

body.en: Lily left home without her umbrella on a rainy morning.
body.zh: 一个下雨的早晨，莉莉没带伞就出门了。

body.en: A grey wolf stood near the trees in the photograph.
body.zh: 照片里，一只灰狼站在树旁。

body.en: We learned how wolves live together in the wild.
body.zh: 我们了解了狼在野外如何一起生活。

body.en: The woman beside the gate is our new science teacher.
body.zh: 门边那位女士是我们的新科学老师。

body.en: Two women helped us lift the heavy box onto the table.
body.zh: 两位女士帮我们把重箱子抬到了桌上。

body.en: I wonder how these tiny seeds become tall trees.
body.zh: 我好奇，这些小种子是怎样长成大树的。

body.en: The children looked at the bright stars in wonder.
body.zh: 孩子们惊叹地望着明亮的星星。

body.en: We had a wonderful time making dumplings with Grandma.
body.zh: 和奶奶一起包饺子让我们度过了愉快的时光。

body.en: Your idea for the school garden sounds wonderful.
body.zh: 你对学校花园的想法听起来很棒。

body.en: We made a small birdhouse from pieces of wood.
body.zh: 我们用几块木头做了一个小鸟屋。

body.en: The path crosses a quiet wood before reaching the lake.
body.zh: 这条小路穿过一片安静的树林，通向湖边。

body.en: I found an interesting new word in my storybook.
body.zh: 我在故事书里发现了一个有趣的新单词。

body.en: I did not understand a word of the announcement.
body.zh: 那则通知，我一个字也没听懂。

body.en: We work together to keep the classroom clean.
body.zh: 我们一起努力，保持教室整洁。

body.en: The old clock does not work, but Grandpa can fix it.
body.zh: 这只旧钟不走了，不过爷爷会修。

body.en: A worker came to repair the broken classroom door.
body.zh: 一位工人来修理坏了的教室门。

body.en: Each worker wears a helmet when entering the building site.
body.zh: 每位工人进入建筑工地时都戴着安全帽。

body.en: People around the world enjoy different kinds of bread.
body.zh: 世界各地的人喜欢不同种类的面包。

body.en: This map shows some of the world's largest rivers.
body.zh: 这张地图标出了世界上一些最大的河流。

body.en: Please do not worry about the test; we can prepare together.
body.zh: 请别担心考试，我们可以一起准备。

body.en: The missing dog was a great worry to our family.
body.zh: 狗走丢了，让我们全家十分担心。

body.en: The weather became worse, so we stayed indoors.
body.zh: 天气变得更糟了，所以我们待在室内。

body.en: Leaving the broken tap running will make the problem worse.
body.zh: 让坏了的水龙头一直流水会使问题更严重。

body.en: This is the worst storm we have seen this summer.
body.zh: 这是我们今年夏天见过的最猛烈的暴风雨。

body.en: The worst part of the trip was losing my bag.
body.zh: 旅途中最糟糕的事是弄丢了我的包。

body.en: This book is worth reading because its pictures are beautiful.
body.zh: 这本书值得一读，因为里面的图片很美。

body.en: The old toy is worth ten dollars at the market.
body.zh: 这个旧玩具在市场上值十美元。

body.en: Would you help me carry these books to the classroom?
body.zh: 你愿意帮我把这些书搬到教室吗？

body.en: When we were little, we would play outside after dinner.
body.zh: 我们小时候常常晚饭后在外面玩。

body.en: The nurse cleaned the small wound on my knee.
body.zh: 护士清理了我膝盖上的小伤口。

body.en: The bird's wing had a wound, so we called for help.
body.zh: 鸟的翅膀受了伤，于是我们打电话求助。

body.en: I write three new English sentences in my notebook every evening.
body.zh: 我每天晚上在笔记本里写三个英语新句子。

body.en: Please write your name on the first page of the form.
body.zh: 请把名字写在表格第一页上。

body.en: I took the wrong bus and arrived late for class.
body.zh: 我坐错了公交车，上课迟到了。

body.en: There is nothing wrong with asking for help.
body.zh: 寻求帮助没有什么不对。

body.en: We planted a small tree in the front yard.
body.zh: 我们在前院种了一棵小树。

body.en: The ball rolled across the yard and under the fence.
body.zh: 球滚过院子，滚到了围栏下面。

body.en: Our class will visit the science museum later this year.
body.zh: 我们班今年晚些时候将参观科学博物馆。

body.en: My little brother is seven years old and loves drawing.
The leaves on this tree turn yellow in autumn.
body.zh: 这棵树的叶子在秋天变黄。

body.en: Please use a yellow pencil to draw the sun.
Mia said yes when her friend invited her to the library.
body.zh: 朋友邀请米娅去图书馆时，她答应了。

body.en: If the answer is yes, put a tick beside the question.
body.zh: 如果答案是肯定的，请在问题旁打勾。

body.en: We planted a small tree behind our classroom yesterday.
body.zh: 昨天我们在教室后面种了一棵小树。

body.en: The book you lent me yesterday is very interesting.
body.zh: 你昨天借给我的那本书很有趣。

body.en: I have not finished my science project yet.
body.zh: 我的科学项目还没有完成。

body.en: The sky was cloudy, yet the children still went outside to play.
body.zh: 天空阴沉，不过孩子们还是到外面玩了。

body.en: I put some fresh fruit in my yogurt at breakfast.
body.zh: 早餐时我往酸奶里加了一些新鲜水果。

body.en: Please keep the yogurt in the fridge until lunchtime.
body.zh: 午饭前请把酸奶放在冰箱里。

body.en: You can borrow my colored pencils for your art project.
body.zh: 你可以借我的彩色铅笔做美术项目。

body.en: I saved a seat for you near the window.
body.zh: 我在窗边给你留了一个座位。

body.en: My young cousin can already ride a bike without help.
body.zh: 我年幼的表弟已经能独自骑自行车了。

body.en: The young players practiced together after school.
body.zh: 这些年轻的队员放学后一起练习。

body.en: Please bring your lunch box to the classroom tomorrow.
body.zh: 明天请把你的午餐盒带到教室。

body.en: Your parents are waiting for you beside the school gate.
body.zh: 你的父母正在校门旁等你。

body.en: My umbrella is blue, and yours is yellow.
body.zh: 我的伞是蓝色的，你的是黄色的。

body.en: I found a notebook under the desk; is it yours?
body.zh: 我在书桌下面发现一本笔记本，是你的吗？

body.en: Did you make this beautiful model all by yourself?
body.zh: 这个漂亮的模型是你完全独立做的吗？

body.en: Please help yourselves to the fruit on the table.
body.zh: 请大家随意吃桌上的水果。

body.en: My grandfather spent his youth in a small village by the sea.
body.zh: 我爷爷的青年时代是在海边一个小村庄度过的。

body.en: The town opened a new sports club for local youth.
body.zh: 镇上为当地年轻人开了一家新的体育俱乐部。

body.en: The temperature fell to zero during the night.
Our team won the game by two goals to zero.
body.zh: 我们队以二比零赢得了比赛。

body.en: Our class visited the zoo to learn about wild animals.
body.zh: 我们班参观了动物园，了解野生动物。

body.en: The zoo closes at five, so we cannot stay long.
body.zh: 动物园五点关门，所以我们不能待太久。
